definition: the fact that somebody/something is able to do something
example: People with the disease may lose their ability to communicate.
definition_zh: 某人或某物能够做到某件事这一事实
example_zh: 患有该疾病的人可能会丧失沟通能力。

definition: to have the skill, intelligence, opportunity, etc. needed to do something
example: You must be able to speak French for this job.
definition_zh: 要具备完成某件事所需的技能、智慧、机会等
example_zh: 你必须会说法语才能胜任这份工作。

definition: in or to a foreign country
example: to go/travel/live/study abroad
definition_zh: 在国外或前往外国
example_zh: 去/旅行/生活/留学

definition: to take willingly something that is offered; to say ‘yes’ to an offer, invitation, etc.
example: He asked me to marry him and I accepted.
definition_zh: 心甘情愿地接受别人所提供的东西;对提议、邀请等说“是”。
example_zh: 他向我求婚，我答应了。

definition: an unpleasant event, especially in a vehicle, that happens unexpectedly and causes injury or damage
example: a car/road/traffic accident
definition_zh: 尤其是在车辆中，发生意外并造成伤害或损害的不愉快事件
example_zh: 一场汽车/道路/交通事故

definition: as stated or reported by somebody/something
example: According to Mick, it's a great movie.
definition_zh: 如某人/某物所述或报告
example_zh: 据米克说，这是一部很棒的电影。

definition: to succeed in reaching a particular goal, status or standard, especially by making an effort for a long time
example: He had finally achieved success.
definition_zh: 要成功达到某个特定目标、地位或标准，尤其是通过长时间的努力
example_zh: 他终于取得了成功。

definition: to do something for a particular purpose or in order to deal with a situation
example: act to do something, It is vital that we act to stop the destruction of the rainforests.
definition_zh: 为特定目的或应对某种情况而做某件事
example_zh: 采取行动，阻止雨林的破坏至关重要。

definition: always busy doing things, especially physical activities
example: Staying physically active in later years can also keep you feeling younger.
definition_zh: 总是忙着做各种事情，尤其是体力活动
example_zh: 晚年保持身体活动也能让你感觉更年轻。

definition: used in speaking to emphasize a fact or a comment, or that something is really true
example: What did she actually say?
definition_zh: 在说话时用来强调某一事实或评论，或者表明某件事确实真实
example_zh: 她到底说了什么？

definition: fully grown or developed
example: preparing young people for adult life
definition_zh: 完全成熟或已开发
example_zh: 为年轻人准备成年生活

definition: a thing that helps you to be better or more successful than other people
example: a distinct/significant/huge advantage
definition_zh: 一件能帮助你比别人更好或更成功的事情
example_zh: 一个独特/显著/巨大的优势

definition: an unusual, exciting or dangerous experience, journey or series of events
example: her adventures travelling in Africa
definition_zh: 一次不同寻常、激动人心或危险的经历、旅程或一系列事件
example_zh: 她在非洲旅行的冒险经历

definition: to tell the public about a product or a service in order to encourage people to buy or to use it
example: If you want to attract customers you need to advertise.
definition_zh: 向公众介绍产品或服务，以鼓励人们购买或使用该产品
example_zh: 如果你想吸引客户，就必须做广告。

definition: a notice, picture or film telling people about a product, job or service
example: a newspaper/television advertisement
definition_zh: 一张告知、图片或影片，向人们介绍某项产品、工作或服务
example_zh: 报纸/电视广告

definition: the activity and industry of advertising things to people on television, in newspapers, on the internet, etc.
example: Cigarette advertising has been banned.
definition_zh: 在电视、报纸、互联网等媒体上向人们宣传事物的活动和行业。
example_zh: 香烟广告已被禁止。

definition: to produce a change in somebody/something
example: How will these changes affect us?
definition_zh: 为某人/某物带来改变
example_zh: 这些变化将如何影响我们？

definition: later in time; afterwards
example: That was in 1996. Soon after, I heard that he'd died.
definition_zh: 以后;之后
example_zh: 那是在1996年。不久之后，我听说他去世了。

definition: at a time later than something; when something has finished
example: I'll call you after I've spoken to them.
definition_zh: 在某件事之后;当某件事结束时
example_zh: 我跟他们说完电话再给你打电话。

definition: opposing or disagreeing with somebody/something
example: the fight against terrorism
definition_zh: 反对或不同意某人/某事
example_zh: 打击恐怖主义

definition: used to express surprise, pleasure or sympathy, or when you disagree with somebody
example: Ah, there you are!
definition_zh: 用来表达惊讶、喜悦或同情，或者当你不同意某人观点时
example_zh: 啊，你在这儿啊！

definition: a company that provides regular flights to take passengers and goods to different places
example: an airline pilot/passenger
definition_zh: 一家提供定期航班，将乘客和货物运往不同地点的公司
example_zh: 一名航空公司飞行员/乘客

definition: living; not dead
example: Is your mother still alive?
definition_zh: 活着;不是死去
example_zh: 妈还活着吗？

definition: completely
example: She was dressed all in white.
definition_zh: 完全
example_zh: 她全身都是白色的。

definition: acceptable; in an acceptable manner
example: Is the coffee all right?
definition_zh: 可接受;以可接受的方式
example_zh: 咖啡还好吗？

definition: acceptable; in an acceptable manner
example: Is the coffee all right?
definition_zh: 可接受;以可接受的方式
example_zh: 咖啡还好吗？

definition: used to check that somebody agrees or understands
example: We've got to get up early, all right?
definition_zh: 用于检查某人是否同意或理解
example_zh: 我们得早点起床，好吗？

definition: to let somebody/something do something; to let something happen or be done
example: allow somebody/something to do something, His parents won't allow him to stay out late.
definition_zh: 允许某人/某物做某事;让某事发生或被完成
example_zh: 允许某人或某事做点什么，他的父母不允许他晚归。

definition: not quite
example: I like almost all of them.
definition_zh: 还不完全是
example_zh: 我几乎都喜欢。

definition: without any other people
example: not alone in, Tom is not alone in finding Rick hard to work with.
definition_zh: 没有其他人
example_zh: 汤姆并不孤单，他并不孤单，觉得瑞克难以相处。

definition: without any other people
example: not alone in, Tom is not alone in finding Rick hard to work with.
definition_zh: 没有其他人
example_zh: 汤姆并不孤单，他并不孤单，觉得瑞克难以相处。

definition: forward
example: I was just walking along singing to myself.
definition_zh: 向前
example_zh: 我只是一边走一边自言自语地唱着歌。

definition: from one end to or towards the other end of something
example: They walked slowly along the road.
definition_zh: 从某物的一端到另一端或朝另一端走去
example_zh: 他们沿着路慢慢走着。

definition: before now or before a particular time in the past
example: ‘Lunch?’ ‘No thanks, I've already eaten.’
definition_zh: 在此之前或某个特定时间之前
example_zh: “午饭？”“不用了，谢谢，我已经吃过了。”

definition: a thing that you can choose to do or have out of two or more possibilities
example: The car is too expensive so we're trying to find a cheaper alternative.
definition_zh: 一种你可以在两种或更多可能性中选择去做或拥有的事情
example_zh: 这辆车太贵了，所以我们正在找更便宜的替代品。

definition: used for introducing a statement that makes the main statement in a sentence seem surprising
example: Although the sun was shining, it wasn't very warm.
definition_zh: 用于引入一个让句子中主语句显得令人惊讶的语句
example_zh: 虽然阳光明媚，但并不温暖。

definition: surrounded by somebody/something; in the middle of somebody/something
example: a house among the trees
definition_zh: 被某个人/某物包围;在某个人/某物的正中央
example_zh: 树林中的房子

definition: a quantity of something
example: I was amazed at the amount he could eat.
definition_zh: 某种数量
example_zh: 我对他能吃的量感到惊讶。

definition: belonging to a period of history that is thousands of years in the past
example: Archaeologists are excavating the ruined temples of this ancient civilization.
definition_zh: 属于数千年前的历史时期
example_zh: 考古学家正在发掘这个古文明的废墟神庙。

definition: the joint connecting the foot to the leg; the narrow part of the leg just above the ankle joint
example: to sprain/break/twist your ankle
definition_zh: 连接脚与腿的关节;腿部紧邻踝关节的狭窄部分
example_zh: 扭伤/骨折/扭伤脚踝

definition: used to emphasize an adjective or adverb in negative sentences or questions, meaning ‘at all’
example: He wasn't any good at French.
definition_zh: 用于强调否定句或疑问句中的形容词或副词，意为“完全”。
example_zh: 他法语一点也不好。

definition: often used at the end of negative sentences and at the end of questions, to mean ‘any longer’
example: She doesn't live here any more.
definition_zh: 常用于否定句末和提问句末，意为“再长”。
example_zh: 她已经不住这里了。

definition: used instead of somebody in negative sentences and in questions after if/whether, and after verbs such as prevent, forbid, avoid, etc.
example: Is there anybody who can help me?
definition_zh: 在否定句中代替 someone 使用，以及在 if/whether 之后以及 prevent 等动词之后使用 someone。
example_zh: 有人能帮我吗？

definition: used when adding something to support an idea or argument
example: It's too expensive and anyway the colour doesn't suit you.
definition_zh: 用于添加某项内容以支持某个观点或论证
example_zh: 太贵了，而且颜色也不适合你。

definition: used in negative sentences and in questions instead of somewhere
example: I can't see it anywhere.
definition_zh: 用于否定句和疑问句中，而不是某处
example_zh: 我哪儿都看不到它。

definition: used in negative sentences and in questions instead of somewhere
example: I don't have anywhere to stay.
definition_zh: 用于否定句和疑问句中，而不是某处
example_zh: 我没地方住。

definition: a piece of software that you can download to a device such as a smartphone or tablet, for example to look up information or to play a game
example: You first need to install the app on your device.
definition_zh: 一种你可以下载到智能手机或平板等设备上的软件，例如用于查询信息或玩游戏
example_zh: 首先你需要在设备上安装该应用。

definition: to start to be seen
example: Three days later a rash appeared.
definition_zh: 开始被看见
example_zh: 三天后出现了皮疹。

definition: the way that somebody/something looks on the outside; what somebody/something seems to be
example: the physical/outward/external appearance of something
definition_zh: 某人/某物在外表上的样子;某人/某物看起来是什么样子
example_zh: 某物的物理/外在/外观

definition: to make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a loan, permission for something, a place at a university, etc.
example: You should apply in person/by letter.
definition_zh: 提出正式请求，通常是书面的，比如工作、贷款、许可、大学名额等。
example_zh: 你应该亲自申请或通过信件申请。

definition: a person whose job is designing buildings
example: The house was designed by architect Louis Kahn.
definition_zh: 一个职业设计建筑的人
example_zh: 这座房子由建筑师路易斯·卡恩设计。

definition: the art and study of designing buildings
example: to study architecture
definition_zh: 建筑设计的艺术与研究
example_zh: 学习建筑

definition: to speak angrily to somebody because you disagree with them
example: My brothers are always arguing.
definition_zh: 因为你不同意别人的看法而愤怒地跟他们说话
example_zh: 我兄弟们总是吵架。

definition: a conversation or discussion in which two or more people disagree, often angrily
example: to win/lose an argument
definition_zh: 一种两个或多人意见不合的对话或讨论，往往是愤怒的
example_zh: 赢得或输掉一场辩论

definition: a large organized group of soldiers who are trained to fight on land
example: The two opposing armies faced each other across the battlefield.
definition_zh: 一支由接受陆地作战训练的大型有组织士兵队伍
example_zh: 两支敌军在战场上对峙。

definition: to plan or organize something in advance
example: arrange something, The party was arranged quickly.
definition_zh: 提前规划或组织某件事
example_zh: 安排点什么吧，派对很快就安排好了。

definition: a plan or preparation that you make so that something can happen
example: Travel and accommodation arrangements have been finalized.
definition_zh: 你制定的计划或准备，以便某件事发生
example_zh: 旅行和住宿安排已经敲定。

definition: used when you are comparing two people or things, or two situations
example: You're as tall as your father.
definition_zh: 当你比较两个人、两个事物或两个情境时
example_zh: 你和你爸爸一样高。

definition: while something else is happening
example: He sat watching her as she got ready.
definition_zh: 而与此同时，还有别的事情正在发生
example_zh: 他坐着看着她准备。

definition: sleeping
example: I waited until they were all fast asleep (= sleeping deeply).
definition_zh: 睡觉
example_zh: 我等到他们都睡得很熟（=睡得很沉）。

definition: having a rank below that of a senior person and helping them in their work
example: the assistant manager/director/commissioner
definition_zh: 在高层职位下，并协助他们工作
example_zh: 助理经理/主任/专员

definition: a person who helps or supports somebody, usually in their job
example: My assistant will now demonstrate the machine in action.
definition_zh: 指帮助或支持他人的人，通常是在工作中
example_zh: 我的助手现在将演示机器的实际操作。

definition: a person who competes in sports
example: Olympic athletes
definition_zh: 一个参加体育比赛的人
example_zh: 奥运运动员

definition: an act of using violence to try to hurt or kill somebody
example: Five people were killed in the attacks that took place last night.
definition_zh: 一种使用暴力试图伤害或杀害他人的行为
example_zh: 昨晚发生的袭击造成五人死亡。

definition: to use violence to try to hurt or kill somebody
example: Most dogs will not attack unless provoked.
definition_zh: 用暴力试图伤害或杀害某人
example_zh: 大多数狗除非被激怒，否则不会攻击。

definition: to be present at an event
example: We'd like as many people as possible to attend.
definition_zh: 出席活动
example_zh: 我们希望尽可能多的人能参加。

definition: used for asking people to listen to something that is being announced
example: Attention, please! Passengers for flight KL412 are requested to go to gate 21 immediately.
definition_zh: 用于邀请人们收听正在宣布的内容
example_zh: 请注意！KL412航班的乘客请立即前往21号登机口。

definition: the act of listening to, looking at or thinking about something/somebody carefully; interest that people show in somebody/something
example: the report’s attention to detail
definition_zh: 倾听、观察或仔细思考某事/某人;人们对某人/某事表现出的兴趣
example_zh: 报告对细节的关注

definition: pleasant to look at, especially in a sexual way
example: an attractive woman
definition_zh: 看起来很舒服，尤其是带有性意味的感觉
example_zh: 一位有吸引力的女人

definition: the group of people who have gathered to watch or listen to something (a play, concert, somebody speaking, etc.)
example: The audience was/were clapping for 10 minutes.
definition_zh: 那群人聚集在一起观看或聆听某件事（戏剧、音乐会、有人演讲等）
example_zh: 观众持续鼓掌了10分钟。

definition: a person who writes books or the person who wrote a particular book
example: Who is your favourite author?
definition_zh: 一个写书的人，或者写过某本特定书的人
example_zh: 你最喜欢的作家是谁？

definition: that you can get, buy or find
example: available resources/data
definition_zh: 你可以买到、买到或找到
example_zh: 可用资源/数据

definition: calculated by adding several amounts together, finding a total, and dividing the total by the number of amounts
example: The average age of participants was 52 years.
definition_zh: 通过将多个金额相加，找到总数，再将总数除以金额数来计算得出
example_zh: 参与者的平均年龄为52岁。

definition: the result of adding several amounts together, finding a total, and dividing the total by the number of amounts
example: The average of 4, 5 and 9 is 6.
definition_zh: 将多个金额相加，找到总额，并将总额除以金额数的结果
example_zh: 4、5、9的平均值是6。

definition: to prevent something bad from happening
example: avoid something, to avoid conflict/confrontation
definition_zh: 以防止发生不好的事
example_zh: 避免某些事情，以避免冲突或对抗

definition: a prize such as money, etc. for something that somebody has done
example: He was nominated for the best actor award.
definition_zh: 比如奖品，比如钱，等等，奖励某人做过的事
example_zh: 他曾获得最佳男演员提名。

definition: very bad or unpleasant
example: That's an awful colour.
definition_zh: 非常糟糕或令人不快
example_zh: 那颜色真糟糕。

definition: located behind or at the back of something
example: We were sitting in the back row
definition_zh: 位于某物的后方或后方
example_zh: 我们当时坐在后排

definition: the details of a person’s family, education, experience, etc.
example: somebody's ethnic/genetic/cultural background
definition_zh: 一个人的家庭细节、教育背景、经历等。
example_zh: 某人的族裔/遗传/文化背景

definition: without skill or care
example: to play/sing badly
definition_zh: 没有技巧或关心
example_zh: 弹奏/唱得很糟糕

definition: a place where you can buy and drink alcoholic and other drinks
example: We arranged to meet in a bar called the Flamingo.
definition_zh: 一个可以购买和饮用酒精饮料及其他饮品的地方
example_zh: 我们约好在一家叫“火烈鸟”的酒吧见面。

definition: a game played especially in the US by two teams of nine players, using a bat and ball. Each player tries to hit the ball and then run around four bases before the other team can return the ball.
example: a baseball bat/team/cap/fan/player/game
definition_zh: 一种特别在美国由两队各九名球员进行的游戏，使用球棒和球。每位球员都试图击球，然后在对方球队把球传回之前跑过四个垒。
example_zh: 棒球棒/球队/帽子/球迷/球员/游戏

definition: if one thing is based on another, it uses it or is developed from it
example: The movie is based on a real-life incident.
definition_zh: 如果一件事基于另一件事，它就会使用它，或者从中发展出来
example_zh: 这部电影基于一桩真实事件改编。

definition: a game played by two teams of five players, using a large ball which players try to throw into a high net hanging from a ring
example: a basketball game/coach/team/player
definition_zh: 一种由两队各五名玩家进行的游戏，使用一个大球，玩家试图将球投向悬挂在环上的高网中
example_zh: 一场篮球比赛/教练/球队/球员

definition: a seed, or pod containing seeds, of a climbing plant, eaten as a vegetable. There are several types of bean and the plants that they grow on are also called beans.
example: green beans
definition_zh: 一种攀缘植物的种子或荚内的种子，作为蔬菜食用。豆类有多种类型，它们生长的植物也被称为豆类。
example_zh: 四季豆

definition: a heavy wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws (= pointed parts on the ends of its feet). There are many types of bear.
example: a black bear
definition_zh: 一种体型庞大、毛发浓密且爪子锋利的野生动物。熊有许多种。
example_zh: 一只黑熊

definition: to defeat somebody in a game or competition
example: beat somebody at something, He beat me at chess.
definition_zh: 在游戏或比赛中击败某人
example_zh: 在某件事上打败了别人，他在国际象棋上也打败了我。

definition: meat that comes from a cow
example: roast beef
definition_zh: 来自牛的肉
example_zh: 烤牛肉

definition: at an earlier time; in the past; already
example: You should have told me so before.
definition_zh: 更早的时间;过去;已经
example_zh: 你早该告诉我。

definition: earlier than the time when
example: Do it before you forget.
definition_zh: 比
example_zh: 趁还没忘之前去做。

definition: to do things in a particular way
example: The doctor behaved very unprofessionally.
definition_zh: 以特定方式做事
example_zh: 医生的行为非常不专业。

definition: the way that somebody behaves, especially towards other people
example: good/bad behaviour
definition_zh: 一个人的行为方式，尤其是对别人
example_zh: 良好/不良行为

definition: to be in the right or suitable place
example: Where do these plates belong (= where are they kept)?
definition_zh: 要处于正确或合适的位置
example_zh: 这些盘子属于哪里（=它们存放在哪里）？

definition: a long narrow piece of leather, cloth, etc. that you wear around the middle part of your body
example: to do up/fasten/tighten a belt
definition_zh: 一条又长又窄的皮革、布料等，你穿在身体中段
example_zh: 系紧/系紧/系紧皮带

definition: an advantage that something gives you; a helpful and useful effect that something has
example: Freedom of information brings great benefits.
definition_zh: 某样东西给你带来的优势;某样东西带来的有益且有用的效果
example_zh: 信息自由带来了巨大的好处。

definition: most; to the greatest extent
example: Which one do you like best?
definition_zh: 大多数;在最大程度上
example_zh: 你最喜欢哪一个？

definition: the most excellent thing or person
example: We all want the best for our children.
definition_zh: 最优秀的事物或人
example_zh: 我们都希望孩子拥有最好的。

definition: in a more excellent or pleasant way; not as badly
example: She sings much better than I do.
definition_zh: 以一种更优秀或更愉快的方式;没那么糟
example_zh: 她唱歌比我好听多了。

definition: in the space or period of time separating two or more points, objects, etc. or two dates, events, etc.
example: The house was near a park but there was a road in between.
definition_zh: 在两个或多个点、物体等之间的时间或空间内，或者两个日期、事件等。
example_zh: 房子靠近一个公园，但中间有条路。

definition: 1 000 000 000; one thousand million
example: Worldwide sales reached 2.5 billion.
example_zh: 全球销售额达到25亿。

definition: a container that you put waste in
example: a rubbish bin
definition_zh: 一个用来装垃圾的容器
example_zh: 一个垃圾桶

definition: the scientific study of the life and structure of plants and animals
example: a degree in biology
definition_zh: 对植物和动物生命及结构的科学研究
example_zh: 生物学学位

definition: the time when a baby is born; the process of being born
example: at birth, The baby weighed three kilos at birth.
definition_zh: 婴儿出生的时间;出生的过程
example_zh: 出生时，婴儿体重为三公斤。

definition: a small flat dry cake for one person, usually sweet, and baked until hard
example: a packet/tin of chocolate biscuits
definition_zh: 一份小而扁的、干的蛋糕，通常为一人份，通常偏甜，烤到硬
example_zh: 一包/一罐巧克力饼干

definition: rather; to some extent
example: These trousers are a bit tight.
definition_zh: 相反地;在某种程度上
example_zh: 这条裤子有点紧。

definition: empty, with nothing written, printed or recorded on it
example: Sign your name in the blank space below.
definition_zh: 空无一物，上面没有任何文字、印刷或记录
example_zh: 请在下方空白处签名。

definition: an empty space on a printed form or document for you to write answers, information, etc. in
example: Please fill in the blanks.
definition_zh: 打印表单或文档上的空白处，供你填写答案、信息等
example_zh: 请填写空白。

definition: the red liquid that flows through the bodies of humans and animals
example: He lost a lot of blood in the accident.
definition_zh: 流经人类和动物体内的红色液体
example_zh: 他在事故中失血很多。

definition: to send out air from the mouth
example: + adv./prep., You're not blowing hard enough!
definition_zh: 从嘴里放出空气
example_zh: + 副词/介词，你吹得不够用力！

definition: a long thin piece of strong hard material, especially wood, used, for example, for making floors, building walls and roofs and making boats
example: He had ripped up the carpet, leaving only the bare boards.
definition_zh: 一块细长且坚硬的材料，尤其是木材，例如用于铺设地板、建造墙体和屋顶以及制作船只
example_zh: 他把地毯撕了一遍，只留下光秃秃的木板。

definition: when a liquid boils or when you boil it, it is heated to the point where it forms bubbles and turns to steam or vapour
example: The water was bubbling and boiling away.
definition_zh: 当液体沸腾或你煮沸时，它被加热到形成气泡，变成蒸汽或蒸气
example_zh: 水在沸腾、沸腾。

definition: any of the hard parts that form the skeleton of the body of a human or an animal
example: He survived the accident with no broken bones.
definition_zh: 构成人体或动物骨骼的任何坚硬部分
example_zh: 他在事故中幸存下来，没有骨折。

definition: to arrange to have or use something on a particular date in the future; to buy a ticket in advance
example: Book early to avoid disappointment.
definition_zh: 安排在未来某一天拥有或使用某项物品;提前购买机票
example_zh: 尽早预订以避免失望。

definition: to take and use something that belongs to somebody else, and return it to them at a later time
example: borrow something, Can I borrow your umbrella?
definition_zh: 取用属于别人的东西，然后在之后归还给他们
example_zh: 借点东西，我能借你的伞吗？

definition: a person who is in charge of other people at work and tells them what to do
example: I'll ask my boss if I can have the day off.
definition_zh: 一个在工作中负责别人、告诉他们该做什么的人
example_zh: 我会问问老板能不能请假一天。

definition: in the lowest, last or furthest place or position
example: your bottom lip
definition_zh: 在最低、最后或最远的位置或地点
example_zh: 你的下唇

definition: the lowest part of something
example: the bottom of the screen/stairs/hill
definition_zh: 某物最低层的部分
example_zh: 屏幕底部/楼梯/山坡

definition: a deep round dish with a wide open top, used especially for holding food or liquid
example: a salad/fruit/sugar bowl
definition_zh: 一种深而圆、顶部宽敞的盘子，特别用于盛载食物或液体
example_zh: 沙拉/水果/糖碗

definition: the organ inside the head that controls movement, thought, memory and feeling
example: The human brain is a complex organ.
definition_zh: 头部内部的器官，掌控运动、思维、记忆和感觉
example_zh: 人类大脑是一个复杂的器官。

definition: a structure that is built over a road, railway, river, etc. so that people, vehicles, etc. can cross from one side to the other
example: We crossed the bridge over the River Windrush.
definition_zh: 一种建在道路、铁路、河流等道路上方的结构，以便人员、车辆等能够从一侧通行到另一侧
example_zh: 我们穿过了温德拉什河上的桥。

definition: full of light; shining strongly
example: bright light/sunshine
definition_zh: 充满光芒;明亮耀眼
example_zh: 明亮的光线/阳光

definition: extremely clever or impressive
example: What a brilliant idea!
definition_zh: 极其聪明或令人印象深刻
example_zh: 多么绝妙的主意！

definition: that has been damaged or injured; no longer whole or working correctly
example: a broken window/plate
definition_zh: 已经受损或受伤;不再完整或正常工作
example_zh: 破碎的窗户/盘子

definition: an object made of short stiff hairs (called bristles) or wires set in a block of wood or plastic, usually attached to a handle. Brushes are used for many different jobs, such as cleaning, painting and tidying your hair.
example: a paintbrush
definition_zh: 由短而硬的毛（称为刷毛）或嵌入木块或塑料中的金属丝制成的物体，通常连接在手柄上。刷子用于许多不同的工作，比如清洁、涂漆和整理头发。
example_zh: 一把画笔

definition: to clean, polish or make something smooth with a brush
example: brush something, to brush your hair/teeth
definition_zh: 用刷子清洁、抛光或使物品光滑
example_zh: 刷点东西，用来刷头发/刷牙

definition: to produce flames and heat
example: A welcoming fire was burning in the fireplace.
definition_zh: 以产生火焰和热量
example_zh: 壁炉里燃着一团热情的火。

definition: a man who works in business, especially at a high level
example: a group of visiting Italian politicians and businessmen
definition_zh: 一个在商界工作的男人，尤其是在高层次工作
example_zh: 一群来访的意大利政治家和商人

definition: a small round piece of metal, plastic, etc. that is sewn onto a piece of clothing and used for fastening two parts together
example: (British English), to do up/undo your buttons
definition_zh: 一小块圆形金属、塑料等，缝在衣服上，用于将两部分固定在一起
example_zh: （英式英语），扣上/解开纽扣

definition: a place where people live temporarily in tents or temporary buildings
example: Let's return to camp.
definition_zh: 人们暂时住在帐篷或临时建筑中的地方
example_zh: 我们回营地吧。

definition: to put up a tent and live in it for a short time
example: I camped overnight in a field.
definition_zh: 搭个帐篷，短暂住进去
example_zh: 我在一片田野里露营过夜。

definition: living in a tent, etc. on holiday
example: Do you go camping?
definition_zh: 度假时住帐篷等
example_zh: 你会去露营吗？

definition: a metal container in which food and drink is sold
example: can of something, a can of beans/beer/soda
definition_zh: 一个金属容器，用来销售食物和饮料
example_zh: 一罐什么的，一罐豆子/啤酒/汽水

definition: the process of caring for somebody/something and providing what they need for their health or protection
example: Some people were badly injured and needed medical care.
definition_zh: 照顾某人或某物，并为其健康或保护提供所需物资的过程
example_zh: 有些人受了重伤，需要医疗救护。

definition: to feel that something is important and worth worrying about
example: I don't care (= I will not be upset) if I never see him again!
definition_zh: 让我觉得某件事很重要，值得担心
example_zh: 我不在乎（=我不会生气）就算再也见不到他！

definition: giving attention or thought to what you are doing so that you avoid hurting yourself, damaging something or doing something wrong
example: Be careful!
definition_zh: 关注或思考自己正在做的事情，以避免伤害自己、损坏东西或做错事
example_zh: 小心！

definition: with a lot of attention or thought, so that you avoid hurting yourself, damaging something or doing something wrong
example: Drive carefully.
definition_zh: 需要大量关注或思考，以避免伤害自己、损坏东西或做错事
example_zh: 开车小心。

definition: a piece of thick woven material made of wool, etc., used to cover the floor of a room or stairs; the material used for carpets
example: He spent the morning laying the new carpet.
definition_zh: 一块厚实的羊毛等编织材料，用于覆盖房间或楼梯的地板;用于地毯的材料
example_zh: 他花了整个上午铺设新地毯。

definition: a humorous drawing in a newspaper or magazine, especially one about politics or events in the news
example: a political/satirical cartoon
definition_zh: 报纸或杂志上的幽默画作，尤其是关于政治或新闻事件的画
example_zh: 一部政治/讽刺漫画

definition: a particular situation or a situation of a particular type
example: in… cases, In some cases people have had to wait several weeks for an appointment.
definition_zh: 特定情况或特定类型的情况
example_zh: 在......在某些情况下，人们甚至需要等待数周才能预约。

definition: money in the form of coins or notes
example: How much cash do you have on you?
definition_zh: 以硬币或纸币形式出现的货币
example_zh: 你身上有多少现金？

definition: a large strong building with thick, high walls and towers, built in the past by kings or queens, or other important people, to defend themselves against attack
example: a medieval castle
definition_zh: 一座坚固的建筑，墙壁厚重，塔楼高耸，过去由国王、女王或其他重要人物建造，用以抵御攻击
example_zh: 一座中世纪城堡

definition: to stop and hold a moving object or person, especially in your hands
example: She managed to catch the keys as they fell.
definition_zh: 停下来并握住移动的物体或人，尤其是用手握住
example_zh: 她设法接住掉落的钥匙。

definition: the person or thing that makes something happen
example: Unemployment is a major cause of poverty.
definition_zh: 那个让某件事发生的人或事
example_zh: 失业是贫困的主要原因之一。

definition: to make something happen, especially something bad or unpleasant; to make somebody do something
example: cause something, Do they know what caused the fire?
definition_zh: 让某件事发生，尤其是坏事或不愉快的事;让某人做某事
example_zh: 引发什么事，他们知道火灾的原因吗？

definition: to show that a day or an event is important by doing something special on it
example: Jake's passed his exams. We're going out to celebrate.
definition_zh: 通过在某一天或事件上做一些特别的事情来展示它的重要性
example_zh: 杰克通过了考试。我们要出去庆祝。

definition: a famous person
example: a celebrity chef
definition_zh: 一位名人
example_zh: 一位名厨

definition: strongly believing something; having no doubts
example: I think it was him, but I can't be certain.
definition_zh: 坚定地相信某件事;毫无怀疑
example_zh: 我觉得是他，但我不能确定。

definition: without doubt
example: Without treatment, she will almost certainly die.
definition_zh: 毫无疑问
example_zh: 如果不接受治疗，她几乎肯定会死亡。

definition: a possibility of something happening, especially something that you want
example: chance of doing something, She only has a slim chance of passing the exam.
definition_zh: 有可能发生某件事，尤其是你想要的事
example_zh: 做点什么的机会，她通过考试的机会微乎其微。

definition: a person or an animal in a book, play or film
example: the main character in the film
definition_zh: 书籍、戏剧或电影中的人物或动物
example_zh: 电影中的主角

definition: an organization for helping people in need
example: a registered charity
definition_zh: 一个帮助有需要人士的组织
example_zh: 注册慈善机构

definition: a friendly informal conversation
example: I just called in for a chat.
definition_zh: 一场友好的非正式对话
example_zh: 我只是打电话聊聊。

definition: to talk in a friendly, informal way to somebody
example: I'm sorry I can't stop to chat.
definition_zh: 以友好、随意的方式与某人交谈
example_zh: 很抱歉我没法停下来聊聊。

definition: an act of making sure that something is safe, correct or in good condition by examining it
example: Could you give the tyres a check?
definition_zh: 通过检查某样东西，确保其安全、正确或状况良好
example_zh: 能帮我检查一下轮胎吗？

definition: a person whose job is to cook, especially the most senior person in a restaurant, hotel, etc.
example: a new book by celebrity chef Jamie Oliver
definition_zh: 一个以烹饪为职业的人，尤指餐厅、酒店等场所中职位最高的厨师。
example_zh: 名厨杰米·奥利弗的新书

definition: the scientific study of the structure of substances, how they react when combined or in contact with one another, and how they behave under different conditions
example: a degree in chemistry
definition_zh: 对物质结构的科学研究，研究它们在组合或接触时的反应，以及在不同条件下的行为
example_zh: 化学学位

definition: a long thin piece of potato fried in oil or fat
example: He was eating a burger and chips.
definition_zh: 一块用油或油脂炸的细长土豆
example_zh: 他当时正在吃汉堡和薯条。

definition: an act of choosing between two or more possibilities; something that you can choose
example: We are faced with a difficult choice.
definition_zh: 一种在两种或多种可能性之间做出选择的行为;一种你可以选择的东西
example_zh: 我们面临一个艰难的选择。

definition: a building where Christians go to attend services, pray, etc.
example: The procession moved into the church.
definition_zh: 一栋基督徒去参加礼拜、祈祷等的建筑。
example_zh: 游行队伍进入教堂。

definition: a thin tube of paper filled with tobacco, for smoking
example: to smoke/have a cigarette
definition_zh: 一根装满烟草的细纸管，用于抽烟
example_zh: 抽烟/抽烟

definition: a completely round flat shape
example: the centre/circumference/radius/diameter of a circle
definition_zh: 完全圆形的扁平形状
example_zh: 圆的中心/周长/半径/直径

definition: to draw a circle around something
example: circle something, Luke circled a date on the kitchen calendar.
definition_zh: 用来在某物周围画一个圆圈
example_zh: 圈出什么东西，卢克在厨房日历上圈出了一个日期。

definition: relating to classical music
example: a classical composer/musician/pianist
definition_zh: 与古典音乐相关的内容
example_zh: 一位古典作曲家/音乐家/钢琴家

definition: easy to understand and not confusing
example: She gave me clear and precise directions.
definition_zh: 易于理解，也不令人困惑
example_zh: 她给了我清晰而准确的指导。

definition: in a way that is easy to see or hear
example: Please speak clearly after the tone.
definition_zh: 以一种容易看见或听见的方式
example_zh: 请在提示音后清晰地说话。

definition: quick at learning and understanding things
example: a clever child
definition_zh: 学习和理解迅速
example_zh: 一个聪明的孩子

definition: the regular pattern of weather conditions of a particular place
example: a tropical/warm/mild/temperate/cold climate
definition_zh: 某一特定地点天气条件的规律模式
example_zh: 热带/温暖/温和/温带/寒冷气候

definition: near in space or time
example: I had no idea the beach was so close.
definition_zh: 在空间或时间上接近
example_zh: 我完全不知道海滩离这里这么近。

definition: shut
example: Keep the door closed.
definition_zh: 关上
example_zh: 把门关好。

definition: clothes, especially a particular type of clothes
example: Workers at the factory wear protective clothing.
definition_zh: 衣服，尤其是某种特定类型的衣服
example_zh: 工厂工人穿着防护服。

definition: a grey or white mass that floats in the sky, made of very small drops of water
example: Dark clouds were gathering in the west.
definition_zh: 一团灰色或白色的物体漂浮在天空中，由极小的水滴组成
example_zh: 西侧乌云密布。

definition: a person who trains a person or team in sport
example: the head/assistant coach
definition_zh: 指训练个人或球队进行体育训练的人
example_zh: 主教练/助理教练

definition: the land next to or near to the sea or ocean
example: a trip to the coast
definition_zh: 靠近或靠近海洋或海洋的陆地
example_zh: 海边之旅

definition: a system of words, letters, numbers or symbols that represent a message or record information secretly or in a shorter form
example: to break/crack a code (= to understand and read the message)
definition_zh: 由词、字母、数字或符号组成的系统，用于秘密或简短地表示信息或记录信息
example_zh: 破解/破解密码（= 理解并读取消息）

definition: a person that you work with, especially in a profession or a business
example: work/senior/male colleagues
definition_zh: 你一起工作的人，尤其是在某个职业或企业中
example_zh: 工作/资深/男性同事

definition: to bring things together from different people or places
example: collect something, to collect data/evidence/information
definition_zh: 把来自不同人或地方的东西汇聚在一起
example_zh: 收集一些东西，以收集数据/证据/信息

definition: one of the straight sections from top to bottom into which text on a page or screen is divided
example: a dictionary with two columns per page
definition_zh: 页面或屏幕上文本从上到下划分为的直板部分之一
example_zh: 每页两列的词典

definition: a play, film or TV show that is intended to be funny, usually with a happy ending; plays, films and TV shows of this type
example: a romantic comedy
definition_zh: 旨在搞笑、通常以圆满结局为目的的戏剧、电影或电视节目;此类戏剧、电影和电视节目
example_zh: 一部浪漫喜剧

definition: making you feel physically relaxed; pleasant to wear, sit on, etc.
example: It's such a comfortable bed.
definition_zh: 让你感到身体放松;穿着、坐姿舒适等等。
example_zh: 这床真舒服。

definition: something that you say or write that gives an opinion on or explains somebody/something
example: comment on something, She made helpful comments on my work.
definition_zh: 你说或写的某些话，表达对某人/某事的看法或解释
example_zh: 评论一下，她对我的工作发表了有帮助的评论。

definition: to share or exchange information, news, ideas, feelings, etc.
example: We only communicate by email.
definition_zh: 用来分享或交换信息、新闻、想法、感受等。
example_zh: 我们只通过电子邮件进行沟通。

definition: all the people who live in a particular area, country, etc. when talked about as a group
example: The local community supported us from the start.
definition_zh: 当作为一个群体谈论时，所有居住在特定地区、国家等地区的人
example_zh: 当地社区从一开始就支持我们。

definition: to take part in a contest or game
example: The games were an outstanding success, with almost 2 400 athletes competing.
definition_zh: 参加比赛或游戏
example_zh: 比赛取得了巨大成功，近2,400名运动员参加了比赛。

definition: an event in which people compete with each other to find out who is the best at something
example: a design/an art/a talent competition
definition_zh: 这是一个人们相互竞争，以找出谁在某项领域最优秀的活动
example_zh: 设计/艺术/才艺比赛

definition: to say that you are annoyed, unhappy or not satisfied about somebody/something
example: She never complains, but she's obviously exhausted.
definition_zh: 说你对某人/某事感到烦躁、不开心或不满意
example_zh: 她从不抱怨，但显然已经筋疲力尽了。

definition: in every way possible; in every part
example: It was completely different from how I had imagined it.
definition_zh: 在一切可能的范围内;在每一部分
example_zh: 这和我想象的完全不同。

definition: the state that something is in
example: in… condition, to be in pristine/excellent/perfect condition
definition_zh: 某物所处的状态
example_zh: 处于......状态，保持完好/完美/完美

definition: a large official meeting, usually lasting for a few days, at which people with the same work or interests come together to discuss their views
example: The hotel is used for exhibitions, conferences and social events.
definition_zh: 一次大型官方会议，通常持续数天，志同道合或兴趣相同的人聚集在一起讨论观点
example_zh: 酒店用于举办展览、会议和社交活动。

definition: to join together two or more things; to be joined together
example: connect A and B, The towns are connected by train and bus services.
definition_zh: 将两个或多个事物结合起来;将两个或多个事物结合在一起
example_zh: 连接A和B，城镇之间有火车和公交服务相连。

definition: (of two or more things or people) having a link between them
example: We do not believe that the incidents are connected.
definition_zh: （两个或多个事物或人）之间有联系
example_zh: 我们不认为这些事件有关联。

definition: to think about something carefully, especially in order to make a decision
example: I'd like some time to consider.
definition_zh: 要认真思考某件事，尤其是在做出决定之前
example_zh: 我想要一些时间考虑。

definition: if something contains something else, it has that thing inside it or as part of it
example: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.
definition_zh: 如果某样东西包含了别的东西，它就包含了那个东西，或者作为其中的一部分
example_zh: 这款饮料不含酒精。

definition: the situation in which something happens and that helps you to understand it
example: Such databases are being used in a wide range of contexts.
definition_zh: 那种发生某件事并帮助你理解它的情境
example_zh: 此类数据库在多种情境中被广泛使用。

definition: one of the large land masses of the earth such as Europe, Asia or Africa
example: the continent of Africa
definition_zh: 地球上较大的陆地之一，如欧洲、亚洲或非洲
example_zh: 非洲大陆

definition: to keep existing or happening without stopping
example: If the current trend continues, that number will increase 165 per cent by 2050.
definition_zh: 让它持续存在或持续发生而不停止
example_zh: 如果当前趋势持续，到2050年这一数字将增长165%。

definition: the power to make decisions about how a country, an area, an organization, etc. is run
example: control of somebody/something, The party expects to gain control of the council in the next election.
definition_zh: 拥有对一个国家、地区、组织等运作方式作出决策的权力
example_zh: 控制某人/某物，该党预计将在下一次选举中掌控议会。

definition: to have power over a person, company, country, etc. so that you are able to decide what they must do or how it is run
example: By the age of 21 he controlled the company.
definition_zh: 对一个人、公司、国家等拥有权力，从而决定他们必须做什么、如何运作
example_zh: 21岁时，他已掌控公司。

definition: a person who cooks food or whose job is cooking
example: John is a very good cook (= he cooks well).
definition_zh: 一个做饭的人，或者其工作是做饭的人
example_zh: 约翰厨艺非常好（=他厨艺不错）。

definition: a large piece of equipment for cooking food, containing an oven and gas or electric rings on top
example: a gas cooker
definition_zh: 一台大型烹饪设备，内含烤箱和顶部的燃气或电环
example_zh: 燃气灶

definition: a thing that is made to be the same as something else, especially a document or a work of art
example: The thieves replaced the original painting with a copy.
definition_zh: 一种被设计成与其他事物相同的东西，尤其是一份文件或一件艺术作品
example_zh: 盗贼用复制品替换了原画。

definition: to make something that is exactly like something else
example: copy something, He taught himself by copying paintings in the Louvre.
definition_zh: 做出与另一种完全相同的东西
example_zh: “临摹某物”，他是通过临摹卢浮宫里的画作自学的。

definition: a part of something where two or more sides, lines or edges join
example: the four corners of a square
definition_zh: 物体中由两条或多条边、线条或边缘连接的部分
example_zh: 正方形的四个角落

definition: in a way that is accurate or true, without any mistakes
example: Have you spelled it correctly?
definition_zh: 以准确或真实、无任何错误的方式
example_zh: 你拼写正确了吗？

definition: to say numbers in the correct order
example: Billy can't count yet.
definition_zh: 按正确顺序说数字
example_zh: 比利还不会数。

definition: two people or things
example: I saw a couple of men get out.
definition_zh: 两个人或两个人
example_zh: 我看到有几个男人出来了。

definition: to place something over or in front of something in order to hide, protect or decorate it
example: cover something with something, Cover the chicken loosely with foil.
definition_zh: 将某物放在某物之上或前面，以隐藏、保护或装饰它
example_zh: 用东西盖上，用锡纸松松地把鸡盖住。

definition: not sensible; stupid
example: Are you crazy? We could get killed doing that.
definition_zh: 不讲理;愚蠢
example_zh: 你疯了吗？我们这么做可能会被杀。

definition: involving the use of skill and the imagination to produce something new or a work of art
example: a course on creative writing (= writing stories, plays and poems)
definition_zh: 运用技巧和想象力来创造出新事物或艺术作品
example_zh: 一门创意写作课程（=写故事、戏剧和诗歌）

definition: an arrangement that you make, with a shop for example, to pay later for something you buy
example: to get credit
definition_zh: 比如你和商店达成的协议，之后为购买的东西付款
example_zh: 为了获得认可

definition: activities that involve breaking the law
example: This month's figures show an increase in violent crime.
definition_zh: 涉及违法的活动
example_zh: 本月的数据显示暴力犯罪有所上升。

definition: a person who commits a crime
example: a convicted criminal
definition_zh: 犯罪者
example_zh: 一名被定罪的罪犯

definition: a mark or an object formed by two lines crossing each other (X or +); the mark (X) is often used on paper to show something
example: I've put a cross on the map to show where the hotel is.
definition_zh: 标记或由两条交叉线条形成的物体（X或+）;标记（X）常用于纸张上展示某物
example_zh: 我在地图上画了一个十字，标示酒店的位置。

definition: to go across; to pass or stretch from one side to the other
example: As soon as traffic slowed down enough to safely cross, I started walking.
definition_zh: 穿越;从一侧延伸到另一侧
example_zh: 一旦交通缓慢到可以安全过马路，我就开始走路。

definition: a large number of people gathered together in a public place, for example in the streets or at a sports game
example: He pushed his way through the crowd.
definition_zh: 大量人群聚集在公共场所，比如街头或体育比赛现场
example_zh: 他挤过人群。

definition: having a lot of people or too many people
example: We made our way through the crowded streets.
definition_zh: 人太多，或者人太多
example_zh: 我们穿过拥挤的街道。

definition: to produce tears from your eyes because you are unhappy or hurt
example: It's all right. Don't cry.
definition_zh: 因为你不开心或受伤，眼里流泪
example_zh: 没事的。别哭。

definition: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves used for storing dishes, food, clothes, etc.
example: kitchen cupboards
definition_zh: 一件带有门和架子的家具，用来存放餐具、食物、衣物等。
example_zh: 厨房橱柜

definition: having a lot of curls or a curved shape
example: long curly hair
definition_zh: 卷发多或曲线型
example_zh: 长卷发

definition: a bicycle or motorcycle
example: He was riding his cycle home when he was hit by a lorry.
definition_zh: 自行车或摩托车
example_zh: 他当时骑自行车回家时被一辆卡车撞了。

definition: to ride a bicycle; to travel by bicycle
example: measures to encourage more people to cycle
definition_zh: 骑自行车;骑自行车旅行
example_zh: 鼓励更多人骑行的措施

definition: happening, done or produced every day
example: Many people still read a daily newspaper.
definition_zh: 每天都在发生、正在进行或制作
example_zh: 许多人仍然阅读每日报纸。

definition: the possibility of something happening that will injure, harm or kill somebody, or damage or destroy something
example: Danger! Keep Out!
definition_zh: 有可能发生某些事情，从而伤害、杀死某人，或者损坏、摧毁某物
example_zh: 危险！禁止进入！

definition: the lack of light in a place, especially because it is night
example: Are the children afraid of the dark?
definition_zh: 某处缺乏光线，尤其是因为现在是夜晚
example_zh: 孩子们害怕黑暗吗？

definition: facts or information, especially when examined and used to find out things or to make decisions
example: We collected publicly available data over a 10-day period.
definition_zh: 事实或信息，尤其是经过审查并用于了解或决策时
example_zh: 我们在10天内收集了公开数据。

definition: no longer alive
example: My mother's dead; she died in 2017.
definition_zh: 已不复活着
example_zh: 我母亲去世了;她在2017年去世。

definition: to give cards to each player in a game of cards
example: Whose turn is it to deal?
definition_zh: 在纸牌游戏中，给每位玩家发牌
example_zh: 轮到谁发牌了？

definition: used in expressions that show that you are surprised, upset, annoyed or worried
example: Oh dear! I think I've lost my purse!
definition_zh: 用于表达你感到惊讶、难过、恼火或担忧的表达
example_zh: 天哪！我想我丢了钱包！

definition: the fact of somebody dying or being killed
example: the anniversary of his wife’s death
definition_zh: 有人死亡或被杀的事实
example_zh: 他妻子去世的周年纪念日

definition: a choice or judgement that you make after thinking and talking about what is the best thing to do
example: I think I've made the right decision.
definition_zh: 这是你在思考并讨论什么才是最好的选择后做出的判断
example_zh: 我觉得我做了正确的决定。

definition: having a large distance from the top or surface to the bottom
example: a deep hole/well/river
definition_zh: 从顶部或表面到底部之间有较大的距离
example_zh: 一个深坑/井/河流

definition: a way of emphasizing that something is true and that there is no doubt about it
example: I definitely remember sending the letter.
definition_zh: 一种强调某件事真实且毫无疑问的方式
example_zh: 我确实记得寄出了那封信。

definition: a unit for measuring temperature
example: at… degrees, Water freezes at 32 degrees Fahrenheit (32°F) or zero/nought degrees Celsius (0°C).
definition_zh: 一种用于测量温度的装置
example_zh: 在......摄氏度时，水结冰温度为华氏32度（32°F），即摄氏零度/零度（0°C）。

definition: a person whose job is to take care of people’s teeth
example: to see/visit/consult your dentist
definition_zh: 一个工作是照顾别人牙齿的人
example_zh: 去看/去/咨询你的牙医

definition: a section of a large organization such as a government, business, university, etc.
example: department of something, the Department of Health
definition_zh: 大型组织的一个部门，比如政府、企业、大学等。
example_zh: 某某部门，卫生部

definition: according to
example: Starting salary varies from £26 000 to £30 500, depending on experience.
definition_zh: 根据
example_zh: 起薪根据经验不同，从26,000英镑到30,500英镑不等。

definition: a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand.
example: the Sahara Desert
definition_zh: 一大片水资源极少、植物稀少的土地。许多沙漠被沙覆盖。
example_zh: 撒哈拉沙漠

definition: a person whose job is to decide how things such as clothes, furniture, tools, etc. will look or work by making drawings, plans or patterns
example: one of the country's top fashion designers
definition_zh: 一个工作是通过绘制图纸、计划或图案来决定衣服、家具、工具等物品的外观或工作方式的人
example_zh: 全国顶尖时装设计师之一

definition: to damage something so badly that it no longer exists, works, etc.
example: The building was completely destroyed by fire.
definition_zh: 把某样东西损坏到不存在、不再工作等等。
example_zh: 建筑被大火彻底摧毁。

definition: a person, especially a police officer, whose job is to investigate crimes and catch criminals
example: a police/homicide/undercover detective
definition_zh: 一个人，尤其是警察，他的职责是调查犯罪和抓捕罪犯
example_zh: 警察/凶杀组/卧底侦探

definition: to gradually grow or become bigger, more advanced, stronger, etc.; to make something do this
example: From birth to age 5, a child's brain develops rapidly.
definition_zh: 逐渐成长或变得更大、更先进、更强大等等;让某样东西做到这一点
example_zh: 从出生到5岁，孩子的大脑发育迅速。

definition: an object or a piece of equipment that has been designed to do a particular job
example: a tracking/recording/listening device
definition_zh: 一个为执行特定任务而设计的对象或设备
example_zh: 追踪/录音/监听设备

definition: a book in which you can write down the experiences you have each day, your private thoughts, etc.
example: Do you keep a diary (= write one regularly)?
definition_zh: 一本可以把你每天经历的经历、私人想法等写下来的书。
example_zh: 你有写日记吗（=定期写）？

definition: in a different way from somebody/something
example: Boys and girls may behave differently.
definition_zh: 以不同于某人/某物的方式
example_zh: 男孩和女孩的行为可能不同。

definition: using a system of receiving and sending information as a series of the numbers one and zero, showing that an electronic signal is there or is not there
example: a digital camera
definition_zh: 使用由数字一和零组成的接收和发送信息系统，以显示电子信号是否存在
example_zh: 一台数码相机

definition: going in the straightest line between two places without stopping or changing direction
example: the most direct route
definition_zh: 在两个地点之间保持最直线，不停下来也不改变方向
example_zh: 最直接的路线

definition: the general position a person or thing moves or points towards
example: in the direction of something, They headed in the direction of the village.
definition_zh: 一个人或物体移动或指向的大致位置
example_zh: 朝着某个方向走去，他们朝村子的方向走去。

definition: one of a group of senior managers who run a company
example: a non-executive director
definition_zh: 公司管理层的成员之一
example_zh: 非执行董事

definition: if two people disagree or one person disagrees with another about something, they have a different opinion about it
example: Even friends disagree sometimes.
definition_zh: 如果两个人在某件事上意见不合，或者一个人和另一个人意见不合，他们对此的看法就不同了
example_zh: 即使是朋友有时也会意见不合。

definition: to become impossible to see
example: With that, Matt promptly disappeared.
definition_zh: 变得难以被看见
example_zh: 说完，马特立刻消失了。

definition: an unexpected event, such as a very bad accident, a flood or a fire, that kills a lot of people or causes a lot of damage
example: the world's worst humanitarian disaster
definition_zh: 突发事件，比如非常严重的事故、洪水或火灾，导致大量人员死亡或造成巨大损失
example_zh: 世界上最严重的人道主义灾难

definition: to be the first person to become aware that a particular place or thing exists
example: Cook is credited with discovering Hawaii.
definition_zh: 成为第一个意识到某个特定地方或事物存在的人
example_zh: 库克被认为是发现夏威夷的人。

definition: an act or the process of finding somebody/something, or learning about something that was not known about before
example: Researchers in this field have made some important new discoveries.
definition_zh: 一个行为、寻找某个人/某物的过程，或者了解一些以前不知道的事情
example_zh: 该领域的研究人员取得了一些重要的新发现。

definition: a conversation about somebody/something; the process of discussing somebody/something
example: I discovered something interesting during a family discussion.
definition_zh: 关于某人/某事的对话;讨论某人/某物的过程
example_zh: 我在一次家庭讨论中发现了一件有趣的事。

definition: an illness affecting humans, animals or plants, often caused by infection
example: heart/lung/liver disease
definition_zh: 一种影响人类、动物或植物的疾病，通常由感染引起
example_zh: 心脏/肺/肝疾病

definition: the amount of space between two places or things
example: a short/long distance
definition_zh: 两个地方或物体之间的距离
example_zh: 短距离/长距离

definition: no longer married because your marriage has been legally ended
example: My parents are divorced.
definition_zh: 因为你的婚姻已经在法律上结束，所以不再结婚
example_zh: 我父母离婚了。

definition: an official paper, book or electronic file that gives information about something, or that can be used as evidence or proof of something
example: Please read and sign the attached document.
definition_zh: 一份官方文件、书籍或电子文件，提供有关某事的信息，或可作为某事的证据或证明
example_zh: 请阅读并签署随附文件。

definition: twice as much or as many as usual
example: a double helping
definition_zh: 比平时多一倍或多一倍
example_zh: 双份

definition: twice as much or as many as
example: His income is double hers.
definition_zh: 两倍或等于的数量
example_zh: 他的收入是她的两倍。

definition: a number or amount that is twice as much or as many as another number or amount
example: He gets paid double for doing the same job I do.
definition_zh: 一个比另一个数字或金额多一倍或多的数字或金额
example_zh: 他做和我一样的工作，拿的是双倍工资。

definition: to become, or make something become, twice as much or as many
example: Membership almost doubled in two years.
definition_zh: 成为或让某样东西成为两倍、同样多的数量
example_zh: 两年内会员人数几乎翻了一番。

definition: data that is downloaded from another computer system
example: A staggering 99.8 % of digital music downloads are to mobile handsets.
definition_zh: 从另一台计算机系统下载的数据
example_zh: 惊人的数字音乐下载占 99.8% 的移动端。

definition: to get data from another computer, usually using the internet
example: download something, to download files/music/software
definition_zh: 从另一台计算机获取数据，通常通过互联网
example_zh: 下载某个东西，以下载文件/音乐/软件

definition: on a floor of a house or building lower than the one you are on, especially the one at ground level
example: a downstairs bathroom
definition_zh: 在你所在的房子或建筑物的一层，尤其是地面层的那层楼上
example_zh: 一楼浴室

definition: a play for the theatre, television or radio
example: a costume/period/courtroom/crime drama
definition_zh: 一部为戏剧、电视或广播而作的戏剧
example_zh: 服装/时代/法庭/犯罪剧

definition: a picture made using a pencil or pen rather than paint
example: a pencil/pen-and-ink/charcoal drawing
definition_zh: 用铅笔或钢笔而非颜料绘制的图片
example_zh: 一幅铅笔/钢笔/炭笔画

definition: a series of images, events and feelings that happen in your mind while you are asleep
example: I had a really weird dream last night.
definition_zh: 一系列在你睡梦中脑海中出现的画面、事件和感受
example_zh: 我昨晚做了一个非常奇怪的梦。

definition: to experience a series of images, events and feelings in your mind while you are asleep
example: Did I talk in my sleep? I must have been dreaming.
definition_zh: 在你睡觉时，在脑海中体验一系列的画面、事件和感受
example_zh: 我睡梦时说话了吗？我一定是在做梦。

definition: a journey in a car or other vehicle
example: Let's go for a drive.
definition_zh: 乘坐汽车或其他车辆的旅程
example_zh: 我们去兜风吧。

definition: the way that somebody drives a vehicle; the act of driving
example: She was convicted of dangerous driving.
definition_zh: 某人驾驶车辆的方式;驾驶行为
example_zh: 她被判危险驾驶罪。

definition: to allow something to fall by accident; to fall by accident
example: drop something, Be careful not to drop that plate.
definition_zh: 允许某物偶然坠落;意外坠落
example_zh: 掉点东西，小心别掉盘子。

definition: an illegal substance that some people smoke, inject, etc. for the physical and mental effects it has
example: He does not smoke or take drugs.
definition_zh: 这是一种非法物质，有些人会吸食、注射等，以引起身体和心理的影响
example_zh: 他不抽烟也不吸毒。

definition: not wet or sticky; without water or moisture
example: Is my shirt dry yet?
definition_zh: 不湿也不黏;无水或湿气
example_zh: 我的衬衫干了吗？

definition: to become dry; to make something dry
example: He did the laundry and hung it out to dry.
definition_zh: 变得干燥;让某物变得干燥
example_zh: 他洗完衣服晾了晾干。

definition: to get money for work that you do
example: earn (something), He earns about $40 000 a year.
definition_zh: 通过工作赚钱
example_zh: 赚取（某物），他一年大约赚4万美元。

definition: the world; the planet that we live on
example: the planet Earth
definition_zh: 这个世界;我们生活的星球
example_zh: 地球

definition: without problems or difficulty
example: The museum is easily accessible by car.
definition_zh: 毫无问题或困难
example_zh: 博物馆可驾车轻松抵达。

definition: a process of teaching, training and learning, especially in schools, colleges or universities, to improve knowledge and develop skills
example: primary/elementary education
definition_zh: 一个教学、培训和学习的过程，尤其是在学校、学院或大学中，旨在提升知识和发展技能
example_zh: 小学/小学教育

definition: a change that somebody/something causes in somebody/something else; a result
example: the beneficial effects of exercise
definition_zh: 某人/某物在某人/某物身上引起的变化;一个结果
example_zh: 锻炼的有益效果

definition: used after negative phrases to state that a feeling or situation is similar to one already mentioned
example: Pete can't go and I can't either.
definition_zh: 用于置于否定短语之后，表示某种情绪或情境与前述情境相似
example_zh: 皮特不能去，我也不能。

definition: one or the other of two; it does not matter which
example: You can park on either side of the street.
definition_zh: 两者之一;无论哪一种都无所谓
example_zh: 你可以把车停在街道的任一侧。

definition: one or the other of two; it does not matter which
example: You can park on either side of the street.
definition_zh: 两者之一;无论哪一种都无所谓
example_zh: 你可以把车停在街道的任一侧。

definition: connected with electricity; using, produced by or producing electricity
example: an electric car/vehicle
definition_zh: 与电力相连;使用、由电力生产或生产电力
example_zh: 电动汽车/电动汽车

definition: connected with electricity; using or producing electricity
example: an electrical fault in the engine
definition_zh: 与电力相连;使用或生产电力
example_zh: 发动机电气故障

definition: a form of energy from charged elementary particles, usually supplied as electric current through cables, wires, etc. for lighting, heating, driving machines, etc.
example: materials that conduct electricity
definition_zh: 一种由带电基本粒子产生的能量形式，通常通过电缆、导线等以电流形式提供，用于照明、供暖、驱动机械等。
example_zh: 导电材料

definition: having or using many small parts, such as microchips, that control and direct a small electric current
example: Airline passengers no longer have to turn off all electronic devices while on the plane.
definition_zh: 拥有或使用许多微型芯片等小部件，用于控制和引导微小电流
example_zh: 航空乘客在飞机上不再需要关闭所有电子设备。

definition: to give somebody a job to do for payment
example: employ somebody, How many people does the company employ?
definition_zh: 给别人一份工作以换取报酬
example_zh: 雇佣某人，公司雇了多少人？

definition: a person who is paid to work for somebody
example: The firm has over 500 employees.
definition_zh: 一个受雇为某人工作的人
example_zh: 公司拥有500多名员工。

definition: a person or company that pays people to work for them
example: They're very good employers (= they treat the people that work for them well).
definition_zh: 一个付钱请人为他们工作的个人或公司
example_zh: 他们是非常好的雇主（=他们对待为他们工作的人很好）。

definition: with no people or things inside
example: an empty box/glass/bottle
definition_zh: 里面没有人，也没有东西
example_zh: 一个空盒子/玻璃/瓶子

definition: the last part of a story, film, etc.
example: His stories usually have a happy ending.
definition_zh: 故事、电影等的最后一部分。
example_zh: 他的故事通常都有一个圆满的结局。

definition: the strength, effort and enthusiasm required for physical or mental activity, work, etc.
example: It's a waste of time and energy.
definition_zh: 身体或精神活动、工作等所需的力量、努力和热情。
example_zh: 这完全是浪费时间和精力。

definition: the part of a vehicle that produces power to make the vehicle move
example: a diesel/petrol engine
definition_zh: 车辆中产生动力以驱动车辆前进的部分
example_zh: 柴油/汽油发动机

definition: a person whose job involves designing and building engines, machines, roads, bridges, etc.
example: We worked with a team of scientists and engineers.
definition_zh: 一个工作内容涉及设计和制造发动机、机器、道路、桥梁等的人。
example_zh: 我们与一支科学家和工程师团队合作。

definition: extremely large
example: an enormous house/dog
definition_zh: 极其庞大
example_zh: 一栋巨大的房子/狗

definition: to come or go into something
example: Knock before you enter.
definition_zh: 进入或进入某物
example_zh: 进来前先敲门。

definition: the natural world in which people, animals and plants live
example: The government should do more to protect the environment.
definition_zh: 人类、动物和植物生活的自然世界
example_zh: 政府应当做更多保护环境的工作。

definition: the things that are needed for a particular purpose or activity
example: a useful piece of equipment for the kitchen
definition_zh: 为特定目的或活动所必需的物品
example_zh: 厨房实用设备

definition: a mistake, especially one that causes problems or affects the result of something
example: spelling/typographical/grammatical errors
definition_zh: 一个错误，尤其是导致问题或影响某事结果的错误
example_zh: 拼写/排版/语法错误

definition: more with one person, thing, etc. than with others, or more in particular circumstances than in others
example: Teenagers are very fashion conscious, especially girls.
definition_zh: 对某一个人、某件事等的关系比对其他人更严重，或者在特定情况下比在其他情况下更严重
example_zh: 青少年非常注重时尚，尤其是女孩。

definition: a short piece of writing by a student as part of a course of study
example: I have to write an essay this weekend.
definition_zh: 学生作为学习课程的一部分写下的一篇短文
example_zh: 我这个周末得写一篇论文。

definition: used or happening every day or regularly; ordinary
example: Change is a part of everyday life in business.
definition_zh: 每天或定期使用或发生;普通
example_zh: 变化是商业日常生活的一部分。

definition: in, to or at every place; all places
example: I've looked everywhere.
definition_zh: 在每个地方、前往或在每个地方;所有地点
example_zh: 我到处找过。

definition: the facts, signs or objects that make you believe that something is true
example: evidence (of something), Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.
definition_zh: 那些让你相信某事是真实的事实、迹象或物体
example_zh: 证据（某种证据），研究人员发现了暴露于太阳与皮肤癌之间存在明确的科学证据。

definition: correct in every detail
example: The new palace is an exact replica of the original building.
definition_zh: 每一个细节都正确
example_zh: 新宫殿是原建筑的精确复制品。

definition: used to emphasize that something is correct in every way or in every detail
example: It's exactly nine o'clock.
definition_zh: 用来强调某件事在各方面或每个细节上都是正确的
example_zh: 现在正好九点。

definition: extremely good
example: an excellent book/article
definition_zh: 极好
example_zh: 一本出色的书籍/文章

definition: used before you mention the only thing or person about which a statement is not true
example: We work every day except Sunday.
definition_zh: 在你提到唯一关于某句话不真实的事物或人物之前使用
example_zh: 我们除了周日外每天都在工作。

definition: to be real; to be present in a place or situation
example: Does life exist on other planets?
definition_zh: 真实存在;在某个地方或情境中存在
example_zh: 其他星球上是否存在生命？

definition: to think or believe that something will happen or that somebody will do something
example: expect something, The company is expecting record sales this year.
definition_zh: 去想或相信某件事会发生，或者有人会做某件事
example_zh: 期待点什么，公司预计今年销量将创纪录。

definition: the knowledge and skill that you have gained through doing something for a period of time; the process of gaining this
example: My lack of practical experience was a disadvantage.
definition_zh: 你通过一段时间做某件事所获得的知识和技能;获得这些的过程
example_zh: 我缺乏实际经验是个劣势。

definition: a scientific test that is done in order to study what happens and to gain new knowledge
example: to do/perform/conduct an experiment
definition_zh: 一种科学测试，旨在研究发生了什么并获得新知识
example_zh: 进行/执行/进行实验

definition: done with, having or involving great knowledge or skill
example: to seek expert advice
definition_zh: 拥有、拥有或涉及高超知识或技能
example_zh: 寻求专家建议

definition: a person with special knowledge, skill or training in something
example: a legal/security/medical/computer expert
definition_zh: 一个在某方面拥有特殊知识、技能或训练的人
example_zh: 法律/安全/医疗/计算机专家

definition: a statement, fact, or situation that tells you why something happened; a reason given for something
example: The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed.
definition_zh: 一种陈述、事实或情境，告诉你某件事发生的原因;给出某事的理由
example_zh: 最可能的解释是他的飞机延误了。

definition: to show or make known a feeling, an opinion, etc. by words, looks or actions
example: express something, Teachers have expressed concern about the changes.
definition_zh: 通过言语、眼神或行为表达或表达某种感受、观点等
example_zh: 表达一些意见，老师们对这些变化表示担忧。

definition: a word or phrase
example: What's the meaning of the expression ‘on cloud nine’?
definition_zh: 一个单词或短语
example_zh: “在云端”这句话是什么意思？

definition: very great in degree
example: We are working under extreme pressure at the moment.
definition_zh: 学位非常出色
example_zh: 我们目前正承受极大压力。

definition: to a very high degree
example: It is extremely important to follow the directions exactly.
definition_zh: 在非常高的程度上
example_zh: 严格按照说明操作非常重要。

definition: one of several things that cause or influence something
example: Obesity is a major risk factor for heart disease.
definition_zh: 其中一种是导致或影响某件事的几个因素之一
example_zh: 肥胖是心脏病的主要风险因素。

definition: a building or group of buildings where goods are made, mainly by machine
example: a car factory
definition_zh: 一栋建筑或一组建筑物，主要通过机器制造货物
example_zh: 汽车工厂

definition: to not be successful in achieving something
example: Many diets fail because they are boring.
definition_zh: 未能成功实现某项成就
example_zh: 许多减肥失败是因为它们无聊。

definition: acceptable and appropriate in a particular situation
example: a fair deal/wage/price
definition_zh: 在特定情况下是可接受且适当的
example_zh: 公平的交易/工资/价格

definition: an act of falling
example: I had a bad fall and broke my arm.
definition_zh: 坠落的行为
example_zh: 我摔得很重，摔断了胳膊。

definition: a person who admires somebody/something or enjoys watching or listening to somebody/something very much
example: sports/music fans
definition_zh: 一个非常欣赏某人/某物，或者非常喜欢观看或聆听某人/某物的人
example_zh: 体育/音乐爱好者

definition: to use land for growing crops and/or keeping animals
example: The family has farmed in Kent for over two hundred years.
definition_zh: 用于种植农作物和/或饲养动物的土地
example_zh: 这个家族在肯特郡务农已有两百多年。

definition: the business of managing or working on a farm
example: to take up farming
definition_zh: 经营或在农场工作
example_zh: 开始务农

definition: a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time or place; the state of being popular
example: the latest fashion trends
definition_zh: 在特定时间或地点流行的服装、发型等风格;受欢迎的状态
example_zh: 最新时尚趋势

definition: a white or yellow substance in the bodies of animals and humans, stored under the skin
example: excess body fat
definition_zh: 一种白色或黄色的物质，存在于动物和人体体内，储存在皮肤之下
example_zh: 过多的体脂

definition: the bad feeling that you have when you are in danger or when a particular thing frightens you
example: Her eyes showed no fear.
definition_zh: 当你处于危险之中，或者某件特定的事情让你害怕时，你会有那种不好的预感
example_zh: 她的眼神没有任何恐惧。

definition: something important, interesting or typical of a place or thing
example: An interesting feature of the city is the old market.
definition_zh: 一些重要、有趣或典型的事物
example_zh: 这座城市的一个有趣特色是老市场。

definition: to give food to a person or an animal
example: feed somebody/something/yourself, Have you fed the cat yet?
definition_zh: 给人或动物提供食物
example_zh: 喂别人/某物/你自己，喂猫了吗？

definition: being a woman or a girl
example: a female student/employee/artist/athlete
definition_zh: 是女人或女孩的；女性的
example_zh: 一位女性学生/员工/艺术家/运动员

definition: an animal that can lay eggs or give birth to babies; a plant that can produce fruit
example: One adult female can lay 400 to 500 eggs.
definition_zh: 一种能产卵或分娩幼崽的动物;一种能结果的植物
example_zh: 一只成年雌性可产下400至500枚卵。

definition: a type of literature that describes imaginary people and events, not real ones
example: a work of popular fiction
definition_zh: 这是一种描述虚构人物和事件的文学类型，而非真实人物
example_zh: 一部通俗小说作品

definition: an area of land in the country used for growing crops or keeping animals in, usually surrounded by a fence, etc.
example: We had to walk across a ploughed field.
definition_zh: 指国内用于种植农作物或饲养动物的土地，通常被围栏等围住。
example_zh: 我们不得不穿越一片耕过的田地。

definition: a struggle against somebody/something using physical force
example: a street/gang fight
definition_zh: 与某人/某物使用武力的斗争
example_zh: 一场街头/帮派斗殴

definition: to take part in a war or battle against an enemy
example: soldiers trained to fight
definition_zh: 参加与敌人的战争或战斗
example_zh: 受过战斗训练的士兵

definition: a number representing a particular amount, especially one given in official information
example: the latest sales/crime/unemployment figures
definition_zh: 代表特定金额的数字，尤其是官方信息中给出的金额
example_zh: 最新的销售/犯罪/失业数据

definition: to make a film of a story or a real event; to record somebody/something on film
example: They are filming in Moscow right now.
definition_zh: 将故事或真实事件拍摄成电影;将某人或某物记录在胶片上
example_zh: 他们现在正在莫斯科拍摄。

definition: the last of a series of games or competitions, in which the winner is decided
example: She reached the final of the 100m hurdles.
definition_zh: 这是一系列游戏或比赛中的最后一场，在这些比赛中决定胜负
example_zh: 她闯入了100米栏决赛。

definition: after a long time, especially when there has been some difficulty or delay
example: The performance finally started half an hour late.
definition_zh: 经过很长时间，尤其是遇到一些困难或延误时
example_zh: 演出终于晚了半小时才开始。

definition: one of the four long thin parts that stick out from the hand (or five, if the thumb is included)
example: She ran her fingers through her hair.
definition_zh: 伸出手掌的四条细长部分之一（如果包括拇指则是五个）
example_zh: 她用手指梳理头发。

definition: the last part or the end of something
example: It was a close finish as they had predicted.
definition_zh: 某件事的最后一部分或结束
example_zh: 正如他们预料的那样，比赛非常接近。

definition: the person or thing that comes or happens before all other similar people or things
example: I was the first in my family to go to college.
definition_zh: 那个出现在所有类似人或事之前的人或事
example_zh: 我是家里第一个上大学的人。

definition: used to introduce the first of a list of points you want to make in a speech or piece of writing
example: There are two reasons for this decision: firstly…
definition_zh: 用于介绍你在演讲或文章中想表达的观点清单中的第一点
example_zh: 做出这一决定有两个原因：首先......

definition: to try to catch fish with nets, a fishing line, etc.
example: The trawler was fishing off the coast of Iceland.
definition_zh: 尝试用渔网、钓鱼线等工具去捕鱼。
example_zh: 那艘拖网渔船当时在冰岛海岸附近捕鱼。

definition: the sport or business of catching fish
example: They often go fishing.
definition_zh: 捕鱼的运动或业务
example_zh: 他们经常去钓鱼。

definition: healthy and strong, especially because you do regular physical exercise
example: Top athletes have to be very fit.
definition_zh: 健康且强壮，尤其是因为你经常锻炼身体
example_zh: 顶尖运动员必须非常健康。

definition: to be the right shape and size for somebody/something
example: I tried the dress on but it didn't fit.
definition_zh: 为某人或某物打造合适的形状和尺寸
example_zh: 我试穿了这条裙子，但不合身。

definition: to repair or correct something
example: The car won't start—can you fix it?
definition_zh: 用于修复或纠正某些东西
example_zh: 车发动不了——你能修好吗？

definition: having a level surface, not curved or sloping, and without holes or any bits sticking out
example: low buildings with flat roofs
definition_zh: 表面平坦，不弯曲或倾斜，且无孔或任何突出部件
example_zh: 低矮且平顶的建筑

definition: a serious disease caused by a virus, that causes a high temperature, severe pains and weakness
example: The whole family has the flu.
definition_zh: 这是一种由病毒引起的严重疾病，会导致高烧、剧烈疼痛和虚弱
example_zh: 全家都得了流感。

definition: a small flying insect with two wings. There are many different types of fly and many of them spread disease.
example: A fly was buzzing against the window.
definition_zh: 一种有两只翅膀的小型飞行昆虫。苍蝇种类繁多，其中许多会传播疾病。
example_zh: 一只苍蝇在窗外嗡嗡飞舞。

definition: able to fly
example: flying insects
definition_zh: 能飞
example_zh: 飞行昆虫

definition: travelling in an aircraft
example: I'm terrified of flying.
definition_zh: 乘坐飞机旅行
example_zh: 我害怕坐飞机。

definition: the thing or person that people are most interested in; the act of paying special attention to something and making people interested in it
example: focus of something, It was the main focus of attention at the meeting.
definition_zh: 人们最感兴趣的事物或人物;对某事给予特别关注并引起人们兴趣的行为
example_zh: 某件事的焦点，那是会议上最主要的关注焦点。

definition: to give attention, effort, etc. to one particular subject, situation or person rather than another
example: She was distracted and finding it hard to focus.
definition_zh: 把注意力、精力等集中在某个特定主题、情境或人物上，而不是另一个
example_zh: 她心不在焉，难以集中注意力。

definition: that is/are going to be mentioned next
example: Answer the following questions.
definition_zh: 接下来会提到
example_zh: 请回答以下问题。

definition: in or from a country that is not your own
example: What foreign languages do you speak?
definition_zh: 在一个不是你本国的国家或来自
example_zh: 你会说哪些外语？

definition: a large area of land that is thickly covered with trees
example: a tropical/pine forest
definition_zh: 一大片被树木茂密覆盖的土地
example_zh: 热带/松林

definition: a tool with a handle and three or four sharp points (called prongs), used for picking up and eating food
example: to eat with a knife and fork
definition_zh: 一种带有手柄和三到四个尖齿的工具，用于拾取和食用食物
example_zh: 用刀叉吃饭

definition: very correct and suitable for official or important occasions
example: ladies in formal evening wear
definition_zh: 非常正确，适合官方或重要场合
example_zh: 穿着正式晚礼服的女士们

definition: by good luck
example: I was late, but fortunately the meeting hadn't started.
definition_zh: 祝你好运
example_zh: 我迟到了，但幸运的是会议还没开始。

definition: towards a place or position that is in front
example: She leaned forward and kissed him on the cheek.
definition_zh: 朝向前方的位置或位置
example_zh: 她俯身在他脸颊上轻轻一吻。

definition: without payment
example: Children under five travel free.
definition_zh: 无需付款
example_zh: 五岁以下儿童免费旅行。

definition: recently produced or picked and not frozen, dried or preserved in tins or cans
example: Is this milk fresh?
definition_zh: 近期生产或采摘，未冷冻、干燥或装罐保存的
example_zh: 这牛奶新鲜吗？

definition: a piece of electrical equipment in which food is kept cold so that it stays fresh
example: The kids tend to raid the fridge when they get home from school.
definition_zh: 一种用于冷藏食物以保持新鲜的电气设备
example_zh: 孩子们放学回家后通常会翻冰箱。

definition: a small animal with smooth skin, that lives both on land and in water (= is an amphibian). Frogs have very long back legs for jumping, and no tail.
example: the croaking of frogs
definition_zh: 一种皮肤光滑的小动物，既生活在陆地，也生活在水中（= 是两栖动物）。青蛙有非常长的后腿用于跳跃，且没有尾巴。
example_zh: 青蛙的呱呱叫声

definition: that you enjoy
example: She's really fun to be with.
definition_zh: 你喜欢的
example_zh: 和她在一起真的很有趣。

definition: objects that can be moved, such as tables, chairs and beds, that are put into a house or an office to make it suitable for living or working in
example: garden/office furniture
definition_zh: 可移动的物品，如桌椅和床，被放置在房屋或办公室中，使其适合居住或工作
example_zh: 花园/办公家具

definition: more; additional
example: Cook for a further 2 minutes.
definition_zh: 更多;附加
example_zh: 再煮2分钟。

definition: taking place or existing at a time after the present
example: The land will remain untouched for future generations to enjoy.
definition_zh: 发生或存在于现在之后的时间点
example_zh: 这片土地将保持原始，供后代享用。

definition: a room or building for showing works of art, especially to the public
example: a picture gallery
definition_zh: 一个用于向公众展示艺术品的房间或建筑
example_zh: 图片库

definition: a space where something is missing
example: Extra funding is needed to plug the gap.
definition_zh: 一个缺失了什么的空间
example_zh: 需要额外的资金来弥补这一缺口。

definition: any substance like air that is neither a solid nor a liquid, for example hydrogen or oxygen
example: Air is a mixture of gases.
definition_zh: 任何既非固体也非液体的物质，比如空气，比如氢或氧
example_zh: 空气是气体的混合物。

definition: a barrier like a door that is used to close an opening in a fence or a wall outside a building
example: the front/main gate
definition_zh: 一种屏障，比如用来封闭围栏或建筑物外墙壁开口的门
example_zh: 正门/主门

definition: affecting all or most people, places or things
example: books of general interest (= of interest to most people)
definition_zh: 影响所有或大多数人、地点或事物
example_zh: 一般性书籍（= 大多数人感兴趣）

definition: a thing that you give to somebody, especially on a special occasion or to say thank you
example: to give/receive a gift
definition_zh: 这是你送给别人的东西，尤其是在特殊场合或表达感谢时
example_zh: 赠送/接受礼物

definition: a frame with a net into which players must kick or hit the ball in order to score a point
example: He headed the ball into an open goal (= one that had nobody defending it).
definition_zh: 一格有网的棋子，球员必须踢或击球得分
example_zh: 他头球攻门，球进入空门（=无人防守的球门）。

definition: the being or spirit that is worshipped and is believed to have created the universe
example: Do you believe in God?
definition_zh: 被崇拜并被认为创造了宇宙的存在或灵魂
example_zh: 你相信上帝吗？

definition: bright yellow in colour, like gold
example: The company name was spelled out in gold letters.
definition_zh: 明亮的黄色，像金色一样
example_zh: 公司名称用金色字母拼写出来。

definition: a chemical element. Gold is a yellow precious metal used for making coins, jewellery, beautiful objects, etc.
example: gold coins/jewellery
definition_zh: 一种化学元素。黄金是一种黄色贵金属，用于制作硬币、珠宝、精美物品等。
example_zh: 金币/首饰

definition: a game played over a large area of ground using sticks with a special shape to hit a small hard ball (a golf ball) into a series of 9 or 18 holes, using as few shots as possible
example: I play golf every weekend.
definition_zh: 一种在大面积场地上进行的游戏，使用形状特殊形状的球杆，将一个小而硬的球（高尔夫球）击入一连串9洞或18洞，尽可能少的击球次数
example_zh: 我每个周末都打高尔夫。

definition: behaviour that is morally right or acceptable
example: Do they even know the difference between good and evil?
definition_zh: 道德上正确或可接受的行为
example_zh: 他们真的分辨善恶吗？

definition: the group of people who are responsible for controlling a country or a state
example: to lead/form a government
definition_zh: 负责控制一个国家或国家的人群体
example_zh: 领导/组建政府

definition: a common wild plant with narrow green leaves and stems that are eaten by cows, horses, sheep, etc.
example: a blade of grass
definition_zh: 一种常见的野生植物，叶片和茎条狭窄，被牛、马、绵羊等食用。
example_zh: 一片草叶

definition: to say hello to somebody or to welcome them
example: greet somebody, He greeted all the guests warmly as they arrived.
definition_zh: 向某人问好或欢迎他们
example_zh: “去问候某人吧。”他热情地迎接所有到来的客人。

definition: the solid surface of the earth
example: on the ground, I found her lying on the ground.
definition_zh: 地球的坚实表面
example_zh: 我发现她躺在地上。

definition: a person that you have invited to your house or to a particular event that you are paying for
example: They only use the dining room when they have guests.
definition_zh: 你邀请到你家或参加你付费举办的特定活动的人
example_zh: 他们只有在有客人时才会使用餐厅。

definition: a person who shows other people the way to a place, especially somebody employed to show tourists around interesting places
example: Our tour guide showed us around the old town.
definition_zh: 一个带别人去某个地方的人，尤其是那种受雇给游客带游客参观有趣地方的人
example_zh: 我们的导游带我们参观了老城区。

definition: to show somebody the way to a place, often by going with them; to show somebody a place that you know well
example: guide somebody, It's a dangerous route—you'll need someone to guide you.
definition_zh: 带别人去某个地方，通常是陪着他们去;带别人去你熟悉的地方
example_zh: 带路吧，那是条危险的路——你需要有人带路。

definition: a weapon that is used for firing bullets or shells
example: I have never fired a gun in my life.
definition_zh: 用于发射子弹或炮弹的武器
example_zh: 我这辈子从来没开过枪。

definition: a man
example: a big/little guy
definition_zh: 一个男人
example_zh: 一个大个子/一个小个子

definition: a thing that you do often and almost without thinking, especially something that is hard to stop doing
example: You need to change your eating habits.
definition_zh: 一件你经常、几乎不假思索地做的事情，尤其是那些很难停止的事情
example_zh: 你需要改变你的饮食习惯。

definition: to the extent of half
example: The glass was half full.
definition_zh: 以一半的程度
example_zh: 杯子里只有一半满。

definition: a space or passage inside the entrance or front door of a building
example: in a hall, Her brother was standing in the front hall.
definition_zh: 建筑物入口或正门内的空间或通道
example_zh: 在一个走廊里，她的哥哥站在前厅。

definition: in a cheerful way; with feelings of pleasure
example: children playing happily on the beach
definition_zh: 以一种愉快的方式;带着愉悦的感觉
example_zh: 孩子们在海滩上快乐地玩耍

definition: used with the past participle to form perfect tenses
example: I've finished my work.
definition_zh: 与过去分词一起使用，以形成完成时态
example_zh: 我已经完成了工作。

definition: a continuous pain in the head
example: He had a terrible headache.
definition_zh: 持续的头痛
example_zh: 他头痛得厉害。

definition: the organ in the chest that sends blood around the body, usually on the left in humans
example: The patient's heart stopped beating for a few seconds.
definition_zh: 胸部的器官，负责将血液输送到全身，通常在人类的左侧
example_zh: 患者的心脏停止跳动了几秒钟。

definition: the quality of being hot
example: Heat rises.
definition_zh: 性感的品质
example_zh: 热度上升。

definition: to make something hot or warm; to become hot or warm
example: heat (something), Heat the oil and add the onions.
definition_zh: 让某样东西变得热或热;让它变得热或热
example_zh: 加热（某种东西），把油加热，然后加入洋葱。

definition: weighing a lot; difficult to lift or move
example: a heavy weight/load
definition_zh: 体重很重;难以抬起或移动
example_zh: 重量/负载沉重

definition: the measurement of how tall a person or thing is
example: Height: 210 mm. Width: 57 mm. Length: 170 mm.
definition_zh: 测量一个人或一个物体的身高
example_zh: 高度：210 毫米。宽度：57 毫米。长度：170 毫米。

definition: able to improve a particular situation
example: helpful advice/information
definition_zh: 能够改善特定情况
example_zh: 有用的建议/信息

definition: a person who is admired by many people for doing something brave or good
example: a war hero (= somebody who was very brave during a war)
definition_zh: 一个因为做勇敢或做好事而受到许多人敬佩的人
example_zh: 战争英雄（= 在战争中非常勇敢的人）

definition: of or belonging to her
example: His eyes met hers.
definition_zh: 属于她或属于她
example_zh: 他的目光与她相遇。

definition: used when the woman or girl who performs an action is also affected by it
example: She hurt herself.
definition_zh: 当执行某项行为的女性或女孩也受到该行为的影响时，会使用。
example_zh: 她伤到了自己。

definition: to put or keep somebody/something in a place where they/it cannot be seen or found
example: hide somebody/something + adv./prep., He hid the letter in a drawer.
definition_zh: 将某人或某物放置在无法被看见或发现的地方
example_zh: 藏某人/某物 + 副词/介词，他把信藏在抽屉里。

definition: at or to a position or level that is a long way up from the ground or from the bottom
example: to climb/jump/leap high
definition_zh: 在离地面或底部很高的位置或高度
example_zh: 攀爬/跳跃/高跃

definition: an area of land that is higher than the land around it, but not as high as a mountain
example: a region of gently rolling hills
definition_zh: 一块比周围土地高，但又不像山那么高的土地
example_zh: 一片起伏缓缓的丘陵地区

definition: used when the man or boy who performs an action is also affected by it
example: He introduced himself.
definition_zh: 当执行某项行为的男子或男孩也受到该行为的影响时，会使用。
example_zh: 他自我介绍了一下。

definition: of or belonging to him
example: He took my hand in his.
definition_zh: 属于他或属于他
example_zh: 他握住了我的手。

definition: an act of hitting somebody/something with your hand or with an object held in your hand
example: Give it a good hit.
definition_zh: 用手或手中握着的物体击打某人/某物的行为
example_zh: 好好一吸。

definition: to bring your hand, or an object you are holding, against somebody/something quickly and with force
example: hit somebody/something, I was afraid he was going to hit me.
definition_zh: 快速且有力地将你的手或你握着的物体对准某人或某物
example_zh: 我怕他会打我。

definition: a game played on a field by two teams of 11 players, with curved sticks and a small hard ball. Teams try to hit the ball into the other team’s goal.
example: to play hockey
definition_zh: 一种在场地上由两队各11名球员进行的游戏，使用弯曲的球杆和一个小硬球。各队尝试将球击入对方球门。
example_zh: 打冰球

definition: to have somebody/something in your hand, arms, etc.
example: hold somebody/something, She was holding a large box.
definition_zh: 手里、手臂里有某个人/某物。
example_zh: 抱着某人/某物，她手里拿着一个大盒子。

definition: a hollow space in something solid or in the surface of something
example: He dug a deep hole in the garden.
definition_zh: 某种实体或某物表面上的空洞空间
example_zh: 他在花园里挖了一个深坑。

definition: connected with the place where you live
example: home life (= with your family)
definition_zh: 与你居住的地方相连
example_zh: 家庭生活（= 与家人）

definition: a feeling of wanting and expecting a particular thing to happen; something that you wish for
example: Don't lose hope—we'll find her.
definition_zh: 一种渴望并期待某件事发生的感觉;你所渴望的某件事
example_zh: 别失去希望——我们一定会找到她。

definition: extremely large in size or amount; great in degree
example: The sums of money involved are potentially huge.
definition_zh: 体积或数量极大;程度极佳
example_zh: 涉及的资金金额可能非常庞大。

definition: of or connected with people rather than animals, machines or gods
example: the human body/brain
definition_zh: 与人有关或与之相连，而非动物、机器或神明
example_zh: 人体/大脑

definition: a person rather than an animal or a machine
example: Dogs can hear much better than humans.
definition_zh: 是人，而不是动物或机器
example_zh: 狗的听力远比人类好。

definition: injured physically
example: None of the passengers were badly hurt.
definition_zh: 身体受伤
example_zh: 乘客均未受重伤。
