definition: to cause physical pain to somebody/yourself; to injure somebody/yourself
example: hurt something, He hurt his back playing squash.
definition_zh: 给某人/你自己造成身体上的痛苦;伤害某人/自己
example_zh: 受伤了，他打壁球时伤了背。

definition: perfect; most suitable
example: an ideal location/place
definition_zh: 完美;最合适
example_zh: 理想的位置/地点

definition: to recognize somebody/something and be able to say who or what they are
example: identify somebody/something, She was able to identify her attacker.
definition_zh: 识别某个人或某物，并能说出他们是谁或是什么
example_zh: 她确认了攻击她的人/某物。

definition: suffering from an illness or disease; not feeling well
example: Her father is seriously ill in St Luke's hospital.
definition_zh: 患有疾病或疾病;身体不适
example_zh: 她的父亲在圣卢克医院病得很重。

definition: the state of being physically or mentally ill
example: The virus can cause illness in humans.
definition_zh: 身体或精神疾病状态
example_zh: 这种病毒可以引发人类疾病。

definition: a picture, photograph or statue that represents somebody/something
example: Most simple leaflets will include text and images.
definition_zh: 代表某人/某物的图片、照片或雕像
example_zh: 大多数简单的宣传单都会包含文字和图片。

definition: without delay
example: She answered almost immediately.
definition_zh: 毫不拖延
example_zh: 她几乎立刻回答了。

definition: that cannot exist or be done; not possible
example: almost/virtually/nearly impossible
definition_zh: 不可能存在或实现;不可能
example_zh: 几乎/几乎/几乎不可能

definition: contained as part of something
example: all of Europe (Britain included)
definition_zh: 作为某物的一部分被包含
example_zh: 整个欧洲（包括英国）

definition: having something as part of a group or set
example: I've got three days' holiday including New Year's Day.
definition_zh: 将某物作为组或套装的一部分
example_zh: 我有三天假期，包括元旦。

definition: a rise in the amount, number or value of something
example: price/tax/wage increases
definition_zh: 某物的数量、数量或价值的增加
example_zh: 价格/税收/工资上涨

definition: to become greater in amount, number, value, etc.; to make something greater in amount, number, value, etc.
example: Costs have increased significantly.
definition_zh: 在数量、数量、价值等方面变得更大;在数量、数量、价值等方面创造更大的事物。
example_zh: 成本大幅增加。

definition: impossible or very difficult to believe
example: an incredible story
definition_zh: 不可能或极难相信
example_zh: 一个令人难以置信的故事

definition: having its own government
example: an independent state/nation/country
definition_zh: 拥有自己的政府
example_zh: 一个独立的国家/民族/国家

definition: considered separately rather than as part of a group
example: We interviewed each individual member of the community.
definition_zh: 单独考虑，而非作为群体的一部分
example_zh: 我们采访了社区中的每一位成员。

definition: a person considered separately rather than as part of a group
example: The competition is open to both teams and individuals.
definition_zh: 一个被单独考虑，而非作为群体一员的人
example_zh: 比赛对团队和个人均开放。

definition: the production of goods from raw materials, especially in factories
example: the needs of British industry
definition_zh: 原材料生产商品，尤其是在工厂中
example_zh: 英国工业的需求

definition: relaxed and friendly; not following strict rules of how to behave or do something
example: an informal atmosphere
definition_zh: 轻松友好;不遵循严格的行为规则
example_zh: 一种非正式的氛围

definition: harm done to a person’s or an animal’s body, for example in an accident
example: Two people sustained minor injuries.
definition_zh: 对个人或动物身体造成的伤害，例如在事故中
example_zh: 两人受了轻伤。

definition: any small creature with six legs and a body divided into three parts. Insects usually also have wings. Ants, bees and flies are all insects.
example: Most birds spend most of the day eating insects.
definition_zh: 任何有六条腿、身体分为三部分的小型生物。昆虫通常也有翅膀。蚂蚁、蜜蜂和苍蝇都是昆虫。
example_zh: 大多数鸟类白天大部分时间都在吃昆虫。

definition: forming the inner part of something; not on the outside
example: the inside pages of a newspaper
definition_zh: 构成某物的内部部分;而不是在外层
example_zh: 报纸内页

definition: on or to the inside
example: She shook it to make sure there was nothing inside.
definition_zh: 在内侧或在内侧
example_zh: 她摇了摇，确认里面什么都没有。

definition: the inner part, side or surface of something
example: The inside of the box was blue.
definition_zh: 物体的内部部分、侧面或表面
example_zh: 盒子的内部是蓝色的。

definition: on or to the inner part of something/somebody; within something/somebody
example: Go inside the house.
definition_zh: 在某物/某人的内部或内部;某物/某人内部
example_zh: 进屋去。

definition: in the place of somebody/something
example: Lee was ill so I went instead.
definition_zh: 代替某人/某物
example_zh: 李生病了，所以我代替了。

definition: detailed information on how to do or use something
example: Follow the instructions on the packet carefully.
definition_zh: 关于如何操作或使用某项东西的详细信息
example_zh: 请仔细按照包装上的说明操作。

definition: a person whose job is to teach somebody a practical skill or sport
example: a fitness/driving/ski instructor
definition_zh: 一个工作是教别人实用技能或运动的人
example_zh: 健身/驾驶/滑雪教练

definition: an object used for producing musical sounds, for example a piano or a drum
example: to play an instrument
definition_zh: 一种用于产生音乐声音的物体，例如钢琴或鼓
example_zh: 演奏乐器

definition: good at learning, understanding and thinking in a logical way about things; showing this ability
example: a highly intelligent child
definition_zh: 擅长学习、理解并以逻辑方式思考事物;展现出这一能力
example_zh: 一个极其聪明的孩子

definition: connected with or involving two or more countries
example: international trade/law
definition_zh: 与两个或多个国家相关或涉及的
example_zh: 国际贸易/法律

definition: the first part of a book or speech that gives a general idea of what is to follow
example: a book with an excellent introduction and notes
definition_zh: 书本或演讲的第一部分，概述接下来的内容
example_zh: 一本有出色导言和注释的书

definition: to produce or design something that has not existed before
example: Who invented the steam engine?
definition_zh: 生产或设计以前从未存在过的东西
example_zh: 谁发明了蒸汽机？

definition: a thing or an idea that has been invented
example: Fax machines were a wonderful invention at the time.
definition_zh: 一件被发明出来的事物或想法
example_zh: 传真机在当时是一项了不起的发明。

definition: a spoken or written request to somebody to do something or to go somewhere
example: to issue/extend an invitation
definition_zh: 对某人进行某事或前往某处的口头或书面请求
example_zh: 发出/发出邀请

definition: to ask somebody to come to a social event
example: invite somebody to something, Have you been invited to their party?
definition_zh: 邀请某人参加社交活动
example_zh: 邀请别人参加某个活动，你被邀请参加他们的派对了吗？

definition: if a situation, an event or an activity involves something, that thing is an important or necessary part or result of it
example: involve something, Any investment involves an element of risk.
definition_zh: 如果某个情境、事件或活动涉及某事，那件事就是其重要或必要的部分或结果
example_zh: 涉及某些东西，任何投资都涉及一定的风险。

definition: one thing on a list of things to buy, do, talk about, etc.
example: What's the next item on the agenda?
definition_zh: 清单上有一项要买、要做、要聊的事项。
example_zh: 议程上的下一个议题是什么？

definition: used when the animal or thing that does an action is also affected by it
example: The cat was washing itself.
definition_zh: 当执行某项动作的动物或物体也受到该行为的影响时，会使用。
example_zh: 猫正在洗澡。

definition: a thick sweet substance made by boiling fruit with sugar, often sold in jars and spread on bread
example: strawberry jam
definition_zh: 一种浓稠甜腻的物质，由水果与糖一起煮制成，常装瓶出售，涂在面包上
example_zh: 草莓酱

definition: a type of music with strong rhythms, in which the players often improvise (= make up the music as they are playing), originally created by African American musicians at the beginning of the 20th century
example: traditional/modern jazz
definition_zh: 这是一种节奏强烈的音乐类型，演奏者常常即兴演奏（=边演奏边即兴演奏），最初由非裔美国音乐家在20世纪初创作
example_zh: 传统/现代爵士

definition: objects such as rings and necklaces that people wear as decoration
example: silver/gold jewellery
definition_zh: 人们佩戴作为装饰的物品，如戒指和项链
example_zh: 银/金饰品

definition: something that you say or do to make people laugh, for example a funny story that you tell
example: I can't tell jokes.
definition_zh: 你说或做的事是为了逗别人笑，比如你讲的一个有趣的故事
example_zh: 我不会讲笑话。

definition: to say something to make people laugh; to tell a funny story
example: She was laughing and joking with the children.
definition_zh: 说点什么逗人笑;讲一个有趣的故事
example_zh: 她和孩子们笑着开玩笑。

definition: a person whose job is to collect and write news stories for newspapers, magazines, radio, television or online news sites
example: a freelance journalist
definition_zh: 一个工作是为报纸、杂志、广播、电视或在线新闻网站收集和撰写新闻报道的人
example_zh: 一名自由记者

definition: an act of jumping
example: to do a parachute jump
definition_zh: 跳跃的动作
example_zh: 跳伞

definition: to move quickly off the ground or away from a surface by pushing yourself with your legs and feet
example: ‘Quick, jump!’ he shouted.
definition_zh: 通过用腿和脚推自己，快速离开地面或远离地面
example_zh: “快，跳！”他喊道。

definition: a child or young person
example: Do you have any kids?
definition_zh: 一名儿童或青少年
example_zh: 你有孩子吗？

definition: to make somebody/something die
example: kill (somebody/something), Cancer kills thousands of people every year.
definition_zh: 让某人/某物死亡
example_zh: 杀死（某人/某物），癌症每年夺走成千上万的人命。

definition: the male ruler of an independent state that has a royal family
example: the kings and queens of England
definition_zh: 拥有王室家族的独立国家的男性统治者
example_zh: 英格兰的国王和王后

definition: the joint between the top and bottom parts of the leg where it bends in the middle
example: a knee injury
definition_zh: 腿部上下两部分之间的关节，即腿部中部弯曲处
example_zh: 膝盖受伤

definition: a sharp blade (= metal edge) with a handle, used for cutting or as a weapon
example: knives and forks
definition_zh: 一把带手柄的锋利刀片（=金属边缘），用于切割或作为武器
example_zh: 刀具和叉子

definition: to hit a door, etc. in order to attract attention
example: He knocked three times and waited.
definition_zh: 敲门等以吸引注意
example_zh: 他敲了三下门，然后等着。

definition: the information, understanding and skills that you gain through education or experience
example: scientific/technical knowledge and skills
definition_zh: 你通过教育或经验获得的信息、理解和技能
example_zh: 科学/技术知识与技能

definition: a laboratory
example: a computer/research lab
definition_zh: 实验室
example_zh: 计算机/研究实验室

definition: a word used to mean ‘woman’ that some people, especially older people, consider is more polite
example: There's a lady waiting to see you.
definition_zh: 这个用来表示“女人”的词，被一些人，尤其是年长者，认为更为礼貌
example_zh: 有位女士在等见你。

definition: a large area of water that is surrounded by land
example: in a lake, We swam in the lake.
definition_zh: 一大片被陆地包围的水域
example_zh: 在湖里，我们在湖里游泳。

definition: a device that uses electricity, oil or gas to produce light
example: a desk/bedside lamp
definition_zh: 一种利用电力、石油或天然气来发光的装置
example_zh: 书桌/床头灯

definition: to come down through the air onto the ground or another surface
example: The plane landed safely.
definition_zh: 通过空气落到地面或其他表面
example_zh: 飞机安全着陆。

definition: a small computer that can work with a battery and be easily carried
example: I opened my laptop and started typing.
definition_zh: 一台能使用电池且便携的小型电脑
example_zh: 我打开笔记本电脑开始打字。

definition: after anyone or anything else; at the end
example: He came last in the race.
definition_zh: 在任何人或任何事物之后;在最后
example_zh: 他在比赛中垫底。

definition: the person or thing that comes or happens after all other similar people or things
example: Sorry I'm late—am I the last?
definition_zh: 在所有类似的人或事之后出现或发生的人或事
example_zh: 抱歉我迟到了——我是最后一个吗？

definition: to continue for a particular period of time
example: Each game lasts about an hour.
definition_zh: 在特定时间内继续
example_zh: 每局游戏大约持续一小时。

definition: coming after something else or at a time in the future
example: Rembrandt's later works
definition_zh: 在其他事物之后或未来某个时刻到来的
example_zh: 伦勃朗后期作品

definition: the act or sound of laughing
example: to roar/howl with laughter
definition_zh: 笑声的行为或声音
example_zh: 带着笑声吼叫/嚎叫

definition: a rule that deals with a particular crime, agreement, etc.
example: to pass a law (= officially make it part of the system of laws)
definition_zh: 一条专门处理特定犯罪、协议等的规则。
example_zh: 通过法律（=将其正式纳入法律体系）

definition: a person who is trained and qualified to advise people about the law and to represent them in court, and to write legal documents
example: to hire a lawyer
definition_zh: 一名受过培训并具备资格，能够为人们提供法律建议、在法庭上代表他人，以及撰写法律文件的人
example_zh: 聘请律师

definition: unwilling to work or be active; doing as little as possible
example: He was not stupid, just lazy.
definition_zh: 不愿意工作或保持活跃;尽可能少做事
example_zh: 他不是傻，只是懒。

definition: to go with or in front of a person or an animal to show the way or to make them go in the right direction
example: If you lead, I'll follow.
definition_zh: 与人或动物同行或站在前面，指路或引导他们走正确的方向
example_zh: 你带路，我跟随。

definition: a person who leads a group of people, especially the head of a country, an organization, etc.
example: party/world leaders
definition_zh: 领导一群人的人，尤其是国家、组织等的领导人。
example_zh: 党/世界领导人

definition: the process of learning something
example: lifelong/adult learning
definition_zh: 学习某物的过程
example_zh: 终身/成人学习

definition: to the smallest degree
example: He always turns up just when you least expect him.
definition_zh: 仅仅在最小程度上
example_zh: 他总是在你最意想不到的时候出现。

definition: smallest in size, amount, degree, etc.
example: He's the best teacher, even though he has the least experience.
definition_zh: 最小的大小、数量、程度等。
example_zh: 他是最棒的老师，尽管经验最少。

definition: smallest in size, amount, degree, etc.
example: He's the best teacher, even though he has the least experience.
definition_zh: 最小的大小、数量、程度等。
example_zh: 他是最棒的老师，尽管经验最少。

definition: a talk that is given to a group of people to teach them about a particular subject, often as part of a university or college course
example: to go to/attend a lecture
definition_zh: 这是一场向一群人讲授特定主题的演讲，通常作为大学或学院课程的一部分
example_zh: 参加/参加讲座

definition: to give a talk or a series of talks to a group of people on a subject, especially as a way of teaching in a university or college
example: He has taught and lectured at the University of Pretoria.
definition_zh: 为一群人就某一主题做一场或一系列讲座，尤其是在大学或学院中作为教学方式
example_zh: 他曾在比勒陀利亚大学任教并讲学。

definition: a yellow citrus fruit with juice that has a bitter, sharp taste. Slices of lemon and lemon juice are used in cooking and drinks.
example: Add a squeeze of lemon juice.
definition_zh: 一种黄色柑橘类水果，汁液味道苦涩且辛辣。柠檬片和柠檬汁用于烹饪和饮品。
example_zh: 挤一点柠檬汁。

definition: to give something to somebody or allow them to use something that belongs to you, which they have to return to you later
example: lend something, They will lend equipment free of charge.
definition_zh: 把东西送给别人，或者允许他们使用属于你的物品，而他们必须事后归还给你
example_zh: 借点东西，他们会免费借设备。

definition: to a smaller degree; not so much
example: less expensive/likely/intelligent
definition_zh: 程度较小；没有那么多
example_zh: 较便宜/较不可能/较不聪明

definition: used with uncountable nouns to mean ‘a smaller amount of’
example: less something, less butter/time/importance
definition_zh: 与不可数名词一起使用，表示“较少的”。
example_zh: 少些什么，少一点黄油/时间/重要性

definition: used with uncountable nouns to mean ‘a smaller amount of’
example: less something, less butter/time/importance
definition_zh: 与不可数名词一起使用，表示“较少的”。
example_zh: 少些什么，少一点黄油/时间/重要性

definition: the height of something in relation to the ground or to what it used to be
example: The cables are buried one metre below ground level.
definition_zh: 某物相对于地面或它曾经的高度
example_zh: 电缆埋在地下一米处。

definition: the way in which a person or a group of people lives and works
example: Many people are trying to adopt a healthy lifestyle these days.
definition_zh: 一个人或一个群体的生活和工作方式
example_zh: 如今，许多人都在努力养成健康的生活方式。

definition: a machine that carries people or goods up and down to different levels in a building or a mine
example: It's on the sixth floor—let's take the lift.
definition_zh: 一种能将人或货物运送至建筑物或矿井不同层级的机器
example_zh: 在六楼——我们坐电梯吧。

definition: to raise somebody/something or be raised to a higher position or level
example: lift somebody/something, I lifted the lid of the box and peered in.
definition_zh: 提升某人/某物，或被提升到更高的位置或层级
example_zh: “抬起某人/什么东西”，我掀开箱盖往里看。

definition: to make something start to burn
example: She lit a candle.
definition_zh: 让某样东西开始燃烧
example_zh: 她点燃了一支蜡烛。

definition: having a good chance of happening or being something; probable or expected
example: the most likely explanation/outcome/scenario
definition_zh: 有很大机会发生或成为某种事情;很可能或预期
example_zh: 最可能的解释/结果/情景

definition: a connection between two or more people or things
example: link between A and B, Police suspect there may be a link between the two murders.
definition_zh: 两个或多个人或事物之间的联系
example_zh: 警方怀疑两起谋杀案之间可能存在关联。

definition: to make a physical or electronic connection between one object, machine, place, etc. and another
example: link A to B, The video cameras are linked to a powerful computer.
definition_zh: 在一个物体、机器、地点等之间建立物理或电子连接
example_zh: 连接A到B，摄像头连接到一台强大的计算机。

definition: a person who listens
example: a good listener (= somebody who you can rely on to listen with attention or sympathy)
definition_zh: 一个倾听的人
example_zh: 一个好倾听者（=你能依靠、愿意用注意力或同情倾听的人）

definition: to a small degree
example: She seemed a little afraid of going inside.
definition_zh: 在一定程度上
example_zh: 她似乎有点害怕进屋。

definition: a device that keeps a door, window, box, etc. shut, usually needing a key to open it
example: She turned the key in the lock.
definition_zh: 一种能让门、窗户、盒子等保持关闭的装置，通常需要钥匙才能打开
example_zh: 她转动钥匙打开锁孔。

definition: to fasten something with a lock; to be fastened with a lock
example: Did you lock the door?
definition_zh: 用锁固定某物;用锁固定
example_zh: 你锁门了吗？

definition: an act of looking at somebody/something
example: look at somebody/something, Here, have a look at this.
definition_zh: 看着某个人/某物的行为
example_zh: 看看某个人/某样东西，来，看看这个。

definition: a large vehicle for carrying heavy loads by road
example: a lorry driver
definition_zh: 一种用于公路运输重载的大型车辆
example_zh: 卡车司机

definition: unable to find your way; not knowing where you are
example: We always get lost in London.
definition_zh: 找不到方向;不知道自己身处何地
example_zh: 我们在伦敦总是迷路。

definition: making a lot of noise
example: loud laughter
definition_zh: 制造很大声响
example_zh: 大笑声

definition: in a way that makes a lot of noise or can be easily heard
example: Do you have to play that music so loud?
definition_zh: 以一种制造大量噪音或容易听见的方式
example_zh: 你非得把那音乐放得那么大声吗？

definition: in a way that makes a lot of noise
example: She screamed as loudly as she could.
definition_zh: 以一种制造巨大喧嚣的方式
example_zh: 她尽可能大声地尖叫。

definition: beautiful; attractive
example: She looked particularly lovely that night.
definition_zh: 美丽;有魅力
example_zh: 那晚她格外美丽。

definition: not high or tall; not far above the ground
example: a low wall/building/table
definition_zh: 不高也不高;离地面不远
example_zh: 一堵低矮的墙/建筑/桌子

definition: in or into a low position, not far above the ground
example: to crouch/bend low
definition_zh: 在一个低矮的位置，离地面不远
example_zh: 蹲低/低身

definition: good things that happen to you by chance, not because of your own efforts or abilities
example: with (any) luck, With any luck, we'll be home before dark.
definition_zh: 那些好事是偶然发生在你身上，而不是因为你自己的努力或能力
example_zh: 要是（好运气）的话，我们天黑前就能回家。

definition: having good luck
example: lucky to do something, His friend was killed and he knows he is lucky to be alive.
definition_zh: 运气不错
example_zh: 能做点什么已经算幸运了，他的朋友被杀了，他知道自己能活着是幸运。

definition: the official system used for sending and delivering letters, packages, etc.
example: a mail service/train/van
definition_zh: 用于发送和投递信件、包裹等的官方系统。
example_zh: 邮政服务/火车/面包车

definition: to send something to somebody using the postal system
example: mail something (to somebody/something), Don't forget to mail that letter to your mother.
definition_zh: 通过邮政系统向某人发送东西
example_zh: 寄点东西（给某人/某物），别忘了把那封信寄给妈。

definition: very large or important
example: a major road
definition_zh: 非常大或非常重要
example_zh: 一条主要道路

definition: being a man or boy
example: a male friend/colleague/partner
definition_zh: 是男性的，即男人或男孩
example_zh: 男性朋友/同事/伴侣

definition: a male person, animal or plant
example: The male of the species has a white tail.
definition_zh: 男性、动物或植物
example_zh: 该物种的雄性尾巴为白色。

definition: to control or be in charge of a business, a team, an organization, land, etc.
example: to manage a business/factory/bank/hotel/soccer team
definition_zh: 控制或掌控一个企业、一个团队、一个组织、一个土地等。
example_zh: 管理一支企业/工厂/银行/酒店/足球队

definition: a person who is in charge of running a business, a shop or a similar organization or part of one
example: a bank/hotel manager
definition_zh: 负责经营企业、商店或类似组织或其部分的人
example_zh: 银行/酒店经理

definition: behaviour that is considered to be polite in a particular society or culture
example: to have good/bad manners
definition_zh: 在特定社会或文化中被视为礼貌的行为
example_zh: 要有礼貌/坏礼貌

definition: a written or printed symbol that is used as a sign of something, for example the quality of something or who made or owns it
example: punctuation marks
definition_zh: 一种书面或印刷的符号，用作某种事物的标志，例如某物的质量、制作者或所有者
example_zh: 标点符号

definition: to write or draw a symbol, line, etc. on something in order to give information about it
example: mark something, The flood level is marked by a white line on the wall.
definition_zh: 在某物上写下或画出符号、线条等，以提供有关该物的信息
example_zh: 标记点什么，洪水水位用墙上的白线标示。

definition: to become the husband or wife of somebody; to get married to somebody
example: marry (somebody), She married a German.
definition_zh: 成为某人的丈夫或妻子;与某人结婚
example_zh: 嫁给（某人），她嫁给了一个德国人。

definition: a substance that things can be made from
example: building materials (= bricks, sand, glass, etc.)
definition_zh: 一种可以制造物品的物质
example_zh: 建筑材料（=砖块、沙子、玻璃等）

definition: the science of numbers and shapes. Branches of mathematics include arithmetic, algebra, geometry and trigonometry.
example: the school mathematics curriculum
definition_zh: 《数与形科学》。数学分支包括算术、代数、几何和三角学。
example_zh: 学校数学课程

definition: mathematics, especially as a subject in school
example: The core subjects are English, maths and science.
definition_zh: 数学，尤其是作为学校课程的一门学科
example_zh: 核心科目为英语、数学和科学。

definition: used (to ask) if somebody is upset, unhappy, etc. or if there is a problem
example: What's the matter? Is there something wrong?
definition_zh: 用来询问某人是否不高兴、不开心等，或者是否有问题
example_zh: 怎么了？有什么不对劲吗？

definition: to be important or have an important effect on somebody/something
example: ‘I'm afraid I forgot that book again.’ ‘It doesn't matter (= it is not important enough to worry about).’
definition_zh: 要对某人/某事产生重要影响或产生重要影响
example_zh: '恐怕我又忘了那本书。''没关系（=没必要担心）。'

definition: used to say that something is possible
example: That may or may not be true.
definition_zh: 我常说，事情是可能的
example_zh: 这可能是真的，也可能不是。

definition: the main ways that large numbers of people receive information and entertainment, that is television, radio, newspapers and the internet
example: the national/international media
definition_zh: 大量人获取信息和娱乐的主要途径是电视、广播、报纸和互联网
example_zh: 国内/国际媒体

definition: connected with illness and injury and their treatment
example: medical care/treatment
definition_zh: 与疾病和伤害及其治疗相关
example_zh: 医疗护理/治疗

definition: the study and treatment of diseases and injuries
example: advances in modern medicine
definition_zh: 疾病与伤害的研究与治疗
example_zh: 现代医学的进展

definition: your ability to remember things
example: memory for something, I have a bad memory for names.
definition_zh: 你记忆事物的能力
example_zh: 记忆力方面，我对名字记性很差。

definition: to write or speak about something/somebody, especially without giving much information
example: mention something/somebody, Sorry, I won't mention it again.
definition_zh: 写作或谈论某事或某人，尤其是不提供太多信息
example_zh: 提点什么/提一下，抱歉，我不会再提了。

definition: a type of solid mineral substance that is usually hard and shiny and that heat and electricity can travel through, for example tin, iron and gold
example: a piece/sheet of metal
definition_zh: 一种通常坚硬且有光泽的固体矿物，热量和电流可以通过它传递，例如锡、铁和黄金
example_zh: 一块金属片/片

definition: a particular way of doing something
example: Which method is the most effective?
definition_zh: 一种特定的做事方式
example_zh: 哪种方法最有效？

definition: in a position in the middle of an object, group of objects, people, etc.; between the beginning and the end of something
example: Pens are kept in the middle drawer.
definition_zh: 处于一个物体、一组物体、人等中间的位置;介于某物的开始与结束之间
example_zh: 笔放在中间抽屉里。

definition: the part of something that is at an equal distance from all its edges or sides; a point or a period of time between the beginning and the end of something
example: in the middle, a lake with an island in the middle
definition_zh: 某物与其所有边或边相等距离的部分;某物开始与结束之间的某个点或一段时间
example_zh: 中央是一个湖，中间有一座岛屿

definition: used when showing that something is or was possible
example: He might get there in time, but I can't be sure.
definition_zh: 用于证明某事是可能的或曾经可能的
example_zh: 他可能赶得上，但我不能确定。

definition: the part of a person that makes them able to be aware of things, to think and to feel
example: the conscious/subconscious mind
definition_zh: 一个人能够觉察事物、思考和感受的那部分
example_zh: 意识/潜意识

definition: to be upset, annoyed or worried by something
example: mind (something), I don't mind the cold—it's the rain I don't like.
definition_zh: 因为某件事感到难过、恼火或担忧
example_zh: 介意（什么的），我不介意冷——我不喜欢雨。

definition: of or belonging to the person writing or speaking
example: That's mine.
definition_zh: 属于或属于写作或发言者的身份
example_zh: 那是我的。

definition: a piece of special flat glass that reflects images, so that you can see yourself when you look in it
example: in the mirror, He looked at himself in the mirror.
definition_zh: 一块特殊的平面玻璃，可以反射图像，这样你在看它时就能看到自己
example_zh: 在镜子里，他看着镜中的自己。

definition: that cannot be found or that is not in its usual place; that has been removed, lost or destroyed
example: I never found the missing piece.
definition_zh: 找不到或不在原位的;已被移除、遗失或毁坏
example_zh: 我从未找到那块缺失的拼图。

definition: connected with mobile phones, tablets, etc.
example: What's your mobile number?
definition_zh: 通过手机、平板等连接。
example_zh: 你的手机号码是多少？

definition: a mobile phone
example: Call me on my mobile.
definition_zh: 一部手机
example_zh: 给我打手机。

definition: an animal with a long tail, that climbs trees and lives in hot countries. There are several types of monkey and they are related to apes and humans.
example: Like humans, apes and monkeys live in complex social groupings.
definition_zh: 一种长尾巴的动物，喜欢爬树，生活在炎热的地区。猴子有好几种，它们与猿类和人类有亲缘关系。
example_zh: 像人类一样，猿类和猴子生活在复杂的社会群体中。

definition: the round object that moves around the earth once every 27½ days and shines at night by light reflected from the sun
example: the surface of the moon
definition_zh: 那个圆形物体，每27天半绕地球一周，夜间通过太阳反射的光照亮
example_zh: 月球表面

definition: mainly; generally
example: The sauce is mostly cream.
definition_zh: 主要如此;总体而言
example_zh: 酱料主要是奶油。

definition: a road vehicle with two wheels, driven by an engine, with one seat for the driver and often a seat for a passenger behind the driver
example: He never learned to ride a motorcycle or to drive a car.
definition_zh: 一种由发动机驱动的两个车轮的公路车辆，驾驶员有一个座位，驾驶员后面通常还有一个乘客座位
example_zh: 他从未学会骑摩托车或开汽车。

definition: an act of moving the body or part of the body
example: hand/eye movements
definition_zh: 移动身体或身体部分的行为
example_zh: 手/眼的运动

definition: connected with music; containing music
example: musical styles/tastes
definition_zh: 与音乐相连;包含音乐
example_zh: 音乐风格/品味

definition: a person who plays a musical instrument or writes music, especially as a job
example: a jazz/rock/classical musician
definition_zh: 一个演奏乐器或创作音乐的人，尤其是作为一份工作
example_zh: 一位爵士/摇滚/古典音乐家

definition: used when the speaker or writer is also the person affected by an action
example: I cut myself on a knife.
definition_zh: 当说话者或写作者同时也是受某项行为影响的人时，会被用到
example_zh: 我被刀割伤了。

definition: measuring a short distance from one side to the other, especially in relation to length
example: Stray dogs wander the steep narrow lanes of the old town.
definition_zh: 测量从一侧到另一侧的短距离，特别是与长度的关系
example_zh: 流浪狗在老城区陡峭狭窄的小路上游荡。

definition: connected with a particular nation; shared by a whole nation
example: Decide whether it would be better to advertise in a national or a local newspaper.
definition_zh: 与特定民族相连;被整个民族共享
example_zh: 决定在全国报纸还是地方报纸上登广告更好。

definition: all the plants, animals and things that exist in the universe that are not made by people
example: Take time to appreciate the beauties of nature.
definition_zh: 宇宙中所有非人类创造的植物、动物和事物
example_zh: 花点时间欣赏大自然的美丽。

definition: almost; not quite; not completely
example: The bottle's nearly empty.
definition_zh: 几乎;还没完全;还没完全
example_zh: 瓶子快空了。

definition: that is needed for a purpose or a reason
example: necessary to do something, It may be necessary to buy a new one.
definition_zh: 这是出于某种目的或原因所需要的
example_zh: 如果要做某件事，可能需要买一个新的。

definition: the part of the body between the head and the shoulders
example: He tied a scarf around his neck.
definition_zh: 头部与肩膀之间的身体部位
example_zh: 他系了条围巾在脖子上。

definition: a situation when something is necessary or must be done
example: to satisfy/meet/fulfil a need
definition_zh: 当某事必要或必须采取行动时
example_zh: 以满足/满足/满足需求

definition: not one nor the other of two things or people
example: Neither answer is correct.
definition_zh: 既不是两件事，也不是两人
example_zh: 这两个答案都不正确。

definition: not one nor the other of two things or people
example: Neither answer is correct.
definition_zh: 既不是两件事，也不是两人
example_zh: 这两个答案都不正确。

definition: anxious about something or afraid of something
example: I felt really nervous before the interview.
definition_zh: 焦虑或害怕某事
example_zh: 面试前我真的很紧张。

definition: a complicated system of roads, lines, tubes, nerves, etc. that are connected to each other and operate together
example: a rail/road/canal network
definition_zh: 一个由道路、线路、管道、神经等组成的复杂系统，这些相互连接并协同运作
example_zh: 铁路/公路/运河网络

definition: a sound, especially when it is loud, unpleasant or frightening
example: There was a rattling noise coming from the back of the car.
definition_zh: 一种声音，尤其是当它响亮、令人不快或令人害怕时
example_zh: 车后传来一阵咔哒声。

definition: making a lot of noise
example: noisy children/traffic/crowds
definition_zh: 制造很大声响
example_zh: 吵闹的孩子/车流/人群

definition: not one of a group of people or things; not any
example: None of these pens works/work.
definition_zh: 不是某个群体或某物;不是任何一个
example_zh: 这些笔都不管用/不管用。

definition: typical, usual or ordinary; what you would expect
example: quite/perfectly (= completely) normal
definition_zh: 典型、普通或普通;正如你所预期的那样
example_zh: 完全/完全正常（= 完全）正常

definition: usually; in normal circumstances
example: I would never normally discuss this.
definition_zh: 通常;在正常情况下
example_zh: 我平时绝不会讨论这个。

definition: a sheet of paper giving written or printed information, usually put in a public place
example: There was a notice on the board saying the class had been cancelled.
definition_zh: 一张写有书面或印刷信息的纸张，通常放在公共场所
example_zh: 黑板上贴着通知说课程已被取消。

definition: to see or hear somebody/something; to become aware of somebody/something
example: People were making fun of him but he didn't seem to notice.
definition_zh: 看到或听到某人/某物;意识到某人/某物的存在
example_zh: 人们在取笑他，但他似乎没注意到。

definition: a story long enough to fill a complete book, in which the characters and events are usually imaginary
example: to write/publish/read a novel
definition_zh: 一个足够长到可以填满一本完整书的故事，其中人物和事件通常是虚构的
example_zh: 写作/出版/阅读一部小说

definition: not in or to any place
example: I had nowhere to live, so I was sleeping on my sister's couch.
definition_zh: 不在任何地方或前往任何地方
example_zh: 我无处可住，只能睡在姐姐的沙发上。

definition: to give a number to something as part of a series or list
example: number something, All the seats in the stadium are numbered.
definition_zh: 为系列或列表中的某项指定数字
example_zh: 编号，体育场里所有座位都有编号。

definition: a small hard fruit with a very hard shell that grows on some trees
example: to crack a nut (= open it)
definition_zh: 一种小而坚硬的果实，壳非常坚硬，生长在某些树上
example_zh: 敲碎坚果（=打开它）

definition: the mass of salt water that covers most of the earth’s surface
example: The ship was dredged from the depths of the ocean.
definition_zh: 覆盖地球大部分表面的大片咸水
example_zh: 这艘船是从海底打捞出来的。

definition: an act of saying that you are willing to do something for somebody or give something to somebody
example: to receive a job offer
definition_zh: 一种表达你愿意为某人做某事或给予某物的行为
example_zh: 以接收工作邀请

definition: to say that you are willing to give something to somebody
example: offer (something), Josie had offered her services as a guide.
definition_zh: 说你愿意给别人一些东西
example_zh: 乔茜主动提出要做向导。

definition: a person who is in a position of authority in the armed forces
example: army/military/naval officers
definition_zh: 在武装部队中担任权威职位的人
example_zh: 陆军/陆军/海军军官

definition: a thick liquid that is found in rock underground
example: Several companies are drilling for oil in the region.
definition_zh: 一种存在于地下岩石中的浓稠液体
example_zh: 多家公司正在该地区进行石油钻探。

definition: used with verbs to express movement on or to a particular place or position
example: Move the books onto the second shelf.
definition_zh: 与动词一起使用，表达在特定地点或位置上的移动
example_zh: 把书搬到第二层书架上。

definition: a time when a particular situation makes it possible to do or achieve something
example: Don't miss this opportunity!
definition_zh: 一个特定情境使得某事成为可能的时刻
example_zh: 不要错过这个机会！

definition: something that you can choose to have or do; the freedom to choose what you do
example: As I see it, we have two options…
definition_zh: 你可以选择拥有或做的事情;选择你做什么的自由
example_zh: 在我看来，我们有两个选择......

definition: not unusual or different in any way
example: an ordinary sort of day
definition_zh: 一点也不奇怪，也没有任何不同之处
example_zh: 一个普通的日子

definition: a group of people who form a business, club, etc. together in order to achieve a particular aim
example: He's the president of a large international organization.
definition_zh: 一群人为了实现特定目标而共同组建企业、俱乐部等
example_zh: 他是一家大型国际组织的主席。

definition: to make all the arrangements for something to happen or be provided
example: He helped to organize various events.
definition_zh: 为某事发生或提供一切安排
example_zh: 他协助组织了各类活动。

definition: existing at the beginning of a particular period, process or activity
example: The room still has many of its original features.
definition_zh: 在特定时期、过程或活动的开始时存在
example_zh: 房间仍保留了许多原有特色。

definition: the reflexive form of we; used when you and another person or other people together cause and are affected by an action
example: We shouldn't blame ourselves for what happened.
definition_zh: “我们”的自身形式;当你与另一个人或其他人共同引发并受到某项行为影响时，会使用。
example_zh: 我们不应该为发生的事情责怪自己。

definition: of, on or facing the outer side
example: The outside walls are damp.
definition_zh: 外侧、上方或朝向外侧
example_zh: 外墙潮湿。

definition: the outer side or surface of something
example: The outside of the house needs painting.
definition_zh: 某物的外侧或表面
example_zh: 房子外墙需要粉刷。

definition: on or to a place on the outside of something
example: You can park your car outside our house.
definition_zh: 在某物的外部或某个地方
example_zh: 你可以把车停在我们家门口。

definition: the part of a cooker that is like a box with a door on the front, in which food is cooked or heated
example: Take the cake out of the oven.
definition_zh: 像一个前面有门的盒子一样的锅炉部分，用来烹饪或加热食物
example_zh: 把蛋糕从烤箱里拿出来。

definition: to have something that belongs to you, especially because you have bought it
example: Do you own your house or do you rent it?
definition_zh: 拥有属于自己的东西，尤其是因为你买下了它
example_zh: 你的房子是自己所有，还是租来的？

definition: a person who owns something
example: a dog/pet/gun owner
definition_zh: 一个拥有某物的人
example_zh: 一位狗/宠物/枪支的主人

definition: to put clothes, etc. into a bag in preparation for a trip away from home
example: I haven't packed yet.
definition_zh: 把衣服等东西装进包里，为远行做准备
example_zh: 我还没收拾行李呢。

definition: the feelings that you have in your body when you have been hurt or when you are ill
example: a cry of pain
definition_zh: 当你受伤或生病时，身体里的感受
example_zh: 一声痛苦的呼喊

definition: a person whose job is painting buildings, walls, etc.
example: He works as a painter and decorator.
definition_zh: 一个工作是粉刷建筑物、墙壁等的人。
example_zh: 他是一名油漆工和装饰师。

definition: the official home of a king, queen, president, etc.
example: Buckingham Palace
definition_zh: 国王、王后、总统等人的官方住所。
example_zh: 白金汉宫

definition: underpants or knickers
example: a pair of pants
definition_zh: 内裤或内裤
example_zh: 一条裤子

definition: the act of stopping a vehicle at a place and leaving it there for a period of time
example: There is no parking here between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m.
definition_zh: 将车辆停在某处并停放一段时间的行为
example_zh: 这里上午9点至下午6点期间不允许停车。

definition: used to emphasize that you are referring to one individual person, thing or type of thing and not others
example: There is one particular patient I'd like you to see.
definition_zh: 用来强调你指的是某个人、某一事物或某一类型，而不是其他
example_zh: 有一位特别的病人我想让你看看。

definition: to achieve the required standard in an exam, a test, etc.
example: I'm not really expecting to pass first time.
definition_zh: 为了在考试、测试等中达到所需的标准。
example_zh: 我其实并不指望第一次就能通过。

definition: a person who is travelling in a car, bus, train, plane or ship and who is not driving it or working on it
example: airline/cruise/rail/bus passengers
definition_zh: 乘坐汽车、公交车、火车、飞机或船只旅行，但既不驾驶也不在修理该船的人
example_zh: 航空公司/邮轮/铁路/巴士乘客

definition: from one side of something to the other
example: She smiled at me as she walked past.
definition_zh: 从某物的一端到另一端
example_zh: 她走过时对我微笑。

definition: a person who is receiving medical treatment, especially in a hospital
example: cancer/AIDS/heart patients
definition_zh: 正在接受医疗治疗的人，尤其是在医院中
example_zh: 癌症/艾滋病/心脏病患者

definition: the regular way in which something happens or is done
example: changing patterns of urban life
definition_zh: 某件事发生或执行的常规方式
example_zh: 城市生活模式的变化

definition: the money that somebody gets for doing regular work
example: Her job is hard work, but the pay is good.
definition_zh: 一个人做常规工作能拿到的钱
example_zh: 她的工作很辛苦，但薪水不错。

definition: a situation or a period of time in which there is no war or violence in a country or an area
example: world peace
definition_zh: 一个国家或地区没有战争或暴力的情形或时期
example_zh: 世界和平

definition: a small British coin and unit of money. There are 100 pence in one pound (£1).
example: He had a few pennies in his pocket.
definition_zh: 一枚小额英国硬币和货币单位。每磅有100便士（£1）。
example_zh: 他口袋里有几枚硬币。

definition: used to express the cost or amount of something for each person, number used, distance travelled, etc.
example: Rooms cost £50 per person, per night.
definition_zh: 用于表达每个人的费用或金额、使用的数量、行驶距离等。
example_zh: 房间费用为每人每晚50英镑。

definition: by, in or for every hundred
example: a 15 per cent rise in price
definition_zh: 按、按或按一百个
example_zh: 价格上涨15%

definition: by, in or for every hundred
example: a 15 per cent rise in price
definition_zh: 按、按或按一百个
example_zh: 价格上涨15%

definition: one part in every hundred
example: per cent of something/somebody, Poor families spend about 80 to 90 per cent of their income on food.
definition_zh: 每百个就有一份
example_zh: 某物/某人的百分比，贫困家庭大约将80%到90%的收入花在食物上。

definition: to entertain an audience by playing a piece of music, acting in a play, etc.
example: to perform a song/dance/play
definition_zh: 通过演奏音乐、表演戏剧等方式娱乐观众。
example_zh: 表演歌曲/舞蹈/戏剧

definition: possibly
example: ‘Are you going to come?’ ‘Perhaps. I'll see how I feel.’
definition_zh: 可能
example_zh: “你会来吗？”“也许吧。我看看自己感觉如何。”

definition: the act of allowing somebody to do something, especially when this is done by somebody in a position of authority
example: permission for something, You must ask permission for all major expenditure.
definition_zh: 允许某人做某事的行为，尤其是当这种行为由身居权威的人完成时
example_zh: 有事要批准，所有重大支出都必须先征得许可。

definition: the various aspects of a person’s character that combine to make them different from other people
example: His wife has a strong personality.
definition_zh: 一个人性格中各种特征结合起来，使他们与众不同
example_zh: 他的妻子性格坚强。

definition: an animal, a bird, etc. that you have at home for pleasure, rather than one that is kept for work or food
example: Do you have any pets?
definition_zh: 你家里养的动物、鸟之类的，是你为了娱乐而养的，而不是只为了工作或吃饭而养的
example_zh: 你有宠物吗？

definition: a liquid obtained from petroleum, used as fuel in car engines, etc.
example: to fill a car up with petrol
definition_zh: 一种从石油中获得的液体，用作汽车发动机等燃料。
example_zh: 给车加满汽油

definition: to take a photograph of somebody/something
example: photograph somebody/something, a workshop on photographing wildlife
definition_zh: 为某人/某物拍摄照片
example_zh: 拍摄某人/某物，野生动物摄影工作坊

definition: connected with a person’s body rather than their mind
example: physical activity/fitness
definition_zh: 与人的身体而非思想相连
example_zh: 体育活动/健身

definition: the scientific study of matter and energy and the relationships between them, including the study of forces, heat, light, sound, electricity and the structure of atoms
example: a degree in physics
definition_zh: 对物质和能量及其关系的科学研究，包括对力、热、光、声音、电以及原子结构的研究
example_zh: 物理学学位

definition: to choose somebody/something from a group of people or things
example: pick somebody/something, Pick a number from one to twenty.
definition_zh: 从一群人或一件事中选择某人/某物
example_zh: 选一个人/某物，从一到二十选一个数字。

definition: a person who operates the controls of an aircraft, especially as a job
example: an airline pilot
definition_zh: 一个操作飞机控制装置的人，尤其是作为工作
example_zh: 一名航空公司飞行员

definition: a large round object in space that moves around a star (such as the sun) and receives light from it
example: the planets of our solar system
definition_zh: 一个位于太空中的大型圆形物体，绕着恒星（如太阳）移动并接收来自恒星的光
example_zh: 我们太阳系的行星

definition: to put plants, seeds, etc. in the ground to grow
example: to plant a tree/seed/crop
definition_zh: 将植物、种子等种到地里使其生长
example_zh: 种植树木/种子/作物

definition: made of plastic
example: a plastic bag/bottle/cup
definition_zh: 塑料制成
example_zh: 一个塑料袋/瓶子/杯子

definition: a light strong material that is produced by chemical processes and can be formed into shapes when heated. There are many different types of plastic, used to make different objects and fabrics.
example: The pipes should be made of plastic.
definition_zh: 一种轻质坚固的材料，通过化学工艺生产，加热后可塑形。塑料有许多不同类型，用于制作不同的物品和织物。
example_zh: 管道应由塑料制成。

definition: a flat, usually round, dish that you put food on
example: sandwiches on a plate
definition_zh: 一个扁平、通常是圆形的盘子，用来盛放食物
example_zh: 盘子里的三明治

definition: the raised flat area next to the track at a train station where you get on or off the train
example: (British English), What platform does it go from?
definition_zh: 火车站轨道旁那个隆起的平坦区域，你在那儿上下车
example_zh: （英式英语），它是从哪个平台转出的？

definition: to make somebody happy
example: please somebody, You can't please everybody.
definition_zh: 为了让某人开心
example_zh: 取悦某人，你不可能取悦所有人。

definition: feeling happy about something
example: You're coming? I'm so pleased.
definition_zh: 为某事感到开心
example_zh: 你要来吗？我太高兴了。

definition: a small piece of material like a small bag sewn into or onto a piece of clothing so that you can carry things in it
example: a jacket/coat/shirt/trouser pocket
definition_zh: 一小块布料，比如小包，缝在衣服上或上，方便你把东西装进去
example_zh: 夹克/外套/衬衫/裤子口袋

definition: having or showing good manners and respect for the feelings of others
example: polite to somebody, Please be polite to our guests.
definition_zh: 拥有或表现出良好的礼貌，并尊重他人的感受
example_zh: 对某人礼貌，请对我们的客人礼貌。

definition: the process of making air, water, soil, etc. dirty; the state of being dirty
example: air/water pollution
definition_zh: 使空气、水、土壤等变脏的过程;肮脏的状态
example_zh: 空气/水污染

definition: connected with modern popular music
example: a pop song
definition_zh: 与现代流行音乐的关联
example_zh: 一首流行歌曲

definition: popular music of the sort that has been popular since the 1950s, usually with a strong rhythm and simple tunes, often contrasted with rock, soul and other forms of popular music
example: rock, pop and soul
definition_zh: 这类流行音乐自20世纪50年代以来一直流行，通常节奏强烈、旋律简单，常与摇滚、灵魂乐及其他流行音乐形式形成对比
example_zh: 摇滚、流行与灵魂乐

definition: all the people who live in a particular area, city or country; the total number of people who live there
example: One third of the world’s population consumes/consume two thirds of the world’s resources.
definition_zh: 居住在特定地区、城市或国家的所有人口;居住在那里的总人口
example_zh: 全球三分之一的人口消耗或消耗了全球三分之二的资源。

definition: the place where somebody/something is located
example: Where would be the best position for the lights?
definition_zh: 某人/某物所在的位置
example_zh: 灯光放在哪里最合适？

definition: something that you own or have with you at a particular time
example: Prisoners were allowed no personal possessions.
definition_zh: 你在特定时间拥有或随身携带的东西
example_zh: 囚犯不得携带任何个人物品。

definition: a thing that may happen or be true; the fact that something might happen or be true, but is not certain
example: Bankruptcy is a real possibility if sales don't improve.
definition_zh: 一种可能发生或成为真实的事情;某件事可能发生或真实，但并不确定这一事实
example_zh: 如果销售不改善，破产是真实存在的可能。

definition: a large notice, often with a picture on it, that is put in a public place to advertise something
example: campaign/election posters
definition_zh: 一张大型告示，通常带有图片，放在公共场所用来宣传某物
example_zh: 竞选/选举海报

definition: the ability to control people or things
example: power to do something, He has the power to make things very unpleasant for us.
definition_zh: 控制人或事物的能力
example_zh: 有能力做某事，他有能力让我们感到非常不愉快。

definition: to say that something will happen in the future
example: predict something, a reliable method of predicting earthquakes
definition_zh: 说未来会发生某件事
example_zh: 预测某物，一种可靠的地震预测方法

definition: to show or offer something for other people to look at or consider
example: present something, Are you presenting a paper at the conference?
definition_zh: 展示或提供一些东西，供他人观看或考虑
example_zh: 做点展示，你是在会议上发表论文吗？

definition: the leader of a republic, for example the US
example: Several presidents attended the funeral.
definition_zh: 一个共和国的领导人，比如美国
example_zh: 多位总统出席了葬礼。

definition: to stop somebody from doing something; to stop something from happening
example: prevent something/somebody, The accident could have been prevented.
definition_zh: 阻止某人做某事;阻止某事发生
example_zh: 阻止某事或某人，事故本可以避免。

definition: to produce letters, pictures, etc. on paper using a machine that puts ink (= coloured liquid) on the surface
example: print (something), I'm printing a copy of the document for you.
definition_zh: 用机器在纸上涂抹墨水（=彩色液体）在纸上绘制字母、图片等。
example_zh: 打印（什么的），我正在帮你打印一份文件的副本。

definition: a machine for printing text on paper, especially one connected to a computer
example: a colour printer
definition_zh: 一台用于在纸上打印文字的机器，尤其是连接计算机的机器
example_zh: 彩色打印机

definition: a building where people are kept as a punishment for a crime they have committed, or while they are waiting for trial
example: She went to prison for tax evasion.
definition_zh: 一栋建筑，人们被关押起来，作为他们犯下的罪行的惩罚，或者等待审判
example_zh: 她因逃税入狱。

definition: an award that is given to a person who wins a competition, race, etc. or who does very good work
example: She was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize.
definition_zh: 这是一个颁发给在比赛、比赛等方面获胜或表现非常出色的人颁发的奖项
example_zh: 她获得了诺贝尔和平奖。

definition: a series of things that are done in order to achieve a particular result
example: the consultation/planning process
definition_zh: 为达到特定结果而采取的一系列措施
example_zh: 咨询/规划过程

definition: to make things to be sold, especially in large quantities
example: Our company mainly produces goods for export.
definition_zh: 制作物品以便出售，尤其是大量销售
example_zh: 我们公司主要生产出口用商品。

definition: doing something as a paid job rather than as a hobby
example: professional athletes/players
definition_zh: 把某件事当作有偿工作，而不是当作兴趣爱好
example_zh: 职业运动员/球员

definition: a university teacher of the highest rank
example: Professor (Ann) Williams
definition_zh: 一位最高级别的大学教师
example_zh: 威廉姆斯教授（Ann）

definition: a description of somebody/something that gives useful information
example: We first build up a detailed profile of our customers and their requirements.
definition_zh: 对某人/事物的描述，提供有用信息
example_zh: 我们首先建立客户及其需求的详细画像。

definition: a set of instructions in code that control the operations or functions of a computer
example: You'll need to download and install the program on your computer.
definition_zh: 一组代码中的指令，用于控制计算机的操作或功能
example_zh: 你需要在电脑上下载并安装该程序。

definition: the process of improving or developing, or of getting nearer to achieving or completing something
example: I think we're making progress.
definition_zh: 改进、发展，或接近实现或完成某事的过程
example_zh: 我觉得我们正在取得进展。

definition: a statement that tells somebody that you will definitely do or not do something
example: to make/keep/fulfil/break a promise
definition_zh: 一句告诉别人你一定会做或不会做某件事的话
example_zh: 承诺/履行/履行/违背承诺

definition: to tell somebody that you will definitely do or not do something, or that something will definitely happen
example: ‘We haven't got time to go to the park.’ ‘But you promised!’
definition_zh: 告诉别人你一定会做或不做某件事，或者一定会发生某件事
example_zh: “我们没时间去公园。”“可你答应过的！”

definition: to make the sound of a word or letter in a particular way
example: to pronounce a word/syllable/vowel/consonant
definition_zh: 以特定方式发出单词或字母的声音
example_zh: 发音一个单词/音节/元音/辅音

definition: to make sure that somebody/something is not harmed, injured, damaged, etc.
example: protect somebody/something/yourself, to protect children/citizens/civilians/consumers/workers
definition_zh: 以确保某人/某物不会受到伤害、受伤、损坏等。
example_zh: 保护某人/某物/你自己，以保护儿童/公民/平民/消费者/工人

definition: to give something to somebody or make it available for them to use
example: provide something, Please provide the following information.
definition_zh: 把某样东西送给某人，或者让某人可以使用
example_zh: 请提供一些信息，请提供以下信息。

definition: a building where people go to drink and meet their friends. Pubs serve alcoholic and other drinks, and often also food.
example: We're all going to the pub after work.
definition_zh: 一栋人们去喝酒、与朋友见面的建筑。酒吧供应酒精饮料及其他饮品，通常还供应食物。
example_zh: 下班后我们都去酒吧。

definition: connected with ordinary people in society in general
example: The campaign is designed to increase public awareness of the issues.
definition_zh: 与社会中普通人有联系
example_zh: 该活动旨在提高公众对相关问题的认识。

definition: ordinary people in society in general
example: The palace is now open to the public.
definition_zh: 社会中的普通人
example_zh: 宫殿现已对公众开放。

definition: to produce a book, magazine, CD-ROM, etc. and sell it to the public
example: to publish a book/novel/magazine/paper
definition_zh: 制作书籍、杂志、CD-ROM等并向公众销售
example_zh: 出版书籍/小说/杂志/报纸

definition: to take hold of something and use force in order to move it or try to move it towards yourself
example: You push and I'll pull.
definition_zh: 抓住某样东西并用力去推动它，或者试图把它推向自己
example_zh: 你推，我拉。

definition: the intention, aim or function of something; the thing that something is supposed to achieve
example: Our campaign's main purpose is to raise money.
definition_zh: 某物的意图、目标或功能;某物应达成的目标
example_zh: 我们活动的主要目的是筹集资金。

definition: to use your hands, arms or body in order to make somebody/something move forward or away from you; to move part of your body into a particular position
example: We pushed and pushed but the piano wouldn't move.
definition_zh: 用手、手臂或身体让某人或某物向前移动或远离你;将身体的一部分移动到特定位置
example_zh: 我们一推再推，但钢琴就是动不了。

definition: the standard of something when it is compared to other things like it; how good or bad something is
example: Improving the quality of care for nursing home residents is a priority.
definition_zh: 某样东西与其他类似事物比较时的标准;某件事有多好或多差
example_zh: 提升养老院居民的护理质量是当务之急。

definition: an amount or a number of something
example: quantity of something, a large/small quantity of something
definition_zh: 某个金额或某个数字
example_zh: 某样东西的数量，某样东西的大/小量

definition: the female ruler of an independent state that has a royal family
example: She was crowned queen at the age of fifteen.
definition_zh: 拥有王室家族的独立国家的女性统治者
example_zh: 她十五岁时加冕为王后。

definition: to ask somebody questions about something, especially officially
example: question somebody, Police are keen to question any witnesses.
definition_zh: 问别人一些问题，尤其是正式的
example_zh: 如果问人，警方很想讯问任何目击者。

definition: in a way that makes very little noise
example: to ask/speak/talk quietly
definition_zh: 以一种几乎不引起噪音的方式
example_zh: 要小声问/说话/说话

definition: a competition between people, animals, vehicles, etc. to see which one is the faster or fastest
example: a boat/horse race
definition_zh: 人、动物、交通工具等之间的竞赛，看谁更快或最快
example_zh: 赛艇/赛马

definition: to compete against somebody/something to see who can go faster or the fastest, do something first, etc.; to take part in a race or races
example: They raced to a thrilling victory in the relay.
definition_zh: 与某人或某物竞争，看谁跑得更快或最快，谁先做某件事，等等;参加比赛
example_zh: 他们在接力赛中奋力夺冠，赢得了一场激动人心的胜利。

definition: a track with rails on which trains run
example: The railway is still under construction.
definition_zh: 一条带轨道的轨道，列车在上面运行
example_zh: 铁路仍在建设中。

definition: to lift or move something to a higher level
example: She raised the gun and fired.
definition_zh: 将某物抬起或移动到更高的位置
example_zh: 她举起枪开火。

definition: a measurement of the speed at which something happens
example: rate (of something), Figures published today show another fall in the rate of inflation.
definition_zh: 测量某事发生速度的指标
example_zh: 某某的水平，今天公布的数据显示通胀率再次下降。

definition: used to mean ‘fairly’ or ‘to some degree’, often when you are disappointed, surprised or expressing slight criticism
example: rather odd/strange/unusual
definition_zh: 过去指的是“相当”或“在某种程度上”，通常是在你感到失望、惊讶或表达轻微批评时
example_zh: 相当奇怪/奇怪/不寻常

definition: to arrive at the place that you have been travelling to
example: They didn't reach the border until after dark.
definition_zh: 抵达你一直前往的地方
example_zh: 他们直到天黑后才到达边境。

definition: to change or behave in a particular way as a result of or in response to something
example: I nudged her but she didn't react.
definition_zh: 因某事而改变或以特定方式行为
example_zh: 我轻轻推了她一下，但她没有反应。

definition: to understand or become aware of a particular fact or situation
example: realize (that)…, I didn’t realize (that) you were so unhappy.
definition_zh: 理解或意识到某一特定事实或情境
example_zh: 意识到（这一点）......我没意识到你曾经那么不开心。

definition: to get or accept something that is sent or given to you
example: receive something
definition_zh: 接收或接受寄送或赠送给你的物品
example_zh: 收到某样东西

definition: that happened or began only a short time ago
example: a recent study/report/survey
definition_zh: 这件事发生或开始的也只是不久前
example_zh: 一项近期研究/报告/调查

definition: not long ago
example: a recently published book
definition_zh: 不久前
example_zh: 一本最近出版的书

definition: the area inside the entrance of a hotel, an office building, etc. where guests or visitors go first when they arrive
example: Please report to reception on arrival.
definition_zh: 酒店、办公楼等入口内的区域，客人或访客到达时最先进入的区域
example_zh: 请到达后前往前台报到。

definition: a set of instructions that tells you how to cook something and the ingredients (= items of food) you need for it
example: recipe for something, a recipe for chicken soup
definition_zh: 一套说明书，告诉你如何烹饪某样东西以及你需要的食材（= 食物种类）
example_zh: 某样菜谱，鸡汤食谱

definition: to know who somebody is or what something is when you see or hear them or it, because you have seen or heard them or it before
example: recognize somebody/something, I recognized him as soon as he came in the room.
definition_zh: 当你看到或听到某人或某物时，知道某人是谁或某物是什么，因为你以前见过或听过他们或它
example_zh: 认出某个人/什么东西，我一看到他进房间就认出来了。

definition: to tell somebody that something is good or useful, or that somebody would be suitable for a particular job, etc.
example: recommend somebody/something, The hotel's new restaurant comes highly recommended (= a lot of people have praised it).
definition_zh: 告诉某人某件事很好或有用，或者某人适合某个特定的工作，等等。
example_zh: 推荐某人或某物，酒店的新餐厅备受高度推荐（= 很多人称赞）。

definition: a written account of something that is kept so that it can be looked at and used in the future
example: You should keep a record of your expenses.
definition_zh: 一份书面记录，保存下来以便未来查看和使用
example_zh: 你应该记录你的开支。

definition: to keep a permanent account of facts or events by writing them down, filming them, storing them in a computer, etc.
example: record something, Her childhood is recorded in the diaries of those years.
definition_zh: 通过写下来、拍摄、存储在电脑中等方式，永久记录事实或事件。
example_zh: 记录点什么，她的童年被记录在那些年的日记里。

definition: sound or pictures that have been recorded on computer files or on CD, DVD, video, etc.
example: an audio recording
definition_zh: 录制在电脑文件或CD、DVD、视频等上的声音或图像。
example_zh: 音频录音

definition: to treat things that have already been used so that they can be used again
example: to recycle waste/rubbish
definition_zh: 治疗已经使用过的东西，以便它们可以再次使用。
example_zh: 用于回收废弃物/垃圾

definition: to make something less or smaller in size, quantity, price, etc.; to become less or smaller in size, quantity, etc.
example: reduce something, Reduce speed now (= on a sign).
definition_zh: 在尺寸、数量、价格等方面，使某物变小或更小;在尺寸、数量等方面变小或更小。
example_zh: 减慢点什么，现在就减速（=标牌上）。

definition: to send somebody/something to somebody/something for help, advice or a decision
example: refer somebody/something to somebody/something, My doctor referred me to a specialist.
definition_zh: 把某人/某物送去某个人/某物那里寻求帮助、建议或一个决定
example_zh: 把某人/某事转诊给某人/某某人，我的医生把我转诊给了专科医生。

definition: to say or show that you will not do something that somebody has asked you to do
example: Go on, ask her; she can hardly refuse.
definition_zh: 说或表现出你不会去做别人让你做的事
example_zh: 来吧，问她;她几乎不可能拒绝。

definition: a large area of land, usually without exact limits or borders
example: mountainous/coastal regions
definition_zh: 一大片土地，通常没有明确的边界或边界
example_zh: 山区/沿海地区

definition: following a pattern, especially with the same time or space in between each thing and the next
example: regular breathing
definition_zh: 遵循某种模式，尤其是在每件事与下一件之间保持相同时间或间隔时
example_zh: 规律呼吸

definition: the way in which two people, groups or countries behave towards each other or deal with each other
example: a personal/working relationship
definition_zh: 两个人、两个群体或国家彼此相处的方式或对待彼此的方式
example_zh: 个人/工作关系

definition: to take somebody/something away from a place
example: remove somebody/something, Illegally parked vehicles will be removed.
definition_zh: 把某人/某物从一个地方带走
example_zh: 移除某人/某物，非法停放车辆将被移除。

definition: to fix something that is broken, damaged or torn
example: to repair a car/television
definition_zh: 修复损坏、损坏或撕裂的东西
example_zh: 修理汽车/电视

definition: to be used instead of somebody/something else; to do something instead of somebody/something else
example: The new design will eventually replace all existing models.
definition_zh: 被用来代替某个人/别的东西;去做点什么，而不是别人/别的什么
example_zh: 新设计最终将取代所有现有车型。

definition: an act of replying to something/somebody in speech, writing or by some action
example: I asked her what her name was but she made no reply.
definition_zh: 以言语、书写或某种行动回应某事或某人
example_zh: 我问她叫什么名字，但她没有回答。

definition: to say or write something as an answer to somebody/something
example: She didn't even bother to reply.
definition_zh: 用某人或某物的回答来说或写一些东西
example_zh: 她甚至懒得回复。

definition: to give people information about something that you have heard, seen, done, etc.
example: report something, The crash happened seconds after the pilot reported engine trouble.
definition_zh: 向人们传递你听过、见过、做过的事情等信息。
example_zh: 报告点什么，坠机发生在飞行员报告发动机故障的几秒钟后。

definition: a person who collects and reports news for newspapers, radio or television
example: He leaked the story to a news reporter.
definition_zh: 为报纸、广播或电视收集和报道新闻的人
example_zh: 他把这个消息泄露给了一名新闻记者。

definition: the action of asking for something formally and politely; a thing that you formally ask for
example: request for something, a request for information
definition_zh: 以正式而礼貌的方式提出请求的行为;你正式提出请求的那种东西
example_zh: 请求某样东西，请求信息

definition: a careful study of a subject, especially in order to discover new facts or information about it
example: scientific/medical/academic research
definition_zh: 对一个主题进行细致研究，尤其是为了发现新的事实或信息
example_zh: 科学/医学/学术研究

definition: to study something carefully and try to discover new facts about it
example: research (something), to research a topic/subject
definition_zh: 认真研究某件事，试图发现关于它的新事实
example_zh: 研究（某样东西），用来研究一个主题/主题

definition: a person who studies something carefully and tries to discover new facts about it
example: European researchers say olive oil could help prevent cancer.
definition_zh: 一个认真研究某件事并试图发现新事实的人
example_zh: 欧洲研究人员表示橄榄油可能有助于预防癌症。

definition: to give a spoken or written answer to somebody/something
example: I asked him his name, but he didn't respond.
definition_zh: 以口头或书面方式回答某人或某物
example_zh: 我问他的名字，但他没有回答。

definition: a spoken or written answer
example: She made no response.
definition_zh: 口头或书面回答
example_zh: 她没有回应。

definition: the part of something that remains
example: Take what you want and throw the rest away.
definition_zh: 那是某物留下来的部分
example_zh: 拿你想要的，把剩下的扔掉。

definition: to relax, sleep or do nothing after a period of activity or illness; to not use a part of your body for some time
example: The doctor told me to rest.
definition_zh: 在活动或生病一段时间后放松、睡觉或什么都不做;一段时间内不使用身体的某一部分
example_zh: 医生让我休息。

definition: a report in a newspaper or magazine, or on the internet, television or radio, in which somebody gives their opinion of a book, play, film, product, etc.; the act of writing this kind of report
example: a book review
definition_zh: 报纸、杂志、互联网、电视或广播中的报道，其中有人对某本书、戏剧、电影、产品等发表看法;撰写此类报道的行为
example_zh: 书评

definition: to write a report of a book, play, film, product, etc. in which you give your opinion of it
example: Please rate and review your purchase on our website.
definition_zh: 写一份关于书籍、戏剧、电影、产品等的报告，并表达你对其的看法
example_zh: 请在我们的网站上评价并评价您的购买。

definition: a short journey in a vehicle, on a bicycle, etc.
example: a train ride through beautiful countryside
definition_zh: 比如短途旅行，比如骑车、骑自行车等。
example_zh: 穿越美丽乡村的火车之旅

definition: a piece of jewellery that you wear on your finger, consisting of a round band of gold, silver, etc., sometimes decorated with precious stones
example: a gold ring
definition_zh: 佩戴在手指上的首饰，由金、银等圆形环组成，有时还镶嵌宝石
example_zh: 一枚金戒指

definition: to surround somebody/something
example: Thousands of demonstrators ringed the building.
definition_zh: 用来包围某个人/某物
example_zh: 成千上万的示威者包围了大楼。

definition: to come or go upwards; to reach a higher level or position
example: The curtain rose to reveal an empty stage.
definition_zh: 向上进或向上;达到更高的层次或位置
example_zh: 幕布缓缓升起，露出一个空荡荡的舞台。

definition: the hard solid material that forms part of the surface of the earth and some other planets
example: They drilled through several layers of rock to reach the oil.
definition_zh: 构成地球表面及其他一些行星表面的坚硬固体
example_zh: 他们钻穿了多层岩石以获取石油。

definition: an actor’s part in a play, film, etc.
example: She has landed the lead role (= the most important one) in a new play.
definition_zh: 演员在戏剧、电影等中的角色。
example_zh: 她获得了一部新戏剧的主角（=最重要的角色）。

definition: the structure that covers or forms the top of a building or vehicle
example: a flat/sloping/pitched roof
definition_zh: 覆盖或构成建筑物或车辆顶部的结构
example_zh: 平坦/倾斜/斜屋顶

definition: having a shape like a circle or a ball
example: a round plate
definition_zh: 具有圆或球这样的形状
example_zh: 一块圆盘

definition: moving in a circle
example: Everybody joins hands and dances round.
definition_zh: 在原地打转
example_zh: 大家手牵手，围着跳舞。

definition: in a circle
example: the first woman to sail round the world
definition_zh: 围成一个圈
example_zh: 第一位环游世界的女性

definition: a way that you follow to get from one place to another
example: Which is the best route to take?
definition_zh: 一种你从一个地方走到另一个地方的路径
example_zh: 哪条路最好？

definition: things that you throw away because you no longer want or need them
example: a rubbish bag/bin
definition_zh: 那些你因为不再想要或不需要而丢弃的东西
example_zh: 垃圾袋/垃圾桶

definition: having or showing a lack of respect for other people and their feelings
example: a rude comment/remark
definition_zh: 对他人及其感受缺乏尊重或表现出不尊重
example_zh: 一句无礼的评论/评论

definition: an act of running; a period of time spent running or the distance that somebody runs
example: I go for a run every morning.
definition_zh: 跑步的行为;跑步的时间或跑步距离
example_zh: 我每天早上都会去跑步。

definition: a person or an animal that runs, especially one taking part in a race
example: a long-distance/cross-country/marathon runner
definition_zh: 一个人或动物会跑步，尤其是参加比赛的动物
example_zh: 一名长跑/越野/马拉松跑者

definition: the action or sport of running
example: to go running
definition_zh: 跑步这一动作或运动
example_zh: 去跑步

definition: in a sad way
example: ‘I'm so sorry,’ she said sadly.
definition_zh: 以一种令人悲伤的方式
example_zh: “我很抱歉，”她悲伤地说。

definition: protected from any danger, harm or loss
example: The children are quite safe here.
definition_zh: 免受任何危险、伤害或损失的保护
example_zh: 孩子们在这里很安全。

definition: to travel on water using sails or an engine
example: + adv./prep., to sail into harbour
definition_zh: 利用帆或发动机在水上旅行
example_zh: + 进修/准备，驶入港口

definition: the sport or activity of travelling in a boat with sails
example: to go sailing
definition_zh: 乘坐带帆船旅行的运动或活动
example_zh: 去航海

definition: money that employees receive for doing their job, especially professional employees or people working in an office, usually paid every month
example: an annual salary of $40 000
definition_zh: 员工因完成工作而获得的报酬，尤其是专业员工或办公室工作人员，通常每月支付
example_zh: 年薪4万美元

definition: an act or the process of selling something
example: regulations governing the sale of alcoholic beverages
definition_zh: 销售某物的行为或过程
example_zh: 关于酒精饮料销售的法规

definition: a thick liquid that is eaten with food to add taste to it
example: tomato/cranberry/chilli sauce
definition_zh: 一种浓稠的液体，与食物一起食用以增加风味
example_zh: 番茄/蔓越莓/辣椒酱

definition: to keep somebody/something safe from death, harm, loss, etc.
example: save somebody/something, to save somebody’s life
definition_zh: 为了保护某人或某物免受死亡、伤害、失去等威胁。
example_zh: 拯救某人/某物，以拯救某人的生命

definition: frightened of something or afraid that something bad might happen
example: The thieves got scared and ran away.
definition_zh: 害怕某事，或者害怕会发生什么坏事
example_zh: 小偷们被吓了，逃跑了。

definition: frightening
example: It was a really scary moment.
definition_zh: 吓人
example_zh: 那真是一个非常可怕的时刻。

definition: the place where something happens, especially something unpleasant
example: the scene of the accident/crime/crash
definition_zh: 那个会发生某事的地方，尤其是那些不愉快的事情
example_zh: 事故/犯罪/坠机现场

definition: a plan that lists all the work that you have to do and when you must do each thing
example: I have a hectic schedule for the next few days.
definition_zh: 一份列出你必须完成的所有工作以及每项工作时间的计划
example_zh: 接下来几天我行程非常忙碌。

definition: the number of points, goals, etc. scored by each player or team in a game or competition
example: a high/low score
definition_zh: 每场比赛或比赛中，每位球员或球队所取得的得分、进球等总数
example_zh: 高分/低分

definition: to win points, goals, etc. in a game or competition
example: Fraser scored again in the second half.
definition_zh: 在比赛或比赛中赢得积分、进球等
example_zh: 弗雷泽在下半场再次得分。

definition: the flat surface at the front of a television, computer, or other electronic device, on which you see pictures or information
example: a computer screen
definition_zh: 电视、电脑或其他电子设备前方的平面，您看到图片或信息的平面
example_zh: 一块电脑屏幕

definition: an attempt to find somebody/something, especially by looking carefully for them/it
example: search for somebody/something, a long search for the murder weapon
definition_zh: 试图找到某个人/某物，尤其是通过仔细寻找他们/它
example_zh: 寻找某人/某物，一场漫长的寻凶之旅

definition: to look carefully for something/somebody; to examine a particular place when looking for something/somebody
example: search for something/somebody, She searched in vain for her passport.
definition_zh: 仔细寻找某物/某人;在寻找某物/某人时仔细检查某个特定地点
example_zh: 寻找某样东西/某人，她徒劳地寻找护照。

definition: any of the four main periods of the year: spring, summer, autumn and winter
example: the changing seasons
definition_zh: 一年中的四个主要时期之一：春、夏、秋和冬
example_zh: 季节更替

definition: a place where you can sit, for example a chair
example: She sat back in her seat.
definition_zh: 一个你可以坐下的地方，比如一把椅子
example_zh: 她靠回座位。

definition: after one other person or thing in order or importance
example: She came second in the marathon.
definition_zh: 在另一个人或事之后，按顺序或重要性
example_zh: 她在马拉松中获得第二名。

definition: used to introduce the second of a list of points you want to make in a speech or piece of writing
example: Firstly, it's expensive, and secondly, it's too slow.
definition_zh: 用于介绍您想在演讲或文章中表达的观点清单中的第二点
example_zh: 首先，它很贵;其次，它太慢了。

definition: known about by only a few people; kept hidden from others
example: secret information/meetings/talks
definition_zh: 只有少数人知道;被隐藏起来，不让别人知道
example_zh: 秘密信息/会议/谈话

definition: something that is known about by only a few people and not told to others
example: Can you keep a secret?
definition_zh: 只有少数人知道，却从未告诉别人的事情
example_zh: 你能保守秘密吗？

definition: a person who works in an office, working for another person, dealing with mail and phone calls, keeping records, arranging meetings with people, etc.
example: a legal/medical secretary
definition_zh: 比如在办公室工作、为他人工作、处理邮件和电话、保存记录、安排与人会面等的人。
example_zh: 法律/医疗秘书

definition: to give the impression of being or doing something
example: + adj., You seem happy.
definition_zh: 给人一种存在或正在做某事的印象
example_zh: + 形容词，你看起来很开心。

definition: an understanding about something; an ability to judge something
example: One of the most important things in a partner is a sense of humour (= the ability to find things funny or make people laugh).
definition_zh: 对某事的理解;判断某事的能力
example_zh: 伴侣中最重要的东西之一是幽默感（= 能把事情发现好笑或逗人笑的能力）。

definition: forming a unit by itself; not joined to something else
example: They have begun to sleep in separate rooms.
definition_zh: 单独形成一个整体;而不是与其他物体相连
example_zh: 他们已经开始分房睡觉了。

definition: a set of television or radio programmes or podcasts that deal with the same subject or that have the same characters
example: The first episode of the new series is on Saturday.
definition_zh: 一组涉及相同主题或拥有相同角色的电视或广播节目或播客
example_zh: 新系列的第一集将在周六播出。

definition: bad or dangerous
example: a serious illness/offence/crime
definition_zh: 坏或危险
example_zh: 严重疾病/犯罪/犯罪

definition: to give somebody food or drink, for example at a restaurant or during a meal
example: serve (something), Breakfast is served between 7 and 10 a.m.
definition_zh: 比如在餐厅或用餐时给某人食物或饮料
example_zh: 提供（某样东西），早餐供应时间为上午7点至10点。

definition: a system that provides something that the public needs, organized by the government or a private company
example: the ambulance/bus/postal service
definition_zh: 一个由政府或私营公司组织、能够满足公众需求的系统
example_zh: 救护车/公交/邮政服务

definition: more than two but not very many
example: Several letters arrived this morning.
definition_zh: 超过两个，但不算多
example_zh: 今天早上收到了几封信。

definition: more than two but not very many
example: Several letters arrived this morning.
definition_zh: 超过两个，但不算多
example_zh: 今天早上收到了几封信。

definition: to move or make somebody/something move with short quick movements from side to side or up and down
example: The whole house shakes when a train goes past.
definition_zh: 用短促快速的左右或上下动作来移动或让某人/某物移动
example_zh: 一列火车经过，整栋房子都会震动。

definition: used with I and we for talking about or predicting the future
example: This time next week I shall be in Scotland.
definition_zh: 与 I 和 we 配合使用，用于谈论或预测未来
example_zh: 下周此时我会在苏格兰。

definition: the form of the outer edges or surfaces of something; an example of something that has a particular form
example: a rectangular/spherical/cylindrical shape
definition_zh: 某物外缘或表面的形状;具有特定形态的事物的例子
example_zh: 长方形/球形/圆柱形

definition: a large piece of thin cloth used on a bed to lie on or lie under
example: Have you changed the sheets (= put clean sheets on the bed)?
definition_zh: 一大块薄布，用来放在床上或下面躺着
example_zh: 你换床单了吗（=把干净的床单放上）？

definition: a large boat that carries people or goods by sea
example: The yard builds ships for the Navy.
definition_zh: 一艘通过海上运载人员或货物的大型船只
example_zh: 该造船厂为海军建造舰船。

definition: either of the two parts of the body between the top of each arm and the neck
example: your left/right shoulder
definition_zh: 身体两部分中介于每只手臂顶部与颈部之间的任一部位
example_zh: 你的左肩/右肩

definition: a loud cry of anger, fear, excitement, etc.
example: angry shouts
definition_zh: 愤怒、恐惧、兴奋等大声的喊叫。
example_zh: 愤怒的喊叫声

definition: to say something in a loud voice; to speak loudly/angrily to somebody
example: Stop shouting and listen!
definition_zh: 用大声说话;大声或愤怒地对别人说话
example_zh: 别喊了，听着！

definition: not open
example: The door was shut.
definition_zh: 未打开
example_zh: 门关着。

definition: to close something; to become closed
example: The window won't shut.
definition_zh: 关闭某物;变得封闭
example_zh: 窗户关不上。

definition: either of the two halves of a surface, an object or an area that is divided by an imaginary central line
example: the right side of the brain
definition_zh: 一个表面的两半、物体或被虚构中心线分隔的区域中的任一部分
example_zh: 大脑右侧

definition: an event, an action, a fact, etc. that shows that something exists, is happening or may happen in the future
example: Looking back, I should have seen the signs.
definition_zh: 一个事件、一个行动、一个事实等等，表明某件事确实存在、正在发生或未来可能发生
example_zh: 回头看，我本该看出那些迹象。

definition: to write your name on a document, letter, etc. to show that you have written it, that you agree with what it says, or that it is real
example: Sign here, please.
definition_zh: 在文件、信件等上写下你的名字，以表明你已经写好了，表示你同意信中所说，或者它是真实的
example_zh: 请在这里签字。

definition: shiny grey-white in colour
example: a silver car
definition_zh: 颜色为闪亮的灰白色
example_zh: 一辆银色汽车

definition: a chemical element. Silver is a shiny, grey-white precious metal used for making coins, jewellery, beautiful objects, etc.
example: a silver ring/chain
definition_zh: 一种化学元素。银是一种光亮的灰白色贵金属，用于制作硬币、珠宝、精美物品等。
example_zh: 一枚银戒指/银链

definition: not complicated; easy to understand or do
example: a simple solution/explanation/question/task/example
definition_zh: 不复杂;易于理解或操作
example_zh: 一个简单的解决方案/解释/问题/任务/示例

definition: from an event in the past until a later past event, or until now
example: Cath hasn't phoned since she went to Berlin.
definition_zh: 从过去的某个事件到更晚的过去事件，或者直到现在
example_zh: 凯斯自从去柏林后就没打过电话。

definition: from a time in the past until a later past time, or until now
example: She's been off work since Tuesday.
definition_zh: 从过去的某个时期到更晚的过去，或者直到现在
example_zh: 她从周二开始就没上班。

definition: the activity of making musical sounds with your voice
example: the beautiful singing of birds
definition_zh: 用你的声音发出音乐声音的活动
example_zh: 鸟儿的美妙歌唱

definition: only one
example: He sent her a single red rose.
definition_zh: 只有一个
example_zh: 他送给她一朵红玫瑰。

definition: a ticket that allows you to travel to a place but not back again
example: How much is a single to York?
definition_zh: 一张可以让你前往某个地方但不能再回来的车票
example_zh: 单人票到约克多少钱？

definition: used as a polite way of addressing a man whose name you do not know, for example in a shop or restaurant
example: Good morning, sir. Can I help you?
definition_zh: 比如在商店或餐厅，作为礼貌称呼一个你不知道名字的男人
example_zh: 早上好，先生。我能帮您吗？

definition: a place where a building, town, etc. was, is or will be located
example: the site of a sixteenth-century abbey
definition_zh: 一个建筑、城镇等曾经、现在或将会所在的位置
example_zh: 十六世纪修道院遗址

definition: how large or small a person or thing is
example: population/sample/group/class size
definition_zh: 一个人或一个事物有多大或多小
example_zh: 总体/样本/组/班级规模

definition: connected with the sport of skiing
example: a ski resort
definition_zh: 与滑雪运动相关的
example_zh: 滑雪胜地

definition: one of a pair of long narrow pieces of wood, metal or plastic that you attach to boots so that you can move smoothly over snow
example: a pair of skis
definition_zh: 这是一对长而窄的木头、金属或塑料片之一，可以固定在靴子上，这样你就能顺畅地在雪地上移动
example_zh: 一双滑雪板

definition: to move over snow on skis, especially as a sport
example: Our children want to learn to ski.
definition_zh: 在滑雪板上踩过雪地，尤其是作为一项运动
example_zh: 我们的孩子想学会滑雪。

definition: the sport or activity of moving over snow on skis
example: He also enjoys skiing and mountain biking.
definition_zh: 在滑雪板上移动雪地的运动或活动
example_zh: 他还喜欢滑雪和山地自行车。

definition: the layer of tissue that covers the body
example: to have dark/pale skin
definition_zh: 覆盖全身的组织层
example_zh: 拥有深色/苍白的皮肤

definition: the space above the earth that you can see when you look up, where clouds and the sun, moon and stars appear
example: The sky suddenly went dark and it started to rain.
definition_zh: 你抬头时能看到的地表上方的空间，云朵、太阳、月亮和星星都出现在那里
example_zh: 天空突然变黑，开始下雨。

definition: the natural state of rest in which your eyes are closed, your body is not active, and your mind is not conscious
example: I need to get some sleep.
definition_zh: 那种自然的休息状态，眼睛闭着，身体不活动，意识不清醒
example_zh: 我需要睡一觉。

definition: at a slow speed; not quickly
example: to move/walk/turn slowly
definition_zh: 以较慢的速度;但不快速
example_zh: 慢慢移动/走路/转身

definition: a mobile phone that also has some of the functions of a computer, for example the facility to use apps and the internet
example: You can use your smartphone to access the internet.
definition_zh: 一部同时具备计算机部分功能的手机，比如使用应用程序和互联网的功能
example_zh: 你可以用智能手机访问互联网。

definition: the quality of something that people and animals sense through their noses
example: a sweet/pleasant smell
definition_zh: 人和动物通过鼻子感知到的品质
example_zh: 一种甜美/宜人的气味

definition: to have a particular smell
example: + adj., The room smelt damp.
definition_zh: 拥有一种特定的气味
example_zh: + 形容词，房间闻起来潮湿。

definition: the expression that you have on your face when you are happy or you think something is funny, in which the corners of your mouth turn upwards
example: a broad/warm/bright/slight smile
definition_zh: 你开心或觉得好笑时脸上的表情，嘴角微微上扬
example_zh: 宽广/温暖/明亮/微微的微笑

definition: to make a smile appear on your face
example: to smile slightly/broadly
definition_zh: 让你脸上绽放笑容
example_zh: 微微一笑/笑容满面

definition: the grey, white or black gas that is produced by something burning
example: cigarette/tobacco smoke
definition_zh: 由燃烧物体产生的灰色、白色或黑色气体
example_zh: 香烟/烟草烟雾

definition: to take smoke from a cigarette, pipe, etc. into your mouth and let it out again
example: Do you mind if I smoke?
definition_zh: 把烟雾、烟斗等烟雾吸入嘴里，然后再吐出来
example_zh: 你介意我抽烟吗？

definition: the activity or habit of smoking cigarettes, etc.
example: No Smoking (= for example, on a notice)
definition_zh: 吸烟等活动或习惯。
example_zh: 禁止吸烟（=例如，有通知）

definition: a substance that you use with water for washing your body
example: Wash the affected area with soap and water.
definition_zh: 一种你用水清洗身体的物质
example_zh: 用肥皂和水清洗受影响区域。

definition: a game played by two teams of 11 players, using a round ball which players kick up and down the playing field. Teams try to kick the ball into the other team’s goal.
example: I played soccer when I was younger.
definition_zh: 一种由两队各11名球员进行的游戏，使用一个圆球，球员们在场地上上下踢球。各队尝试将球踢进对方球门。
example_zh: 我小时候踢过足球。

definition: connected with activities in which people meet each other for pleasure
example: She has a busy social life.
definition_zh: 与人们因娱乐而相互聚会的活动相关
example_zh: 她的社交生活非常忙碌。

definition: people in general, living together in communities
example: She believes that the arts benefit society as a whole.
definition_zh: 一般来说，人们，共同生活在社区中
example_zh: 她相信艺术对整个社会有益。

definition: a piece of clothing that is worn over the foot, ankle and lower part of the leg, especially inside a shoe
example: a pair of socks
definition_zh: 一种穿在脚、脚踝和小腿下部的衣物，尤其是在鞋内
example_zh: 一双袜子

definition: changing shape easily when pressed; not stiff or hard
example: soft margarine
definition_zh: 按压时容易变形;不硬也不硬
example_zh: 软人造黄油

definition: a member of an army, especially one who is not an officer
example: They visited the graves of US soldiers killed in the First World War.
definition_zh: 军队成员，尤其是不是军官的
example_zh: 他们参观了在第一次世界大战中阵亡的美国士兵的墓地。

definition: a way of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation
example: Attempts to find a solution have failed.
definition_zh: 一种解决问题或应对困难情况的方法
example_zh: 寻找解决方案的尝试均告失败。

definition: to find a way of dealing with a problem or difficult situation
example: Attempts are being made to solve the problem of waste disposal.
definition_zh: 寻找应对问题或困难局面的方法
example_zh: 正在努力解决废弃物处理问题。

definition: in, at or to a place that you do not know or do not mention by name
example: I read somewhere that she refuses to do interviews.
definition_zh: 在某个你不认识或未提及名字的地方
example_zh: 我在某处看到她拒绝接受采访。

definition: a place that you do not know or do not mention by name
example: We need to find somewhere to live.
definition_zh: 一个你不认识或没有提及名字的地方
example_zh: 我们得找个地方住。

definition: a group or type of people or things that are similar in a particular way
example: sort of somebody/something, ‘What sort of music do you like?’ ‘Oh, all sorts.’
definition_zh: 一个群体、类型、某类人或事物在某种方面有相似之处
example_zh: 有点像某个人/什么，'你喜欢什么样的音乐？''哦，各种各样的音乐。'

definition: a place, person or thing that you get something from
example: renewable energy sources
definition_zh: 一个你从中获得东西的地方、人或事物
example_zh: 可再生能源

definition: a person who gives a talk or makes a speech
example: He was a guest speaker at the conference.
definition_zh: 发表演讲或演讲的人
example_zh: 他是会议的特邀演讲者。

definition: connected with one particular thing only
example: specific needs/requirements
definition_zh: 只与一个特定事物相关
example_zh: 具体需求/要求

definition: a formal talk that a person gives to an audience
example: Several people made speeches at the wedding.
definition_zh: 一个人向听众进行的正式演讲
example_zh: 婚礼上有好几位人士发表了致辞。

definition: the rate at which somebody/something moves or travels
example: at … speed, at high/low/full/top speed
definition_zh: 某人或某物移动或移动的速度
example_zh: 在......速度，高速/低速/全速/最高速

definition: a small creature with eight thin legs. Many spiders spin webs to catch insects for food.
example: a poisonous spider
definition_zh: 一种有八条细长腿的小生物。许多蜘蛛织网捕食昆虫作为食物。
example_zh: 一只有毒的蜘蛛

definition: a tool that has a handle with a shallow bowl at the end, used for mixing, serving and eating food
example: a plastic/metal spoon
definition_zh: 一种带把手、末端带一个浅碗的工具，用于搅拌、盛食和食用食物
example_zh: 一把塑料/金属勺子

definition: having four straight equal sides and four angles of 90°
example: a square room
definition_zh: 具有四条直线等边和四个90°角
example_zh: 方形房间

definition: a shape with four straight sides of equal length and four angles of 90°; a piece of something that has this shape
