example: First break the chocolate into squares.
definition_zh: 一个有四条等长直边、四个角为90°的形状;一个具有此形状的物体碎片
example_zh: 首先把巧克力掰成方块。

definition: a period or state that something/somebody passes through while developing or making progress
example: at… stage, I can't make a decision at this stage.
definition_zh: 一个阶段或状态，表示某事或某人在发展或进展过程中经历
example_zh: 在......这个阶段，我无法做出决定。

definition: a set of steps built between two floors inside a building
example: We had to carry the piano up three flights of stairs.
definition_zh: 建筑物内部两层之间建造的一组台阶
example_zh: 我们不得不把钢琴抬上三层楼梯。

definition: a small piece of paper with a design on it that you buy and stick on an envelope or a package before you post it
example: a 67p stamp
definition_zh: 一张小纸，上面有图案，买下来贴在信封或包裹上，然后再寄出
example_zh: 67便士邮票

definition: to have one of the main parts in a film, play, etc.
example: star in something, He starred in that movie about the crazy professor.
definition_zh: 在电影、戏剧等中担任主要角色之一。
example_zh: 主演过什么，他主演过那部关于疯狂教授的电影。

definition: the point at which something begins
example: If we don't hurry, we'll miss the start.
definition_zh: 某件事开始的那个点
example_zh: 如果我们不快点，就会错过起跑。

definition: a country considered as an organized political community controlled by one government
example: the Baltic States
definition_zh: 一个被视为由单一政府控制的有组织政治共同体的国家
example_zh: 波罗的海国家

definition: a period of staying; a visit
example: I enjoyed my stay in Prague.
definition_zh: 一段停留期;一次拜访
example_zh: 我很享受在布拉格的时光。

definition: to take something from a person, shop, etc. without permission and without intending to return it or pay for it
example: I'll report you to the police if I catch you stealing again.
definition_zh: 未经许可且无意退还或支付费用，从某人、商店等处取走物品
example_zh: 如果我再抓到你偷东西，我就报警。

definition: one of a series of things that you do in order to achieve something
example: We are taking steps to prevent pollution.
definition_zh: 这是你为了实现某件事而做的一系列事情之一
example_zh: 我们正在采取措施防止污染。

definition: the organ inside the body where food goes when you eat it
example: stomach pains/cramps
definition_zh: 食物在你吃东西时，身体内部的那个器官就是食物会去的地方
example_zh: 胃痛/痉挛

definition: a hard solid mineral substance that is found in the ground, often used for building
example: Most of the houses are built of stone.
definition_zh: 一种坚硬的固体矿物，存在于地下，常用于建筑
example_zh: 大多数房屋均为石头建造。

definition: a large shop that sells many different types of goods
example: It's available at London's three biggest stores.
definition_zh: 一家大型商店，销售各种不同类型的商品
example_zh: 它在伦敦三大门店都有售。

definition: very bad weather with strong winds and rain, and often thunder and lightning
example: fierce/heavy/severe/violent storms
definition_zh: 天气非常恶劣，强风大雨，常有雷电
example_zh: 猛烈/猛烈/猛烈/猛烈风暴

definition: without a bend or curve; going in one direction only
example: a straight road
definition_zh: 没有弯道或曲线;只向一个方向前进
example_zh: 一条笔直的路

definition: not in a curve or at an angle; in a straight line
example: Keep straight on for two miles.
definition_zh: 不是弯道或斜角;而是直线
example_zh: 直行两英里。

definition: unusual or surprising, especially in a way that is difficult to understand
example: A strange thing happened this morning.
definition_zh: 不寻常或令人惊讶，尤其是以一种难以理解的方式
example_zh: 今天早上发生了一件奇怪的事。

definition: a plan that is intended to achieve a particular purpose
example: the government’s economic strategy
definition_zh: 旨在实现特定目的的计划
example_zh: 政府的经济战略

definition: pressure or worry caused by problems in somebody’s life or by having too much to do
example: emotional/mental stress
definition_zh: 因某人生活中的问题或事情太多而产生的压力或担忧
example_zh: 情绪/精神压力

definition: to give extra force to a word or syllable when saying it
example: You stress the first syllable in ‘happiness’.
definition_zh: 在说出某个词或音节时，赋予它额外的力量
example_zh: 你强调“幸福”的第一个音节。

definition: the way in which the parts of something are connected together, arranged or organized; a particular arrangement of parts
example: the structure of the building
definition_zh: 某物各部分如何连接、排列或组织的方式;特定部分的排列方式
example_zh: 建筑结构

definition: showing a lack of thought or good judgement
example: a stupid mistake/question/idea
definition_zh: 缺乏深思熟虑或判断力不足
example_zh: 一个愚蠢的错误/问题/想法

definition: to achieve something that you have been trying to do or get; to have the result or effect that was intended
example: Our plan succeeded.
definition_zh: 实现你一直努力想做或得到的事;达到预期的结果或效果
example_zh: 我们的计划成功了。

definition: achieving your aims or what was intended
example: The experiment was entirely successful.
definition_zh: 实现你的目标或原本的目标
example_zh: 实验完全成功。

definition: used to emphasize the great degree of something
example: This issue was of such importance that we could not afford to ignore it.
definition_zh: 用来强调某件事的伟大程度
example_zh: 这一问题至关重要，我们不能忽视它。

definition: used to emphasize the great degree of something
example: This issue was of such importance that we could not afford to ignore it.
definition_zh: 用来强调某件事的伟大程度
example_zh: 这一问题至关重要，我们不能忽视它。

definition: quickly and unexpectedly
example: I suddenly realized what I had to do.
definition_zh: 迅速且出乎意料地
example_zh: 我突然意识到我必须做什么。

definition: to put forward an idea or a plan for other people to think about
example: suggest something, I'd like to suggest a different explanation for the company's decline.
definition_zh: 提出一个想法或计划，让别人思考
example_zh: 如果提出一些建议，我想提出一个关于公司衰落的不同解释。

definition: an idea or a plan that you mention for somebody else to think about
example: Can I make a suggestion?
definition_zh: 一个你提起、让别人思考的想法或计划
example_zh: 我可以提个建议吗？

definition: a set of clothes made of the same cloth, including a jacket and trousers or a skirt
example: She was wearing a grey business suit.
definition_zh: 一套用同一种布料制成的衣服，包括夹克和裤子或一条裙子
example_zh: 她穿着灰色西装。

definition: approval that you give to somebody/something because you want them to be successful
example: support for something, There is strong public support for the policy.
definition_zh: 你给予某人或某物的认可，因为你希望他们成功
example_zh: 对某项政策的支持，公众对该政策有强烈支持。

definition: to help or encourage somebody/something by saying or showing that you agree with them/it
example: support somebody/something, to support an idea/a view
definition_zh: 通过表达或表现出你同意某人/某事的看法来帮助或鼓励他们/它
example_zh: 支持某人/某事，以支持一个想法/观点

definition: to think or believe that something is true or possible (based on the knowledge that you have)
example: Getting a visa isn't as simple as you might suppose.
definition_zh: 基于你所掌握的知识，认为或相信某件事是真实或可能的
example_zh: 办理签证并不像你想象的那么简单。

definition: used to say ‘yes’ to somebody
example: ‘Will you get me my coat?’ ‘Sure, where is it?’
definition_zh: 以前会对某人说'是'
example_zh: “你能帮我拿件外套吗？”“当然，在哪里？”

definition: an event, a piece of news, etc. that is unexpected or that happens suddenly
example: What a nice surprise!
definition_zh: 一个意外或突然发生的事件、一条新闻等等
example_zh: 真是个惊喜！

definition: to make somebody feel surprised
example: surprise somebody, It wouldn't surprise me if they got married soon.
definition_zh: 让某人感到惊讶
example_zh: 给人惊喜，如果他们很快结婚我一点也不惊讶。

definition: feeling or showing surprise
example: a surprised look
definition_zh: 感到或表现出惊讶
example_zh: 惊讶的表情

definition: causing surprise
example: It’s not surprising (that) they lost.
definition_zh: 引发惊讶
example_zh: 他们输了也就不足为奇了。

definition: an investigation of the opinions, behaviour, etc. of a particular group of people, which is usually done by asking them questions
example: A recent survey showed 75 per cent of those questioned were in favour of the plan.
definition_zh: 对特定群体的观点、行为等进行调查，通常通过向他们提问来完成
example_zh: 最近的一项调查显示，75%的受访者支持该计划。

definition: containing, or tasting as if it contains, a lot of sugar
example: a cup of hot sweet tea
definition_zh: 含有，或者说尝起来像含有大量糖分
example_zh: 一杯热甜茶

definition: a small piece of sweet food, usually made with sugar and/or chocolate and eaten between meals
example: a packet of sweets
definition_zh: 一小块甜食，通常用糖和/或巧克力制成，在餐间食用
example_zh: 一包糖果

definition: a person, an object, an event, etc. that represents a more general quality or situation
example: The vase is decorated with religious symbols.
definition_zh: 一个人、一个物体、一个事件等等，代表一种更普遍的特质或情境
example_zh: 花瓶上装饰有宗教符号。

definition: an organized set of ideas or theories or a particular way of doing something
example: reform of the country's education system
definition_zh: 一组有组织的思想、理论或某种特定的做事方式
example_zh: 国家教育体系改革

definition: a small computer that is easy to carry, with a large touch screen and usually without a physical keyboard
example: The company has launched its latest 10-inch tablet.
definition_zh: 一台便携的小型电脑，配有大型触摸屏，通常没有实体键盘
example_zh: 该公司推出了最新的10英寸平板电脑。

definition: a speech or lecture on a particular subject
example: I went to several interesting talks at the conference.
definition_zh: 关于特定主题的演讲或讲座
example_zh: 我在会议上参加了几场有趣的演讲。

definition: a result that you try to achieve
example: to meet/hit a target
definition_zh: 你试图实现的结果
example_zh: 达到/击中目标

definition: a piece of work that somebody has to do, especially a hard or unpleasant one
example: to accomplish/perform/undertake/complete a task
definition_zh: 这是一项必须有人完成的工作，尤其是艰难或不愉快的工作
example_zh: 完成/执行/承担/完成任务

definition: the particular quality that different foods and drinks have that allows you to recognize them when you put them in your mouth
example: a sweet/salty/bitter/sour taste
definition_zh: 不同食物和饮料具有的特殊特性，让你在把它们放进嘴里时就能辨认出来
example_zh: 甜/咸/苦/酸的味道

definition: to have a particular taste
example: + adj., to taste good/delicious/sweet
definition_zh: 拥有特定的品味
example_zh: + 形容词，味道好/美味/甜美

definition: the work of a teacher
example: She wants to go into teaching (= make it a career).
definition_zh: 教师的工作
example_zh: 她想从事教学工作（=把它当成职业）。

definition: scientific knowledge used in practical ways in industry, for example in designing new machines
example: science and technology
definition_zh: 在工业中实际应用的科学知识，例如设计新机器时
example_zh: 科学与技术

definition: between 13 and 19 years old; connected with people of this age
example: a teenage girl/boy
definition_zh: 年龄在13至19岁之间;与这一年龄段的人有联系
example_zh: 一个十几岁的女孩/男孩

definition: the measurement in degrees of how hot or cold a thing or place is
example: high/low temperatures
definition_zh: 以度数衡量一个事物或地方有多热或多冷的度量
example_zh: 高温/低温

definition: a word or phrase used as the name of something, especially one connected with a particular type of language
example: a technical/legal/generic term
definition_zh: 一个用作某物名称的词语或短语，尤其是与某种特定语言类型相关的词
example_zh: 一个技术性/法律性/通用术语

definition: to send somebody a written message using a mobile phone
example: I'll text you when I get home.
definition_zh: 使用手机向某人发送书面信息
example_zh: 我回家后会给你发短信。

definition: used when people or animals performing an action are also affected by it
example: They seemed to be enjoying themselves.
definition_zh: 当执行某项操作的人或动物也会受到其影响时，会使用。
example_zh: 他们似乎玩得很开心。

definition: having a larger distance between opposite sides or surfaces than other similar objects or than normal
example: a thick slice of bread
definition_zh: 比其他类似物体或正常物体之间的相对侧或表面间距更大
example_zh: 一大片面包

definition: a person who steals something from another person or place
example: a car/jewel thief
definition_zh: 一个人从他人或地方偷取物品
example_zh: 一个汽车/珠宝窃贼

definition: having a smaller distance between opposite sides or surfaces than other similar objects or than normal
example: Cut the vegetables into thin strips.
definition_zh: 相对侧或表面之间的距离比其他类似物体或正常物体更小
example_zh: 把蔬菜切成细条。

definition: the process of thinking about something
example: I had to do some quick thinking.
definition_zh: 思考某事的过程
example_zh: 我不得不迅速思考。

definition: each of three equal parts of something
example: He divided the money into thirds.
definition_zh: 每个是某物的三个相等部分
example_zh: 他把钱分成了三份。

definition: something that you think of or remember
example: thought of doing something, I couldn't bear the thought of waiting any longer.
definition_zh: 你想起或记得的某件事
example_zh: 想到要做点什么，我再也无法忍受等待的念头。

definition: to send something from your hand through the air by moving your hand or arm quickly
example: Practise throwing and catching.
definition_zh: 通过快速移动手或手臂，将某样东西从手中飞向空中
example_zh: 练习投掷和接球。

definition: arranged neatly and with everything in order
example: a tidy desk
definition_zh: 整齐地摆放，一切都井然有序
example_zh: 一张整洁的书桌

definition: to make something look neat by putting things in the place where they belong
example: I spent all morning cleaning and tidying.
definition_zh: 把东西放到该在的位置，让东西看起来整洁
example_zh: 我整个上午都在打扫和整理。

definition: a long, narrow piece of cloth worn around the neck, especially by men, with a knot in front
example: He was dressed impeccably in a suit and tie.
definition_zh: 一种长而窄的布，通常系在脖子上，尤其是男性佩戴，前面有结
example_zh: 他穿着西装打领带，衣着得体无可挑剔。

definition: to attach or hold two or more things together using string, rope, etc.; to fasten somebody/something with string, rope, etc.
example: tie something + adv./prep., She tied the newspapers in a bundle.
definition_zh: 用细绳、绳索等将两个或多个物体连接或固定在一起；用细绳、绳索等捆住某人或某物。
example_zh: 将某物系在或捆在某处，她把报纸捆成一捆。

definition: a small piece of advice about something practical
example: tip on/for doing something, handy tips for buying a computer
definition_zh: 关于一些实用的小建议
example_zh: 关于某件事的小贴士/购买电脑的小贴士

definition: an instrument such as a hammer, screwdriver, saw, etc. that you hold in your hand and use for making things, repairing things, etc.
example: garden tools
definition_zh: 一种工具，比如锤子、螺丝刀、锯子等，你握在手里用来制作、修理东西等等。
example_zh: 园艺工具

definition: highest in position
example: He lives on the top floor.
definition_zh: 最高位置
example_zh: 他住在顶楼。

definition: the highest part or point of something
example: at the top of something, She was standing at the top of the stairs.
definition_zh: 某物的最高部分或点
example_zh: 在某处顶端，她站在楼梯顶端。

definition: to put your hand or another part of your body onto somebody/something
example: Don't touch that plate—it's hot!
definition_zh: 把你的手或身体的其他部位放在某个人/某物上
example_zh: 别碰那盘子——太烫了！

definition: a journey made for pleasure during which several different towns, countries, etc. are visited
example: a walking/sightseeing/bus tour
definition_zh: 这是一场为娱乐而设计的旅程，途中会访问多个不同的城镇、国家等
example_zh: 步行/观光/巴士游览

definition: the business activity connected with providing accommodation, services and entertainment for people who are visiting a place for pleasure
example: The area is heavily dependent on tourism.
definition_zh: 为来访娱乐场所的人们提供住宿、服务和娱乐相关的商业活动
example_zh: 该地区高度依赖旅游业。

definition: in the direction of somebody/something
example: They were heading towards the German border.
definition_zh: 朝着某个人/某物的方向
example_zh: 他们正朝着德国边境前进。

definition: a piece of cloth or paper used for drying things, especially your body
example: Help yourself to a clean towel.
definition_zh: 一块用来擦干物品的布或纸，尤其是你的身体
example_zh: 随便拿一条干净的毛巾。

definition: a tall narrow building or part of a building, especially of a church or castle
example: a bell tower
definition_zh: 一栋高而窄的建筑或建筑的一部分，尤其是教堂或城堡的建筑
example_zh: 钟楼

definition: made as a copy of a particular thing and used for playing with
example: a toy car
definition_zh: 作为特定物品的复制品制作，用于玩弄
example_zh: 一辆玩具车

definition: an object for children to play with
example: cuddly/stuffed toys
definition_zh: 一个供孩子们玩耍的物品
example_zh: 毛绒玩具/毛绒玩具

definition: rails (= metal bars) that a train moves along
example: railway/railroad tracks
definition_zh: 列车沿线行驶的轨道（=金属杆）
example_zh: 铁路/铁路轨道

definition: a belief, custom or way of doing something that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people; a set of these beliefs or customs
example: religious/cultural/ancient traditions
definition_zh: 一种在特定群体中长期存在的信仰、习俗或做某事的方式;这些信仰或习俗的集合
example_zh: 宗教/文化/古代传统

definition: being part of the beliefs, customs or way of life of a particular group of people, that have not changed for a long time
example: traditional dress/music/art/culture/dance
definition_zh: 成为某一特定群体信仰、习俗或生活方式的一部分，这些信仰、习俗或生活方式长期未曾改变
example_zh: 传统服饰/音乐/艺术/文化/舞蹈

definition: to teach a person or an animal the skills for a particular job or activity; to be taught in this way
example: train somebody/something, highly trained professionals
definition_zh: 教人或动物从事特定工作或活动的技能;以这种方式被教导
example_zh: 培训某人/某物，训练有素的专业人士

definition: a shoe that you wear for sports or as informal clothing
example: a pair of trainers
definition_zh: 一种你用于运动或休闲穿着的鞋子
example_zh: 一双运动鞋

definition: the process of learning the skills that you need to do a job
example: staff training
definition_zh: 学习完成工作所需技能的过程
example_zh: 员工培训

definition: a system for carrying people or goods from one place to another using vehicles, roads, etc.
example: air/freight/road transport
definition_zh: 一种利用车辆、道路等将人员或货物从一个地方运送到另一个地方的系统。
example_zh: 航空/货运/公路运输

definition: a person who is travelling or who often travels
example: She is a frequent traveller to Belgium.
definition_zh: 一个正在旅行或经常旅行的人
example_zh: 她经常前往比利时旅行。

definition: a problem, worry, difficulty, etc. or a situation causing this
example: We have trouble getting staff.
definition_zh: 是问题、担忧、困难等等，或者某个情境导致这种情况
example_zh: 我们很难找到员工。

definition: a large vehicle for carrying heavy loads by road
example: a truck driver
definition_zh: 一种用于公路运输重载的大型车辆
example_zh: 一名卡车司机

definition: used to describe one of a pair of children who are twins
example: a twin brother/sister
definition_zh: 用来形容一对双胞胎孩子中的一个
example_zh: 一对双胞胎兄妹

definition: one of two children born at the same time to the same mother
example: She's expecting twins.
definition_zh: 同一个母亲同时出生的两个孩子之一
example_zh: 她怀的是双胞胎。

definition: having the usual qualities or features of a particular type of person, thing or group
example: a typical Italian cafe
definition_zh: 具备某类人、事物或群体的常见特质或特征
example_zh: 一家典型的意大利咖啡馆

definition: under the surface of the ground
example: an underground bunker/tunnel
definition_zh: 地下
example_zh: 地下掩体/隧道

definition: under the surface of the ground
example: Rescuers found victims trapped several feet underground.
definition_zh: 地下
example_zh: 救援人员发现受害者被困在地下数英尺深处。

definition: the knowledge that somebody has about a particular subject or situation
example: Students will gain a broad understanding of the workings of Parliament.
definition_zh: 某人对某个特定主题或情境的了解
example_zh: 学生将广泛了解议会的运作方式。

definition: used to say that a particular situation or fact makes you sad or disappointed, or gets you into a difficult position
example: Unfortunately, I won't be able to attend the meeting.
definition_zh: 过去说的是一种特定情况或事实让你感到难过、失望，或者让你陷入困境
example_zh: 很遗憾，我无法参加这次会议。

definition: not happy; sad
example: to feel/look/seem/sound/become unhappy
definition_zh: 不开心;悲伤
example_zh: 感受/看上去/听起来/变得不快乐

definition: the special set of clothes worn by all members of an organization or a group at work, or by children at school
example: The hat is part of the school uniform.
definition_zh: 组织或团体所有成员在工作中穿的特殊服装，或学校里的儿童穿着的服装
example_zh: 帽子是校服的一部分。

definition: a single thing, person or group that is complete by itself but can also form part of something larger
example: After 1946 the British Government treated the four territorial divisions as a single unit.
definition_zh: 一个整体、一个人或一个群体，它们本身就完整，但也可以成为更大事物的一部分
example_zh: 1946年后，英国政府将四个领土行政区视为一个整体。

definition: joined together as a political unit or by shared aims
example: the United States of America
definition_zh: 作为一个政治单位或因共同目标而联合起来
example_zh: 美利坚合众国

definition: different from what is usual or normal
example: The case is highly unusual.
definition_zh: 与正常或正常不同
example_zh: 此案极为罕见。

definition: on a floor of a house or other building that is higher than the one that you are on
example: an upstairs room/window/bathroom
definition_zh: 在房屋或其他建筑物的某层，该楼层比你所在的楼层更高
example_zh: 楼上的房间/窗户/浴室

definition: the act of using something; the state of being used
example: A ban was imposed on the use of chemical weapons.
definition_zh: 使用某物的行为;被使用状态
example_zh: 对化学武器的使用实施了禁令。

definition: used to say that something happened continuously or frequently during a period in the past
example: I used to live in London.
definition_zh: 过去的话常说，过去某个时期里某件事是持续或频繁发生的
example_zh: 我以前住在伦敦。

definition: a person or thing that uses something
example: road users
definition_zh: 使用某物的人或物
example_zh: 道路使用者

definition: that happens or is done most of the time or in most cases
example: This is the usual way of doing it.
definition_zh: 这种情况大多数情况下都会发生或被执行
example_zh: 这是通常的做法。

definition: an area of low land between hills or mountains, often with a river flowing through it; the land that a river flows through
example: in a valley, In the valley below cows were grazing peacefully.
definition_zh: 丘陵或山脉之间的低洼地带，通常有河流穿过;河流流经的土地
example_zh: 在山谷里，下面的山谷里，牛群安静地吃草。

definition: a covered vehicle with no side windows in its back half, usually smaller than a lorry, used for carrying goods or people
example: the driver of a white van
definition_zh: 一种后半部没有侧窗的有盖车辆，通常比卡车小，用于运载货物或人员
example_zh: 白色面包车的司机

definition: several different sorts of the same thing
example: There is a wide variety of patterns to choose from.
definition_zh: 同一种东西的几种不同类型
example_zh: 有种类繁多的图案可供选择。

definition: a thing that is used for transporting people or goods from one place to another, such as a car or lorry
example: motor vehicles (= cars, buses, lorries, etc.)
definition_zh: 一种用于将人或货物从一个地方运送到另一个地方的东西，比如汽车或卡车
example_zh: 机动车辆（= 汽车、公交车、卡车等）

definition: what you can see from a particular place or position, especially beautiful countryside
example: view of something, There were magnificent views of the surrounding countryside.
definition_zh: 你从某个特定地点或位置看到的景象，尤其是美丽的乡村景色
example_zh: 某处景象，周围乡村景色壮丽。

definition: a living thing, too small to be seen without a microscope, that causes disease in people, animals and plants
example: the flu/influenza virus
definition_zh: 一种生命体，体型太小，不借助显微镜无法看见，却会引发人类、动物和植物的疾病
example_zh: 流感/流感病毒

definition: the sound or sounds produced through the mouth by a person speaking or singing
example: I could hear voices in the next room.
definition_zh: 指一个人说话或唱歌时通过嘴巴发出的声音或声音
example_zh: 我能听到隔壁房间有声音。

definition: an act of waiting; an amount of time waited
example: The wait seemed interminable.
definition_zh: 一种等待的行为;等待的时间
example_zh: 等待似乎漫长无尽。

definition: a situation in which two or more countries or groups of people fight against each other over a period of time
example: the Second World War
definition_zh: 一种情形：两个或多个国家或群体在一段时间内相互对抗
example_zh: 第二次世界大战

definition: an act of cleaning somebody/something using water and usually soap
example: These towels are ready for a wash.
definition_zh: 用水和通常是肥皂清洗某人或某物的行为
example_zh: 这些毛巾已经准备好洗了。

definition: the act of cleaning something using water and usually soap
example: a gentle shampoo for frequent washing
definition_zh: 用水，通常是肥皂清洗某样东西的行为
example_zh: 一款适合频繁洗头的温和洗发水

definition: a raised line of water that moves across the surface of the sea, ocean, etc.
example: Huge waves were breaking on the shore.
definition_zh: 一条在海面、海洋等表面流动的隆起水线。
example_zh: 巨大的海浪拍打着岸边。

definition: not physically strong
example: She is still weak after her illness.
definition_zh: 身体不强壮
example_zh: 她病后依然虚弱。

definition: a system for finding information on the internet, in which documents are connected to other documents
example: to surf/browse/search the web
definition_zh: 一种在互联网上查找信息的系统，其中文档与其他文档相关联
example_zh: 浏览/浏览/搜索网页

definition: a marriage ceremony, and the meal or party that usually follows it
example: I dreamed of having a big wedding, with all my family and friends.
definition_zh: 婚礼仪式，以及通常随之而来的餐宴或派对
example_zh: 我梦想着办一场盛大的婚礼，所有家人和朋友都参加。

definition: how heavy somebody/something is, which can be measured in, for example, kilograms or pounds
example: in weight, It is about 76 kilos in weight.
definition_zh: 某人或某物的重量，可以用公斤或磅来衡量
example_zh: 重量约为76公斤。

definition: something that you do or say to somebody when they arrive, especially something that makes them feel you are happy to see them
example: to get/receive a welcome
definition_zh: 当某人到来时你做或说的什么，尤其是能让他们觉得你很高兴见到他们的事情
example_zh: 要获得/接受欢迎

definition: covered with or containing liquid, especially water
example: wet clothes/hair/grass
definition_zh: 覆盖或含有液体，尤其是水
example_zh: 湿衣服/头发/草

definition: one of the round objects under a car, bicycle, bus, etc. that turns when it moves
example: He braked suddenly, causing the front wheels to skid.
definition_zh: 汽车、自行车、公交车等车下方的圆形物体，移动时会转动
example_zh: 他突然刹车，导致前轮打滑。

definition: during the time that something is happening; at the same time as something else is happening
example: We must have been burgled while we were asleep.
definition_zh: 在某件事正在发生的那段时间;同时发生其他事情
example_zh: 我们肯定是在睡觉时被盗了。

definition: full; complete
example: Let's forget the whole thing.
definition_zh: 完全的；完整的
example_zh: 把这事全忘了吧。

definition: used in questions to ask who something belongs to
example: Whose house is that?
definition_zh: 用于询问某物属于谁的问题
example_zh: 那是谁的房子？

definition: used in questions to ask who something belongs to
example: Whose house is that?
definition_zh: 用于询问某物属于谁的问题
example_zh: 那是谁的房子？

definition: measuring a large distance from one side to the other
example: It's a wide, fast-flowing river.
definition_zh: 测量从一侧到另一侧的大距离
example_zh: 这是一条宽阔且流速急的河流。

definition: living or growing in natural conditions; not kept in a house or on a farm
example: wild animals/birds/flowers
definition_zh: 在自然条件下生活或生长;不在房屋或农场中饲养;
example_zh: 野生动物/鸟类/花卉

definition: air that moves quickly as a result of natural forces
example: The strong wind blew the leaves off the trees.
definition_zh: 由于自然力而快速流动的空气
example_zh: 强风把树叶吹得飞了下来。

definition: a person, a team, an animal, etc. that wins something
example: The lucky winner gets an all-expenses-paid trip to Sydney.
definition_zh: 一个人、一个团队、一只动物等等，只要他们赢得了什么
example_zh: 幸运的赢家将获得一趟全额报销的悉尼之旅。

definition: used especially in a letter, email or card to say that you hope that somebody will be happy, well or successful
example: Give my good wishes to the family.
definition_zh: 尤其用于信件、电子邮件或卡片中，表达你希望某人能够幸福、健康或成功
example_zh: 代我向家人致以美好祝福。

definition: to want something to happen or to be true even though it is unlikely or impossible
example: wish (that)…, I wish I were taller.
definition_zh: 希望某件事发生或成为真，尽管它不太可能或不可能
example_zh: 真希望......我真希望自己能更高一点。

definition: the hard material that the trunk and branches of a tree are made of; this material when it is used to build or make things with, or as a fuel
example: He chopped some wood for the fire.
definition_zh: 树干和树枝所由坚硬材料构成;当这种材料用于建筑或制作物品时，或作为燃料使用
example_zh: 他劈了些柴火。

definition: made of wood
example: a wooden box/door/floor
definition_zh: 木制
example_zh: 一个木箱/门/地板

definition: having a job for which you are paid
example: the working population
definition_zh: 有一份你有报酬的工作
example_zh: 劳动人口

definition: thinking about unpleasant things that have happened or that might happen and therefore feeling unhappy and afraid
example: Don't look so worried!
definition_zh: 想到已经发生或可能发生的不愉快事情，因此感到不快乐和害怕
example_zh: 别那么担心！

definition: to keep thinking about unpleasant things that might happen or about problems that you have
example: Don't worry. We have plenty of time.
definition_zh: 不断想着可能发生的不愉快事情，或者你遇到的问题
example_zh: 别担心。我们有的是时间。

definition: of poorer quality or lower standard; more unpleasant
example: The rooms were awful and the food was worse.
definition_zh: 质量较低或标准较低;更令人不快
example_zh: 房间很糟糕，食物更糟。

definition: of the poorest quality or lowest standard; worse than any other person or thing of a similar kind
example: It was by far the worst speech he had ever made.
definition_zh: 质量最低或标准最低;比任何类似的人或物都更差
example_zh: 那是他迄今为止发表过的最糟糕的演讲。

definition: used to show that you are very surprised or impressed by somebody/something
example: Wow! You look terrific!
definition_zh: 用来表达你对某人/某事感到非常惊讶或印象深刻
example_zh: 哇！你看起来棒极了！

definition: used in negative sentences and questions to talk about something that has not happened but that you expect to happen
example: (British English), I haven't received a letter from him yet.
definition_zh: 用于否定句和提问句中，用来谈论尚未发生但你预期会发生的事情
example_zh: （英式英语），我还没收到他的信。

definition: of or belonging to you
example: Is that book yours?
definition_zh: 属于或属于您
example_zh: 那本书是你的吗？

example: Five, four, three, two, one, zero… We have lift-off.
example_zh: 五、四、三、二、一、零......我们已经升空了。
